"""Python 3 + SQLite teaching comparison. Not an InnoDB locking simulator.
No network, dispatcher or external operation is performed.
"""
import json
import sqlite3
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

EDGES = {("NEW", "RUNNING"), ("RUNNING", "SUCCEEDED"), ("RUNNING", "FAILED")}
MAX_VERSION = 2**63 - 1

def connect(path):
    c = sqlite3.connect(path, timeout=3, isolation_level=None)
    c.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    return c

def init(c):
    c.executescript("""
      CREATE TABLE task(tenant TEXT NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>=0),PRIMARY KEY(tenant,id));
      CREATE TABLE receipt(tenant TEXT NOT NULL,op TEXT NOT NULL,request TEXT NOT NULL,
        result TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(tenant,op));
      CREATE TABLE outbox(tenant TEXT NOT NULL,op TEXT NOT NULL,task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        state TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(tenant,op),
        FOREIGN KEY(tenant,task_id) REFERENCES task(tenant,id));
    """)

def transition(c, tenant, task, op, state, version, target, fail_outbox=False):
    if (state, target) not in EDGES or type(version) is not int or not 0 <= version < MAX_VERSION:
        raise ValueError("invalid edge/version")
    if any(not isinstance(s, str) or not 1 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in (tenant, task, op)):
        raise ValueError("bounded identities required")
    request = json.dumps([task, state, version, target], ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    c.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
    try:
        old = c.execute("SELECT request,result FROM receipt WHERE tenant=? AND op=?", (tenant, op)).fetchone()
        if old:
            if old[0] != request:
                raise ValueError("operation ID reused")
            c.commit()
            return old[1]
        changed = c.execute("""UPDATE task SET state=?,version=version+1
            WHERE tenant=? AND id=? AND state=? AND version=?""",
            (target, tenant, task, state, version)).rowcount
        result = "APPLIED" if changed == 1 else "CONFLICT_OR_MISSING"
        c.execute("INSERT INTO receipt VALUES(?,?,?,?)", (tenant, op, request, result))
        if changed:
            if fail_outbox:
                raise RuntimeError("injected before outbox")
            c.execute("INSERT INTO outbox VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)", (tenant, op, task, target, version + 1))
        c.commit()
        return result
    except BaseException:
        c.rollback()
        raise

def self_test():
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="state-cas-", dir=Path(__file__).resolve().parent) as tmp:
        path = str(Path(tmp) / "lab.db")
        with connect(path) as c:
            init(c)
            c.execute("INSERT INTO task VALUES('t','job','NEW',0)")
        def race(i):
            c = connect(path)
            try:
                return i, transition(c, "t", "job", f"op{i}", "NEW", 0, "RUNNING")
            finally:
                c.close()
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
            outcomes = list(pool.map(race, range(64)))
        wins = [i for i, result in outcomes if result == "APPLIED"]
        assert len(wins) == 1
        c = connect(path)
        try:
            assert c.execute("SELECT state,version FROM task").fetchone() == ("RUNNING", 1)
            assert c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox").fetchone()[0] == 1
            assert transition(c, "t", "job", f"op{wins[0]}", "NEW", 0, "RUNNING") == "APPLIED"
            try:
                transition(c, "t", "job", "complete", "RUNNING", 1, "SUCCEEDED", True)
                raise AssertionError("expected injection")
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
            assert c.execute("SELECT state,version FROM task").fetchone() == ("RUNNING", 1)
            assert c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM receipt WHERE op='complete'").fetchone()[0] == 0
            assert transition(c, "t", "job", "complete", "RUNNING", 1, "SUCCEEDED") == "APPLIED"
            try:
                transition(c, "t", "job", "complete", "RUNNING", 1, "FAILED")
                raise AssertionError("expected payload conflict")
            except ValueError:
                pass
            assert transition(c, "other", "job", "x", "NEW", 0, "RUNNING") == "CONFLICT_OR_MISSING"
            assert c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox").fetchone()[0] == 2
        finally:
            c.close()
    print("PASS: SQLite transition/receipt/outbox model, 64 contenders, rollback and tenant boundary; not MySQL")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("SQLite", sqlite3.sqlite_version)
    self_test()

import java.sql.*;

/** Optional integration against an explicitly authorized local disposable schema. */
public final class MySqlIntegration {
    private static int checks;
    private static void require(boolean b){checks++;if(!b)throw new AssertionError("check "+checks);}
    @FunctionalInterface interface Job { boolean run(int i) throws Exception; }
    private static int race(int count,Job job) throws Exception {
        ExecutorService pool=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8);
        List<Future<Boolean>> futures=new ArrayList<>();
        Throwable primary = null;
        try{
            for(int i=0;i<count;i++){final int n=i;futures.add(pool.submit(()->job.run(n)));}
            int won=0;long end=System.nanoTime()+60_000_000_000L;
            for(Future<Boolean> f:futures)if(f.get(Math.max(1,end-System.nanoTime()),TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS))won++;
            return won;
        } catch (Exception | Error failure) { primary = failure; throw failure; }
        finally {
            Throwable failure = primary;
            for (Future<Boolean> future : futures) {
                try { future.cancel(true); }
                catch (RuntimeException | Error cleanup) { failure = keepFailure(failure, cleanup); }
            }
            try { pool.shutdownNow(); }
            catch (RuntimeException | Error cleanup) { failure = keepFailure(failure, cleanup); }
            try {
                if (!pool.awaitTermination(12,TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new IllegalStateException("workers did not stop");
            } catch (InterruptedException | RuntimeException | Error cleanup) {
                if (cleanup instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();

      q=statement.strip()
      if not q or re.match(r'(SET\b|EXPLAIN\b|ANALYZE\b)',q,re.I):continue
      if 'ROW_COUNT()' in q:selects.append([(dml_counts[-1],)]);continue
      q=re.sub(r'ENGINE\s*=\s*InnoDB','',q,flags=re.I)
      q=q.replace('AUTO_INCREMENT','').replace('START TRANSACTION','BEGIN')
      # Ignore physical key declarations but preserve their columns, rows and constraints.
      q=re.sub(r',\s*(?:INDEX|KEY)\s+\w+\s*\([^)]*\)','',q,flags=re.I)
      q=re.sub(r'\s+(?:FORCE|IGNORE) INDEX\s*\([^)]*\)','',q,flags=re.I)
      q=q.replace('TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,',"TIMESTAMPADD('SECOND',")
      q=re.sub(r'@(\w+)',lambda m:repr(sets[m[1]]),q)
      # DATETIME(6) normalizes omitted fractional seconds in MySQL.
      # SQLite uses text here, so explicitly normalize literals to the same precision.
      q=re.sub(r"'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})'",lambda m:"'"+m[1]+".000000'",q)
      cur=db.execute(q)
      if q.upper().startswith(('SELECT','WITH')):selects.append(cur.fetchall())
      if q.upper().startswith(('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE')):dml_counts.append(cur.rowcount)
    return db,selects,dml_counts

-- # 隔离级别、幻读与写偏差：用两会话推导结果
-- 
-- ## 先给结论
-- 
-- InnoDB 的默认隔离级别是 REPEATABLE READ。RC 与 RR 的差别既包括普通一致性读的快照时机，也包括锁定读和写语句的范围保护、非匹配记录锁释放等行为。RR 稳定的普通读快照不等于可串行化，更不等于自动防超卖、自动幂等或自动保护跨行约束。
-- 
-- 先声明读类型和事务边界，再回答“有没有幻读”。普通一致性读不靠间隙锁阻止别人插入；范围加锁读及写语句才需要结合索引、谓词、隔离级别分析记录锁、gap lock 和 next-key lock。
-- 
-- ## 四种级别分别允许什么、怎样选择
-- 
-- **READ UNCOMMITTED：** 普通读可能看到其他事务未提交的修改，包括后来回滚的值。写操作仍有锁和其他并发控制，不能理解为“没有任何机制”。只有明确容忍撤销和不稳定结果的近似观察才值得评估，余额、库存及业务决策不应以这种读取为事实。
-- 
-- **READ COMMITTED：** 每次普通一致性读采用新的已提交视图。同一个事务再次读同一行可能变化，同一个谓词的结果集也可能变化。适合每条查询独立看已提交状态、业务不变量由约束和原子更新等另外表达的服务。
-- 
-- **REPEATABLE READ：** 同一事务的普通一致性读通常复用第一次这类读的视图，适合多次核对或有界快照报表。自己的写和当前加锁操作仍需单独分析；范围加锁访问可能阻止相关插入，长快照也增加历史保留成本。
-- 
-- **SERIALIZABLE：** 在关闭 autocommit 的事务中，InnoDB 将普通 SELECT 隐式转为共享加锁读，以施加更强并发约束。它可能等待、发生锁升级死锁并要求事务重试。自动提交的单条只读 SELECT 有独立优化语义；“把级别设成串行化”不意味着整个数据库只能有一个工作线程，也不包含外部 HTTP 副作用。
-- 
-- 隔离级别不是通用性能排名。RC 在部分范围更新负载下减少间隙保护和无效记录持锁，可能降低冲突；RR 已存在唯一键完整等值命中通常只需记录锁，不能说“RR 每次都锁间隙”。RC 的外键和重复键检查仍可用 gap lock。RC UPDATE 遇到被锁记录时还可能先用半一致读判断已提交版本是否匹配，真正修改时仍需锁定并重新检查。
-- 
-- RC 和 RR 都可能死锁。例如 A 先锁记录 1 再请求记录 2，B 先锁记录 2 再请求记录 1，就可能形成等待环。RC 可以减少部分范围负载的锁冲突，却不能消除这个环；统一访问顺序、缩短持锁时间，并完整回滚重试更重要。库存单行扣减与月末多查询对账的快照需求不同，不能按公司所属行业选择级别。
-- 
-- 切换到 RC 还应核对 binlog：InnoDB 的 RC 变更只支持行格式；MIXED 会为相应操作自动用 ROW。这个限制不能证明“默认 RR 只因为历史 statement binlog”这一完整历史因果。默认值是产品行为，实际全局、会话、连接池和事务管理器配置可能不同，必须检查实际连接。
-- 
-- ## 三种现象，三个独立时间线
-- 
-- **脏读：** 初始余额 100，A 改成 50 未提交；B 在 RU 读到 50；A 回滚。B 读到的 50 从未成为提交事实。
-- 
-- **不可重复读：** 初始余额 100，A 在 RC 读到 100；B 改成 80 并提交；A 再读同一主键得到 80。两次都读已提交值，变化发生在同一条记录。
-- 
-- **幻读：** A 在 RC 查询 status='OPEN' 得到 ID={1,2}；B 插入符合条件的 ID=3 并提交；A 重复谓词得到 {1,2,3}。这里关注谓词集合的成员变化。新增/删除行，或更新使已有行进入/离开谓词，都要按结果集合分析；单纯数行数还可能漏掉“数量相同、成员已换”的变化。
-- 
-- 若题目只说“三道 SQL，分析事务结果”或“给了两个事务，各隔离级别结果是什么”，却没有语句、DDL、初始数据、交错顺序、提交点和读类型，就没有唯一答案。应补齐这些输入后逐步推导，不能凭隔离级别名称制造输出。“索引相关问题”没有具体 SQL 时，也不能推算确切锁范围。
-- 
-- ## 双会话练习的共同约定
-- 
-- 下面所有结果都是 MySQL 8.4.0/InnoDB 语义下的预期，不包含真实数据库执行结果。使用已有授权的隔离练习实例，开两个独立连接 A、B。不要把整章 SQL 一次性粘到一个窗口；按每段标明的会话和编号执行，看到当前语句返回后才越过对应关卡。
-- 
-- 确定性来自显式顺序和数据库等待证据，不使用 SLEEP 猜测调度。每组结束后 A、B 都 ROLLBACK，并确认上一条阻塞语句已返回，然后才由 A 重置。若碰到超时、死锁或与预期不同的错误，该轮停止，两边回滚，重新初始化后再做；不能沿用半轮状态。

-- SQL 段开始
SELECT r.PROCESSLIST_ID AS waiting_connection,
       b.PROCESSLIST_ID AS blocking_connection,
       l.OBJECT_SCHEMA, l.OBJECT_NAME, l.INDEX_NAME,
       l.LOCK_TYPE, l.LOCK_MODE, l.LOCK_STATUS, l.LOCK_DATA
FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits AS w
JOIN performance_schema.threads AS r ON r.THREAD_ID=w.REQUESTING_THREAD_ID
JOIN performance_schema.threads AS b ON b.THREAD_ID=w.BLOCKING_THREAD_ID
JOIN performance_schema.data_locks AS l
  ON l.ENGINE=w.ENGINE AND l.ENGINE_LOCK_ID=w.REQUESTING_ENGINE_LOCK_ID
WHERE l.OBJECT_SCHEMA='mysql_txn_learning';

-- SQL 段开始
-- B2：确认 A2 已返回。
SELECT balance FROM s2_balance WHERE id=1; -- 预期 100
ROLLBACK;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 独立重置后，把 B1 改为 READ COMMITTED，普通读应得到 100；它读的是可见已提交版本，不需要读 A 的未提交 50 来避免等待。
-- 
-- ### 1B：余额 100→80→提交
-- 
-- 两边回滚后，A 再重置 balance=100 并 COMMIT。按 A1→B1→A2：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A1
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT balance FROM s2_balance WHERE id=1; -- 100
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B1
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
START TRANSACTION;
UPDATE s2_balance SET balance=80 WHERE id=1;
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A2：B1 的 COMMIT 已返回。
SELECT balance FROM s2_balance WHERE id=1; -- RC 预期 80
ROLLBACK;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 独立重置 100 后，只把 A 的级别改为 RR，相同时序的 A2 预期仍为 100。这不等于所有形式的读取都得到 100。
-- 
-- ## 练习二：相同谓词的结果集
-- 
-- 两边回滚后，由 A 重置：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
DELETE FROM s2_open;
INSERT INTO s2_open VALUES (1,'OPEN'),(2,'OPEN');
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 按 A1→B1→A2：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A1
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT id FROM s2_open WHERE status='OPEN' ORDER BY id; -- 1,2
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B1
START TRANSACTION;
INSERT INTO s2_open VALUES (3,'OPEN');
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A2
SELECT id FROM s2_open WHERE status='OPEN' ORDER BY id; -- RC 预期 1,2,3
ROLLBACK;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 重新清理到只有 ID 1、2，并将 A 改成 RR 后重复，A2 预期还是 1、2。B 插入能正常完成，说明普通 RR 快照读并没有靠锁住所有间隙来阻止插入；它只是不把新行纳入旧视图。
-- 
-- ## S2-A：同一事务的两个“现在”
-- 
-- 库存初值严格重置为 10、version=0。两次成功扣 1 后应为 8；这与余额 100→80 的练习互不混用。
-- 
-- A、B 都结束前一事务后，由 A 执行：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
UPDATE s2_stock SET available=10,version=0 WHERE sku=1;
COMMIT;
SELECT sku,available,version FROM s2_stock WHERE sku=1; -- (1,10,0)
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 按 A1→B1→A2：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A1：这一次普通读建立 RR 视图。
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT available,version FROM s2_stock WHERE sku=1; -- (10,0)
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B1
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
UPDATE s2_stock SET available=9,version=version+1 WHERE sku=1;
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A2：先确认 B 的 COMMIT 返回。
SELECT available,version FROM s2_stock WHERE sku=1; -- (10,0)
SELECT available,version FROM s2_stock WHERE sku=1 FOR UPDATE; -- (9,1)
SELECT available,version FROM s2_stock WHERE sku=1; -- 仍 (10,0)，本事务尚未写
ROLLBACK;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 把 A 改成 RC、重新重置 10 后重复，A2 的普通读也应得到 (9,1)。当前加锁读并没有“刷新”RR 后续一致性读的旧视图；它本来就是另一种读取契约。
-- 
-- ### BEGIN 与首次读之间的提交
-- 
-- 独立重置 (1,10,0) 后，只执行下面顺序：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A1：不要在这里读 s2_stock。
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B1
START TRANSACTION;
UPDATE s2_stock SET available=9,version=1 WHERE sku=1;
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A2：第一次普通一致性读发生在 B 提交之后。
SELECT available FROM s2_stock WHERE sku=1; -- 预期 9
ROLLBACK;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 若独立重置后将 A1 改为 START TRANSACTION WITH CONSISTENT SNAPSHOT，且仍为 RR，则 A2 预期 10。要变更的只有快照建立时点，不能沿用前一轮的 9。
-- 
-- ## S2-B：检查和修改放错位置，写锁也救不了
-- 
-- ### 错误方案：两人都把 10-1 算成常量 9
-- 
-- 两会话回滚后，由 A 重置：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
UPDATE s2_stock SET available=10,version=0 WHERE sku=1;
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 先完成 A1 与 B1，再执行 A2，最后执行 B2：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A1
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT available INTO @a_seen FROM s2_stock WHERE sku=1; -- 10
SET @a_next=@a_seen-1; -- 模拟 Java 中基于读值计算的 9
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B1：必须在 A2 之前完成读取。
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT available INTO @b_seen FROM s2_stock WHERE sku=1; -- 10
SET @b_next=@b_seen-1; -- 9
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A2
UPDATE s2_stock SET available=@a_next,version=version+1 WHERE sku=1;
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B2：A2 已提交，但 B 仍使用先前算出的常量。
UPDATE s2_stock SET available=@b_next,version=version+1 WHERE sku=1;
COMMIT;
SELECT available,version FROM s2_stock WHERE sku=1; -- 预期 (9,2)
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 两个成功路径各认为预留了一份，库存却只少一份。写锁让写入先后执行，没有修正第二个请求携带的过时常量。这是丢失更新式的业务错误；初值只有 1 时，同型先查后写可能让两笔订单都以为拿到最后一份。
-- 
-- ### 正确的单行约束：把条件与算术放在数据库里
-- 
-- 两边回滚，A 重置 (1,10,0)。按 A1→B1→等待证据→A2→B2：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A1：UPDATE 返回后先不提交。
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
UPDATE s2_stock
SET available=available-1,version=version+1
WHERE sku=1 AND available>=1;
SELECT ROW_COUNT() AS a_changed; -- 预期 1
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B1：只提交这条 UPDATE 到服务器，然后停在等待中。
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
UPDATE s2_stock
SET available=available-1,version=version+1
WHERE sku=1 AND available>=1;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 此时在 A 执行共同约定中的等待观察 SQL。看到 B 等待 A 的 s2_stock 锁之后，A 才执行：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A2
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 等 B1 的 UPDATE 返回，B 紧接着执行，ROW_COUNT 之前不要夹任何其他语句：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B2
SELECT ROW_COUNT() AS b_changed; -- 初值 10 时预期 1
COMMIT;
SELECT available,version FROM s2_stock WHERE sku=1; -- 预期 (8,2)
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 同一 SQL 会在写入所需锁定下判断条件和修改行。重新结束事务并把 available=1、version=0，按完全相同关卡执行，A 成功 1 行，B 等待后影响 0 行，最终 (0,1)。改为 RC 也应保持这一单行条件约束。
-- 

-- 这只证明库存条件，并未实现请求幂等。同一逻辑请求超时重试，换一轮再扣仍可能成功。完整业务还需要稳定请求键、同键同参数校验，以及请求记录与扣减同事务；不能把“影响 0 行”统称为重复成功。0 行也可能是 SKU 不存在、库存不足、版本冲突或其他谓词未满足。
-- 
-- ### 乐观版本条件的边界
-- 
-- 若确实要检测从读取后发生的相关变化，可使用业务 version：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- 示例前提：quantity=1，预期 version=7，数据库当前库存=1、version=7。
UPDATE s2_stock
SET available=available-1,version=version+1
WHERE sku=1 AND version=7 AND available>=1;
SELECT ROW_COUNT();
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 独立测试前应由 A 在两边回滚后重置 available=1、version=7。两次使用这个条件的竞争预期仅一次影响 1 行，最终库存 0、version=8。版本条件是应用协议，所有相关写必须维护它，递增还要考虑数值上界。失败后重新读取、重新判断整个业务，不能只替换版本号继续用旧决策；旧 RR 快照中盲目重读可能永远读到旧版本。
-- 
-- quantity 必须大于 0。若把 -1 带进 available>=quantity 与 available=available-quantity，“扣库存”反而会加库存。接口层校验正数量，金额和数量范围也要受控；不要等数据库整数溢出才发现契约有洞。
-- 
-- ## S2-C：不同的行都更新成功，整体却错了
-- 
-- ### 两台备用设备：至少留一台待命
-- 
-- 两会话回滚后由 A 重置：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
UPDATE s2_device SET on_standby=1 WHERE slot_id=1;
UPDATE s2_shift SET remaining=2 WHERE slot_id=1;
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 先完成 A1、B1，再做 A2、B2：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A1
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT SUM(on_standby) INTO @a_count FROM s2_device WHERE slot_id=1; -- 2
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B1：在 A2 前完成。
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT SUM(on_standby) INTO @b_count FROM s2_device WHERE slot_id=1; -- 2
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A2：使用自己读到的决策。
UPDATE s2_device SET on_standby=0
WHERE slot_id=1 AND id=1 AND on_standby=1 AND @a_count>1;
SELECT ROW_COUNT(); -- 1
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B2：更新另一行，不会因 A 已经改第一行而自动失败。
UPDATE s2_device SET on_standby=0
WHERE slot_id=1 AND id=2 AND on_standby=1 AND @b_count>1;
SELECT ROW_COUNT(); -- 1
COMMIT;
SELECT SUM(on_standby) FROM s2_device WHERE slot_id=1; -- 预期 0，违反约束
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 两条单行条件都成立，却没有保护“至少一台”的跨行不变量。每行的 CHECK 只能保证 0/1，也不能替你断言 SUM>=1。改成 RC 后，如果两人仍先读到 2 再分别修改，同样可能失败。
-- 
-- ### 怎样证明这是写偏差
-- 
-- 把设备换成医生：doctor(id,on_call) 的两行最初都是 1。A 读到两人在岗后把医生 1 改成 0；B 也读到两人在岗后把医生 2 改成 0。写集合不相交，但读集合与对方写集合有交叉。
-- 
-- 若按 A→B 串行执行，B 应读到只剩一人并拒绝下班；B→A 也一样。两人都下班不等价于任何遵守此业务逻辑的串行顺序。这就是为什么“RR 普通读没有看到后来新增行”仍不等于“RR 已经可串行化”。
-- 
-- ### 修复方案一：预先存在的守卫行
-- 
-- 每个时段有一行稳定的 s2_shift，所有新增、停用、删除和管理后台写路径先锁它。守卫行不存在时应拒绝或按另外定义的创建协议处理，不能“查不到就当没锁也继续”。
-- 
-- 两边回滚后重新把设备都置 1、remaining=2。按 A1→B1 等待→A2→B2：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A1：获得共同冲突点，并读取当前候选集合。
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT slot_id FROM s2_shift WHERE slot_id=1 FOR UPDATE;
SELECT on_standby INTO @a_one FROM s2_device WHERE slot_id=1 AND id=1 FOR UPDATE;
SELECT on_standby INTO @a_two FROM s2_device WHERE slot_id=1 AND id=2 FOR UPDATE;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B1：只执行到守卫行锁；这里应等待 A。
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT slot_id FROM s2_shift WHERE slot_id=1 FOR UPDATE;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- A 通过等待观察 SQL 确认 B 等待自己的 s2_shift 锁，然后：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A2：示例固定两台设备，停用自己的设备。
UPDATE s2_device SET on_standby=0
WHERE slot_id=1 AND id=1 AND on_standby=1 AND (@a_one+@a_two)>1;
SELECT ROW_COUNT(); -- 1
UPDATE s2_shift SET remaining=1 WHERE slot_id=1;
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- B 的守卫锁返回后，必须用当前读重新判断，不能沿用任何早先普通快照：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B2
SELECT on_standby INTO @b_one FROM s2_device WHERE slot_id=1 AND id=1 FOR UPDATE;
SELECT on_standby INTO @b_two FROM s2_device WHERE slot_id=1 AND id=2 FOR UPDATE;
UPDATE s2_device SET on_standby=0
WHERE slot_id=1 AND id=2 AND on_standby=1 AND (@b_one+@b_two)>1;
SELECT ROW_COUNT(); -- 预期 0，剩余待命数为 1
ROLLBACK;
SELECT id,on_standby FROM s2_device WHERE slot_id=1 ORDER BY id; -- (1,0),(2,1)
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 示例中的 remaining 仅随成功路径维护。一般化实现必须同时维护计数、设备存在性和所有状态转换，不应把固定写 remaining=1 推广到任意数量。按固定顺序锁全部候选也能保护已知集合，但动态新增候选还涉及范围或守卫协议，不能只锁两条现有记录便宣称保护任意集合。
-- 
-- ### 修复方案二：把不变量集中到一行条件更新
-- 
-- 若业务允许汇总维护，所有停用先原子减少 remaining，成功才在同一事务修改对应设备。两边回滚后重置设备全为 1、remaining=2：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A1：先不提交。
START TRANSACTION;
UPDATE s2_shift SET remaining=remaining-1 WHERE slot_id=1 AND remaining>1;
SET @a_allowed=ROW_COUNT();
UPDATE s2_device SET on_standby=0
WHERE slot_id=1 AND id=1 AND on_standby=1 AND @a_allowed=1;
SELECT ROW_COUNT() AS a_device_changed; -- 预期 1
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B1：应在 s2_shift 上等待 A。
START TRANSACTION;
UPDATE s2_shift SET remaining=remaining-1 WHERE slot_id=1 AND remaining>1;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- A 确认等待边后 COMMIT；B 的 UPDATE 返回后紧接着执行：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B2
SET @b_allowed=ROW_COUNT(); -- 预期 0
UPDATE s2_device SET on_standby=0
WHERE slot_id=1 AND id=2 AND on_standby=1 AND @b_allowed=1;
SELECT ROW_COUNT() AS b_device_changed; -- 0
COMMIT;
SELECT remaining FROM s2_shift WHERE slot_id=1; -- 1
SELECT SUM(on_standby) FROM s2_device WHERE slot_id=1; -- 1
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 完整业务中，如果汇总扣减成功、设备更新却不是恰好 1 行，必须回滚整个事务；不能提交减了计数却没停设备的半段状态。汇总行成为热点，新增/恢复设备、取消请求、重复请求都要遵循同一守恒协议。它将跨行不变量化成共同冲突点，交换的是并发度和维护成本。
-- 
-- ## SERIALIZABLE 如何处理两医生下班
-- 
-- 这里只研究同库、两位现有医生，显式关闭 autocommit，确保普通读处于多语句事务。需要实例已开启死锁检测；若关闭，可能表现为超时，应先回滚并恢复实验条件，不能声称必然立即报告死锁。
-- 
-- 两边回滚并 SET autocommit=1 后，由 A 重置：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
UPDATE doctor SET on_call=1;
COMMIT;
SELECT @@global.innodb_deadlock_detect;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 按 A1→B1→A2 等待→B2：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A1
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;
SET autocommit=0;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT id,on_call FROM doctor ORDER BY id; -- 1、2 都在岗，读操作持共享锁
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B1
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;
SET autocommit=0;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT id,on_call FROM doctor ORDER BY id; -- 共享锁兼容，仍可读两人在岗
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A2：单独发送此句，等待 B 的共享锁。
UPDATE doctor SET on_call=0 WHERE id=1;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- B 运行等待观察 SQL，确认 A 正在等待 B 的 doctor 锁。然后 B 执行：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B2：需要升级另一记录的锁，形成等待环。
UPDATE doctor SET on_call=0 WHERE id=2;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 不要预设牺牲哪一个事务。死锁检测应使一个事务报错并整笔回滚；另一个 UPDATE 得以继续。在成功返回的那一侧执行：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
COMMIT;
SET autocommit=1;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 错误侧执行：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
ROLLBACK;
SET autocommit=1;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 确认两边都完成上述结束动作后，任意一侧在新的事务边界下查询：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
SELECT id,on_call FROM doctor ORDER BY id;
SELECT SUM(on_call) AS remaining_doctors FROM doctor; -- 预期 1
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 不能提前查询尚未提交的另一侧结果，或把谁成为受害者写成固定答案。
-- 
-- 失败侧若重试，应从完整业务判断重新开始：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;
SET autocommit=0;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT id,on_call FROM doctor ORDER BY id; -- 只剩一人在岗
-- 业务判断人数不大于 1，拒绝再下班；不执行 UPDATE。
ROLLBACK;
SET autocommit=1;
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 这说明更强隔离可以把原本无写写冲突的错误历史变成等待或失败；它没有替应用写出“人数不大于 1 就拒绝”的规则，也没有保证每次调用都成功。若错误后只重放 UPDATE，不再判断人数，依旧会破坏业务约束。
-- 
-- ## RR 里“突然多一行”的两个精确条件
-- 
-- ### 条件一：从普通读换成当前加锁读
-- 
-- 两会话回滚，A 重置：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
DELETE FROM p;
INSERT INTO p VALUES (1,10,'old');
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 按 A1→B1→A2：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A1
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT id,score,note FROM p WHERE score=15; -- 空，建立视图
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B1
START TRANSACTION;
INSERT INTO p VALUES (2,15,'new');
COMMIT;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A2
SELECT id,score,note FROM p WHERE score=15; -- 仍空
SELECT id,score,note FROM p WHERE score=15 FOR UPDATE; -- (2,15,'new')
SELECT id,score,note FROM p WHERE score=15; -- 仍空
ROLLBACK;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 这是两种读契约的差异，不是同一个 Read View 被 B 随意改写。A 最初没有锁住相应间隙，B 才能先完成插入。
-- 
-- ### 条件二：自己修改了旧视图看不到的新行
-- 
-- 重新把 p 清理到只有 (1,10,'old')，A、B 重复上面 A1、B1；这次 A2 改为：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A2：当前 UPDATE 能面对 B 刚提交的行。
UPDATE p SET note='changed' WHERE score=15;
SELECT ROW_COUNT(); -- 预期 1
SELECT id,score,note FROM p WHERE score=15; -- (2,15,'changed')
ROLLBACK;
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- 自己修改可见，因此普通 SELECT 可以出现行 2；不能把该结果描述为“RR 不使用 MVCC”。自己的写与其他行旧版本混合，还可能产生从未整体存在过的组合。
-- 
-- ### 范围锁为什么是另一条路
-- 
-- 再独立重置 p，A 一开始就加锁：
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- A1
SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
START TRANSACTION;
SELECT id FROM p FORCE INDEX(ix_score) WHERE score=15 FOR UPDATE; -- 空结果
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- SQL 段开始
-- B1：在相关间隙保护下等待，先只执行 INSERT。
START TRANSACTION;
INSERT INTO p VALUES (2,15,'new');
-- SQL 段结束
-- 
-- A 用等待观察 SQL 确认 p 上的等待边，再 ROLLBACK。B 的 INSERT 返回后也 ROLLBACK，避免给下一轮留下行。空结果仍能保护索引间隙；锁范围依访问路径而定，不能由“返回 0 行”推出“没有锁”。本例强制 ix_score 使观察路径明确，这不是生产优化器建议。
-- 
-- 唯一键完整等值命中已有记录、缺失键、联合唯一键仅匹配部分列、非唯一范围查询的锁范围不同。所谓“临键锁”通常指 next-key lock，即记录及其前方间隙的组合；不能把 S/X 兼容模式、IS/IX 意向锁、元数据锁和内部 mutex 都列成一个平行分类。内部 mutex/latch 保护引擎短临界区，事务锁则服务较长的业务并发协议。
-- 
-- ## 从单行正确到高并发业务
-- 
-- 同一 SKU 的条件更新最终竞争同一记录。增加线程或连接通常只能增加排队，不能把这个串行冲突点变成无限并行。先测持锁时间、事务内 SQL、日志 I/O 和队列年龄，去掉持锁期间的网络调用，减少无效扫描，给热点请求设置有界在途数量。
-- 
-- 需要扩展时，可以按业务授权把有限库存预分到桶，例如总共 100 份分成 4 个各 25 份的桶，而不是每个桶复制 100。所有配额、预留和释放必须守恒，调拨还要处理旧所有者和旧轮次。合并更新也必须保留逐请求结果与幂等身份；只剩一个总差值，无法解释哪笔订单成功。MySQL 是库存权威还是仅作可靠事件的异步投影，是两种不同契约。
-- 
-- 缓存和队列能平滑流量，但数据库预留尚未提交时，“已受理”不能等同于“已买到”。支付与取消、库存释放、重复通知属于更完整的状态机，不能从本章一条 UPDATE 的成功推出端到端只生效一次。
-- 
-- ## 最后用不变量验收，而不是只看 SQL 成功
-- 
-- 建议在同一基线上逐项观察以下预期：
-- 
-- - 同一 SKU 两次扣 1：初值 10 最终 8；初值 1 只一次成功、最终 0；初值 0 两次均 0 行。
-- - 不同 SKU：另插入 (2,10,0) 后，各自按主键扣减，不应仅因业务使用同一张表就被全局串行化；额外索引、外键或其他共享资源仍要另查。
-- - 非正数量：应用拒绝，不能进入扣减 SQL。
-- - 中途异常：成功扣减后未完成必要后续写就回滚，库存恢复；提交后响应丢失则走结果查询，不能盲重扣。
-- - 重复逻辑请求：只有稳定身份与同事务去重记录才能检验此契约；本章单行条件更新本身不提供它。
-- - 两设备或两医生：失败方案可能得到 0；守卫、汇总或正确 Serializable 重试应保持至少 1。
-- - 长事务：跟踪事务年龄、历史保留和空间趋势；低 CPU 不代表没有成本。
-- 
-- **库存先查后改为什么仍可能超卖？条件更新保护单行后，能否自动保护跨行约束？** 检查与修改若分离，会基于过时状态作决定；同一行条件更新只能保护该行表达的条件。跨行约束必须让竞争者在共同受保护的决策点相遇。
-- 
-- **RR 有 MVCC 和间隙锁，为什么仍可能需要 Serializable？** 普通快照读未自动锁住决策集合，非相交写集合仍可能形成写偏差。更强隔离是选择之一，守卫和集中约束也是；它们都需要完整失败处理。

import java.util.*;
public final class ArchitectureTest {
 private static int checks;
 private static void check(boolean ok,String what){checks++;if(!ok)throw new AssertionError(what);}
 private static List<EqualityJoin.Pair> oracle(List<EqualityJoin.Row> left,List<EqualityJoin.Row> right,boolean outer){
  List<EqualityJoin.Pair> out=new ArrayList<>();
  for(var l:left){boolean found=false;for(var r:right)if(l.key()!=null&&r.key()!=null&&l.key().equals(r.key())){out.add(new EqualityJoin.Pair(l,r));found=true;}
   if(outer&&!found)out.add(new EqualityJoin.Pair(l,null));}
  return out;
 }
 public static void main(String[]args){
  Random random=new Random(682104);int rows=0;
  for(int i=0;i<5000;i++){
   List<EqualityJoin.Row> l=new ArrayList<>(),r=new ArrayList<>();
   for(int j=0;j<random.nextInt(12);j++)l.add(new EqualityJoin.Row(j,random.nextInt(4)==0?null:random.nextInt(4),"L"+j));
   for(int j=0;j<random.nextInt(12);j++)r.add(new EqualityJoin.Row(j,random.nextInt(4)==0?null:random.nextInt(4),"R"+j));
   for(boolean outer:new boolean[]{false,true}){var expected=oracle(l,r,outer);var got=EqualityJoin.join(l,r,outer);check(got.equals(expected),"bag join");rows+=got.size();}
  }
  var two=List.of(new EqualityJoin.Row(1,7,"a"),new EqualityJoin.Row(2,7,"b"));
  var three=List.of(new EqualityJoin.Row(3,7,"c"),new EqualityJoin.Row(4,7,"d"),new EqualityJoin.Row(5,7,"e"));
  check(EqualityJoin.join(two,three,false).size()==6,"2x3 multiplicity");
  var nil=List.of(new EqualityJoin.Row(7,null,"x"));
  check(EqualityJoin.join(nil,nil,false).isEmpty(),"SQL NULL not equality");
  check(EqualityJoin.join(nil,nil,true).getFirst().right()==null,"left null extension");
  int[] owners=new int[16];for(int i=0;i<16;i++)owners[i]=i;
  ShardRouting original=new ShardRouting(owners);owners[0]=999;
  ShardRouting moved=original.movedBucket(3,99);Set<Integer> buckets=new HashSet<>();
  for(long i=0;i<16000;i++){
   long id=i*16;int bucket=original.bucket(id);buckets.add(bucket);check(Math.floorMod(id,16)==0,"raw low bits skew");
   check(moved.owner(id)==(bucket==3?99:bucket),"only chosen bucket owner changes");
   check(original.owner(id)==bucket,"immutable original owner map");
  }
  check(buckets.size()==16,"fixed sample mixed coverage");
  for(long id:new long[]{Long.MIN_VALUE,Long.MAX_VALUE,-1,0,1})check(original.bucket(id)>=0&&original.bucket(id)<16,"signed hash range");
  for(int i=0;i<1000;i++)check(original.bucket(7)==original.bucket(7),"one hot key remains one bucket");
  RoutingDemo.main(args);
  System.out.println("PASS ArchitectureTest checks="+checks+", joined rows compared="+rows+"; pure algorithms only");
 }
}

import java.lang.reflect.Proxy;
import java.sql.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Fault-injected JDBC interface model, not an InnoDB or Connector/J execution. */
public final class JdbcBoundaryTest {
    private static Object empty(Class<?> type) {
        if(type==boolean.class)return false;
        if(type==int.class)return 0;
        if(type==long.class)return 0L;
        return null;
    }
    private static ResultSet rows(long... values) {
        int[] i={-1};
        return (ResultSet)Proxy.newProxyInstance(JdbcBoundaryTest.class.getClassLoader(),new Class<?>[]{ResultSet.class},(p,m,a)->switch(m.getName()) {
            case "next" -> ++i[0]<values.length;
            case "getLong" -> values[i[0]];
            default -> empty(m.getReturnType());
        });
    }
    private static final class Faults {
        final List<String> calls=new ArrayList<>();
        boolean rollbackFails, commitUnknown, resetFails, closeFails;
        SQLException commitError=new SQLException("commit UNKNOWN","08007");
        SQLException rollbackError=new SQLException("rollback failed","08006");
        SQLException resetError=new SQLException("reset failed","08006");
        SQLException closeError=new SQLException("close failed");
        Connection connection() {
            return (Connection)Proxy.newProxyInstance(JdbcBoundaryTest.class.getClassLoader(),new Class<?>[]{Connection.class},(p,m,a)->{
                switch(m.getName()) {
                    case "getAutoCommit":return true;
                    case "setAutoCommit":
                        calls.add("auto="+a[0]);
                        if((Boolean)a[0]&&resetFails)throw resetError;
                        return null;
                    case "commit":
                        calls.add("commit");
                        if(commitUnknown)throw commitError;
                        return null;
                    case "rollback":
                        calls.add("rollback");
                        if(rollbackFails)throw rollbackError;
                        return null;
                    case "close":calls.add("close");if(closeFails)throw closeError;return null;
                    case "prepareStatement":
                        String sql=(String)a[0];
                        return Proxy.newProxyInstance(JdbcBoundaryTest.class.getClassLoader(),new Class<?>[]{PreparedStatement.class},(p2,m2,a2)->{
                            if(m2.getName().equals("executeQuery"))return sql.contains("entry_id")?rows(11,12):rows(1);
                            if(m2.getName().equals("executeUpdate"))return 1;
                            if(m2.getName().equals("executeBatch"))return new int[]{1,1};
                            return empty(m2.getReturnType());
                        });
                    default:return empty(m.getReturnType());
                }
            });
        }
    }
    @FunctionalInterface private interface SqlAction { void run() throws Exception; }
    private static void expectSame(SQLException wanted,SqlAction action) throws Exception {
        try {action.run();throw new AssertionError("missing failure");}
        catch(SQLException actual) {if(actual!=wanted)throw new AssertionError("original exception lost",actual);}
    }
    /** Deliberately narrow JDBC surface model, not a database or a transaction simulator. */
    private static final class AliasDriver implements Driver {
        final SQLException shared=new SQLException("shared COMMIT UNKNOWN","08007");
        int commits,rollbacks,closes;
        boolean closeAliases,closeDifferent;
        boolean commitFails=true;
        final SQLException closeError=new SQLException("distinct connection close failure","08006");
        public boolean acceptsURL(String url) {return url!=null&&url.startsWith("jdbc:boundary-test:");}
        public Connection connect(String url,Properties properties) {
            if(!acceptsURL(url))return null;
            return (Connection)Proxy.newProxyInstance(getClass().getClassLoader(),new Class<?>[]{Connection.class},(p,m,args)->{
                switch(m.getName()) {
                    case "commit":commits++;if(commitFails)throw shared;return null;
                    case "rollback":rollbacks++;throw shared;
                    case "close":closes++;if(closeAliases)throw shared;if(closeDifferent)throw closeError;return null;
                    case "prepareStatement":
                        String sql=(String)args[0];
                        return Proxy.newProxyInstance(getClass().getClassLoader(),new Class<?>[]{PreparedStatement.class},(p2,m2,a2)->{
                            if(m2.getName().equals("executeUpdate"))return 1;
                            if(m2.getName().equals("executeQuery")) {
                                if(sql.startsWith("SELECT version"))return rows(0);
                                if(sql.startsWith("SELECT id FROM board_task"))return rows(1,2);
                                if(sql.startsWith("SELECT state")||sql.startsWith("SELECT MAX")) {
                                    boolean[] first={true};
                                    return Proxy.newProxyInstance(getClass().getClassLoader(),new Class<?>[]{ResultSet.class},(p3,m3,a3)->switch(m3.getName()) {
                                        case "next" -> {boolean value=first[0];first[0]=false;yield value;}
                                        case "getString" -> (Integer)a3[0]==1?"OPEN":null;
                                        case "getObject" -> null;
                                        case "getLong" -> 1L;
                                        default -> empty(m3.getReturnType());
                                    });
                                }
                                return rows();
                            }
                            return empty(m2.getReturnType());
                        });
                    default:return empty(m.getReturnType());
                }
            });
        }
        public DriverPropertyInfo[] getPropertyInfo(String url,Properties properties) {return new DriverPropertyInfo[0];}
        public int getMajorVersion() {return 1;}
        public int getMinorVersion() {return 0;}
        public boolean jdbcCompliant() {return false;}
        public java.util.logging.Logger getParentLogger() {return java.util.logging.Logger.getGlobal();}
    }
    private static void transactionCall(int operation) throws Exception {
        switch(operation) {
            case 0 -> StreamLedger.append("jdbc:boundary-test:stream",1,1,1,0,"中😀",false);
            case 1 -> StreamLedger.end("jdbc:boundary-test:stream",1,1,1,0);
            case 2 -> TaskBoard.reorder("jdbc:boundary-test:task",1,1,0,List.of(2L,1L),false);
            case 3 -> TaskBoard.depend("jdbc:boundary-test:task",1,1,0,1,2,false);
            default -> throw new AssertionError(operation);
        }
    }
    private static void aliases() throws Exception {
        Faults pr=new Faults();pr.commitUnknown=true;pr.resetFails=true;pr.resetError=pr.commitError;
        expectSame(pr.commitError,()->PlaylistOrder.reorder(pr.connection(),1,0,0,List.of(12L,11L),false));
        if(pr.commitError.getSuppressed().length!=0||!pr.calls.contains("close"))throw new AssertionError(pr.calls);
        Faults rc=new Faults();rc.resetFails=true;rc.closeFails=true;rc.closeError=rc.resetError;
        expectSame(rc.resetError,()->PlaylistOrder.reorder(rc.connection(),1,0,0,List.of(12L,11L),false));
        if(rc.resetError.getSuppressed().length!=0||!rc.calls.contains("close"))throw new AssertionError(rc.calls);
        Faults pb=new Faults();pb.commitUnknown=true;pb.rollbackFails=true;pb.rollbackError=pb.commitError;
        expectSame(pb.commitError,()->PlaylistOrder.reorder(pb.connection(),1,0,0,List.of(12L,11L),false));
        if(pb.commitError.getSuppressed().length!=0||pb.calls.contains("auto=true")||!pb.calls.contains("close"))throw new AssertionError(pb.calls);
        Faults pc=new Faults();pc.commitUnknown=true;pc.rollbackFails=true;pc.closeFails=true;pc.closeError=pc.commitError;
        expectSame(pc.commitError,()->PlaylistOrder.reorder(pc.connection(),1,0,0,List.of(12L,11L),false));
        if(pc.commitError.getSuppressed().length!=1||pc.commitError.getSuppressed()[0]!=pc.rollbackError||pc.calls.contains("auto=true"))throw new AssertionError(pc.calls);
        System.out.println("PASS Playlist primary/reset, reset/close, primary/rollback and primary/close aliases");
        AliasDriver d=new AliasDriver();DriverManager.registerDriver(d);
        try {
            expectSame(d.shared,()->StreamLedger.append("jdbc:boundary-test:stream",1,1,1,0,"中😀",false));
            expectSame(d.shared,()->StreamLedger.end("jdbc:boundary-test:stream",1,1,1,0));
            expectSame(d.shared,()->TaskBoard.reorder("jdbc:boundary-test:task",1,1,0,List.of(2L,1L),false));
            expectSame(d.shared,()->TaskBoard.depend("jdbc:boundary-test:task",1,1,0,1,2,false));
            if(d.commits!=4||d.rollbacks!=4||d.closes!=4||d.shared.getSuppressed().length!=0)throw new AssertionError("driver fault path");
        } finally {DriverManager.deregisterDriver(d);}
        System.out.println("PASS both StreamLedger and both TaskBoard mutation paths preserve rollback aliases");
        AliasDriver closing=new AliasDriver();closing.closeAliases=true;DriverManager.registerDriver(closing);
        try {
            expectSame(closing.shared,()->StreamLedger.append("jdbc:boundary-test:stream",1,1,1,0,"中😀",false));
            expectSame(closing.shared,()->StreamLedger.end("jdbc:boundary-test:stream",1,1,1,0));
            expectSame(closing.shared,()->TaskBoard.reorder("jdbc:boundary-test:task",1,1,0,List.of(2L,1L),false));
            expectSame(closing.shared,()->TaskBoard.depend("jdbc:boundary-test:task",1,1,0,1,2,false));
            if(closing.commits!=4||closing.rollbacks!=4||closing.closes!=4||closing.shared.getSuppressed().length!=0)throw new AssertionError("connection-close alias path");
        } finally {DriverManager.deregisterDriver(closing);}
        System.out.println("PASS all four self-owned transaction connections preserve commit/rollback/close aliases");
        for(int op=0;op<4;op++) {
            final int operation=op;
            AliasDriver distinct=new AliasDriver();distinct.closeDifferent=true;DriverManager.registerDriver(distinct);
            try {
                expectSame(distinct.shared,()->transactionCall(operation));
                if(distinct.commits!=1||distinct.rollbacks!=1||distinct.closes!=1||distinct.shared.getSuppressed().length!=1||distinct.shared.getSuppressed()[0]!=distinct.closeError)throw new AssertionError("distinct close must be suppressed");
            } finally {DriverManager.deregisterDriver(distinct);}
            AliasDriver committed=new AliasDriver();committed.commitFails=false;committed.closeDifferent=true;DriverManager.registerDriver(committed);
            try {
                expectSame(committed.closeError,()->transactionCall(operation));
                if(committed.commits!=1||committed.rollbacks!=0||committed.closes!=1)throw new AssertionError("known committed cleanup path");
            } finally {DriverManager.deregisterDriver(committed);}
        }
        System.out.println("PASS four UNKNOWN+distinct-close and four known-commit+close-failure controls");
        SQLException shared=new SQLException("shared prepare/close failure");
        Connection report=(Connection)Proxy.newProxyInstance(JdbcBoundaryTest.class.getClassLoader(),new Class<?>[]{Connection.class},(p,m,args)->{
            if(m.getName().equals("prepareStatement"))return Proxy.newProxyInstance(JdbcBoundaryTest.class.getClassLoader(),new Class<?>[]{PreparedStatement.class},(p2,m2,a2)->{
                if(m2.getName().equals("setLong")||m2.getName().equals("close"))throw shared;
                return empty(m2.getReturnType());
            });
            return empty(m.getReturnType());
        });
        expectSame(shared,()->ReportAggregate.javaAggregate(report,1,0,10,7));
        expectSame(shared,()->ReportAggregate.databaseAggregate(report,1,0,10,7));
        if(shared.getSuppressed().length!=0)throw new AssertionError("report self-suppression");
        System.out.println("PASS both ReportAggregate entry points preserve preparation/close alias");
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Faults rollback=new Faults();rollback.rollbackFails=true;
        try {PlaylistOrder.reorder(rollback.connection(),1,0,0,List.of(12L,11L),true);throw new AssertionError();}
        catch(SQLException e){if(!rollback.calls.contains("close")||rollback.calls.contains("auto=true")||e.getSuppressed().length!=1)throw new AssertionError(rollback.calls);}
        System.out.println("PASS rollback failure closes and never enables autoCommit: "+rollback.calls);
        Faults unknown=new Faults();unknown.commitUnknown=true;
        try {PlaylistOrder.reorder(unknown.connection(),1,0,0,List.of(12L,11L),false);throw new AssertionError();}
        catch(SQLException e){if(!e.getMessage().equals("commit UNKNOWN"))throw new AssertionError(e);}
        System.out.println("PASS unknown commit normally propagates: "+unknown.calls);
        Faults masked=new Faults();masked.commitUnknown=true;masked.resetFails=true;
        try {PlaylistOrder.reorder(masked.connection(),1,0,0,List.of(12L,11L),false);throw new AssertionError();}
        catch(SQLException e){
            if(!e.getMessage().equals("commit UNKNOWN")||e.getSuppressed().length!=1||!masked.calls.contains("close"))throw new AssertionError(e);
            System.out.println("PASS COMMIT UNKNOWN preserved and reset failure suppressed: "+masked.calls);
        }
        Faults cleanup=new Faults();cleanup.resetFails=true;cleanup.closeFails=true;
        try {PlaylistOrder.reorder(cleanup.connection(),1,0,0,List.of(12L,11L),false);throw new AssertionError();}
        catch(SQLException e){if(!e.getMessage().equals("reset failed")||e.getSuppressed().length!=1||!cleanup.calls.contains("commit")||!cleanup.calls.contains("close"))throw new AssertionError(e);}
        System.out.println("PASS successful commit with cleanup failure closes and preserves cleanup details");
        Faults business=new Faults();business.resetFails=true;
        try {PlaylistOrder.reorder(business.connection(),1,0,0,List.of(12L,11L),true);throw new AssertionError();}
        catch(SQLException e){if(!e.getMessage().equals("injected rollback test")||e.getSuppressed().length!=1||!business.calls.contains("close"))throw new AssertionError(e);}
        System.out.println("PASS business failure preserved after reset failure");
        aliases();
        System.out.println("JDBC interface fault model only; no MySQL or Connector/J integration executed");
    }
}

完整 B+ 树插入与查询实现

保存为 BPlusTree.java。

components/query/code/BPlusTree.java
import java.util.*;

/** Insert/update-only in-memory B+ tree model. No deletion, concurrency or disk pages. */
public final class BPlusTree {
    private static final class Node {
        final boolean leaf;
        final List<Integer> keys=new ArrayList<>();
        final List<String> values=new ArrayList<>();
        final List<Node> children=new ArrayList<>();
        Node next;
        Node(boolean leaf){this.leaf=leaf;}
    }
    private record Split(int separator,Node right){}
    public record Entry(int key,String value){}
    private final int maxKeys;
    private Node root=new Node(true);
    public BPlusTree(int maxKeys){
        if(maxKeys<3)throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxKeys >= 3");
        this.maxKeys=maxKeys;
    }
    private static int lower(List<Integer> keys,int key){
        int l=0,r=keys.size();
        while(l<r){int m=(l+r)>>>1;if(keys.get(m)<key)l=m+1;else r=m;}
        return l;
    }
    private static int upper(List<Integer> keys,int key){
        int l=0,r=keys.size();
        while(l<r){int m=(l+r)>>>1;if(keys.get(m)<=key)l=m+1;else r=m;}
        return l;
    }
    public void put(int key,String value){
        Objects.requireNonNull(value);
        Split s=insert(root,key,value);
        if(s!=null){Node parent=new Node(false);parent.keys.add(s.separator());
            parent.children.add(root);parent.children.add(s.right());root=parent;}
    }
    private Split insert(Node n,int key,String value){
        if(n.leaf){
            int p=lower(n.keys,key);
            if(p<n.keys.size() && n.keys.get(p)==key){n.values.set(p,value);return null;}
            n.keys.add(p,key);n.values.add(p,value);
            if(n.keys.size()<=maxKeys)return null;
            int mid=n.keys.size()/2;Node right=new Node(true);
            right.keys.addAll(n.keys.subList(mid,n.keys.size()));
            right.values.addAll(n.values.subList(mid,n.values.size()));
            n.keys.subList(mid,n.keys.size()).clear();n.values.subList(mid,n.values.size()).clear();
            right.next=n.next;n.next=right;
            return new Split(right.keys.get(0),right); // copy separator; keep leaf record
        }
        int p=upper(n.keys,key);Split child=insert(n.children.get(p),key,value);
        if(child==null)return null;
        n.keys.add(p,child.separator());n.children.add(p+1,child.right());
        if(n.keys.size()<=maxKeys)return null;
        int mid=n.keys.size()/2,promoted=n.keys.get(mid);Node right=new Node(false);
        right.keys.addAll(n.keys.subList(mid+1,n.keys.size()));
        right.children.addAll(n.children.subList(mid+1,n.children.size()));
        n.keys.subList(mid,n.keys.size()).clear();n.children.subList(mid+1,n.children.size()).clear();
        return new Split(promoted,right); // promoted separator removed from internal child
    }
    public String get(int key){
        Node n=root;while(!n.leaf)n=n.children.get(upper(n.keys,key));
        int p=lower(n.keys,key);return p<n.keys.size() && n.keys.get(p)==key?n.values.get(p):null;
    }
    /** Inclusive low, exclusive high; an inverted/empty interval returns empty. */
    public List<Entry> range(int low,int high){
        List<Entry> result=new ArrayList<>();if(low>=high)return result;
        Node n=root;while(!n.leaf)n=n.children.get(upper(n.keys,low));
        int p=lower(n.keys,low);
        while(n!=null){for(;p<n.keys.size();p++){
            int k=n.keys.get(p);if(k>=high)return result;result.add(new Entry(k,n.values.get(p)));
        }n=n.next;p=0;}
        return result;
    }
    public int height(){int h=1;Node n=root;while(!n.leaf){h++;n=n.children.get(0);}return h;}
    public void validate(){
        List<Node> leaves=new ArrayList<>();int[] depth={-1};validate(root,true,0,depth,leaves);
        for(int i=0;i<leaves.size();i++){
            Node expected=i+1<leaves.size()?leaves.get(i+1):null;
            require(leaves.get(i).next==expected,"leaf chain");
            if(expected!=null)require(leaves.get(i).keys.get(leaves.get(i).keys.size()-1)<expected.keys.get(0),"leaf order");
        }
    }
    private int validate(Node n,boolean isRoot,int d,int[] depth,List<Node> leaves){
        require(n.keys.size()<=maxKeys,"capacity");
        if(!isRoot)require(n.keys.size()>=(n.leaf?maxKeys/2+maxKeys%2:maxKeys/2),"occupancy");
        for(int i=1;i<n.keys.size();i++)require(n.keys.get(i-1)<n.keys.get(i),"key order");
        if(n.leaf){require(n.children.isEmpty() && n.values.size()==n.keys.size(),"leaf shape");
            if(depth[0]<0)depth[0]=d;require(depth[0]==d,"balanced leaf depth");leaves.add(n);
            return n.keys.isEmpty()?0:n.keys.get(0);
        }
        require(n.values.isEmpty() && n.children.size()==n.keys.size()+1 && !n.keys.isEmpty(),"internal shape");
        int min=validate(n.children.get(0),false,d+1,depth,leaves);
        for(int i=1;i<n.children.size();i++)require(n.keys.get(i-1)==validate(n.children.get(i),false,d+1,depth,leaves),"separator");
        return min;
    }
    private static void require(boolean b,String message){if(!b)throw new AssertionError(message);}
}

import java.util.*;
public final class BPlusTreeTest {
  private static int checks;
  static void check(boolean ok){checks++;if(!ok)throw new AssertionError("check "+checks);}
  static void invalid(Runnable r){try{r.run();throw new AssertionError("expected invalid");}catch(IllegalArgumentException expected){checks++;}}
  public static void main(String[] args){
    invalid(()->new BPlusTree(2));invalid(()->TreeHeight.estimate(-1,600,60));
    invalid(()->TreeHeight.estimate(1,1,60));invalid(()->TreeHeight.estimate(1,600,0));
    check(TreeHeight.estimate(10000000,600,60)==3);
    check(TreeHeight.estimate(10000000,600,12)==4);
    check(TreeHeight.estimate(0,600,60)==1);
    check(TreeHeight.estimate(Long.MAX_VALUE,2,1)==64);
    for(int max:new int[]{3,4,5,8,16,31}){
      BPlusTree t=new BPlusTree(max);TreeMap<Integer,String> oracle=new TreeMap<>();
      check(t.get(0)==null);check(t.range(0,0).isEmpty());check(t.height()==1);t.validate();
      Random random=new Random(20261010L+max);
      for(int i=0;i<10000;i++){
        int k=random.nextInt(6001)-3000;String v="v"+i;
        t.put(k,v);oracle.put(k,v);check(Objects.equals(t.get(k),v));
        if(i%23==0){
          t.validate();int lo=random.nextInt(6001)-3000,hi=random.nextInt(6001)-3000;
          List<BPlusTree.Entry> expected=new ArrayList<>();
          if(lo<hi)oracle.subMap(lo,true,hi,false).forEach((key,value)->expected.add(new BPlusTree.Entry(key,value)));
          check(t.range(lo,hi).equals(expected));
        }
      }
      t.put(Integer.MIN_VALUE,"min");t.put(Integer.MAX_VALUE,"max");t.validate();
      check(t.get(Integer.MIN_VALUE).equals("min"));check(t.get(Integer.MAX_VALUE).equals("max"));
      check(t.range(Integer.MAX_VALUE,Integer.MIN_VALUE).isEmpty());
      for(var e:oracle.entrySet())check(Objects.equals(t.get(e.getKey()),e.getValue()));
      try{t.put(0,null);throw new AssertionError("null accepted");}catch(NullPointerException expected){checks++;}
    }
    System.out.println("PASS BPlusTree/TreeHeight checks="+checks+", random insert/update operations=60000");
  }
}

本次整理的版本与验证边界

本批保留用户自有手册中的 MySQL Community Server 8.4.0、InnoDB、utf8mb4、JDK 21、Connector/J 8.4.0 以及各章单独声明的版本。SQL mode、时区、排序规则、autocommit、隔离级别、完整索引与会话交错都是结论前提。纯 Java、SQLite 或假连接测试不证明真实 MySQL 行为。

本次只完成资料转换与独立内容编译，未执行导入的 SQL、Java、Python、Shell、网络服务或数据库故障实验。源文中的运行命令、PASS 字符串和历史验证说明原样作为教材保留，不是本批运行结果。示例行数、QPS、延迟和容量是假设或原材料口径，不能改写成个人生产业绩。

MySQL与数据库系统设计面试手册

MySQL与数据库系统设计面试手册

MySQL 与数据库系统设计面试手册

MySQL 与数据库系统设计面试手册

数据库面试要讲清数据怎样组织、查询怎样执行，以及并发和故障时怎样守住业务不变量。索引、事务、锁、日志和复制最终都要回到一个具体问题：这次操作读到了什么、改了什么、何时算成功，失败后还能怎样确认和恢复。

回答时先给一句结论，再说成立条件和关键机制，最后用一条查询、两笔并发事务或一段故障时序说明取舍。设计题先明确数据规模、查询形态、一致性与恢复目标，再选择组件；调优题先保证结果相同，再比较资源和延迟。

阅读可分五步：先理解存储与关系模型，再推导索引和执行计划；随后练习事务、锁与恢复；最后把复制、分片和 Java 应用接成完整业务链路。每章列出同一知识点的常见问法，具体条件不同的追问分别展开。

练习环境与代码使用

练习环境与代码使用

除章节另有说明，MySQL 示例采用 MySQL Community Server 8.4.0、InnoDB、utf8mb4；Java 示例采用 JDK 21，JDBC 驱动目标为 Connector/J 8.4.0。版本、排序规则、SQL mode、时区和事务隔离级别都是实验前提，不能从示例推定某个实际项目的配置。

不同练习使用各自的空白 schema，只有明确列出的前置表才共享。带 ? 的 SQL 由 PreparedStatement 绑定，不直接粘贴进普通 SQL 控制台；双会话实验按给出的交错顺序执行。完整工程中的同名文件也按组件目录隔离，不能把所有 SQL 或 Java 文件无差别拼到一起。

纯 Java 算法、假连接故障模型和 SQLite 关系模型各验证自己的边界。实际 MySQL 的执行计划、锁范围、排序规则、复制、驱动行为和故障恢复，需要在对应隔离环境中进一步验证。各章给出完整实现、必要文件及运行前提，涉及网络服务的示例不应直接连接生产数据。

SQL 教学采用严格 SQL mode；每份独立脚本先选择新的空白实验库，可在 MySQL 客户端中使用 source 文件名.sql。具体教学值、字符排序规则与环境前提要逐项核对，不把脚本直接用于生产数据。关系模型使用 Python 3 标准库；MySQL 双会话结果是机制预期，须在目标版本按关卡验证，不能把整页 SQL 当作一次批处理。

这册可以怎样复习

这册可以怎样复习

先把索引、事务、锁和 MVCC 各讲出一条主线，再和 Redis、MQ、网络、操作系统交替复习。不要先把数据库所有细节读到底，才开始其他主干。

第一轮：索引和事务两条主线一起建立

  • 第02章 记录、页、缓存与物理 I/O → 第10章 索引结构、聚簇与覆盖 → 第11章 复合键、最左前缀、范围与 ICP → 第12章 LIKE、NULL、OR 与所谓索引失效 → 第14章 EXPLAIN、执行器与优化器选择
  • 第18章 事务契约：ACID、原子提交与业务一致性 → 第19章 MVCC：Read View、undo 与两种读取语义 → 第20章 隔离级别、幻读与写偏差：用两会话推导结果 → 第21章 事务锁 意向锁 MDL 与内部闩

先读各章的首答与关键推演：一次查询怎样定位、过滤、回表；一次事务怎样提交、选择可见版本和获取锁。MVCC与事务锁在这一轮就要能回答，Read View边界、完整锁范围和实验随后深化。

第二轮：沿慢查询和长事务各讲一个案例

  • 第13章 从真实查询分布推导索引 → 第15章 慢查询定位与有证据的改进 → 第16章 深分页、稳定排序与游标 → 第17章 大表索引变更、批量写入与容量
  • 第19章 MVCC：Read View、undo 与两种读取语义 → 第20章 隔离级别、幻读与写偏差：用两会话推导结果 → 第22章 实际访问路径决定锁范围 → 第23章 死锁检测 等待与完整事务重试
  • 第34章 JDBC、连接池与参数化 SQL → 第35章 Spring 事务、ORM 与代理边界 → 第36章 数据库、缓存、消息与外部动作

索引案例先固定过滤、排序、分页和结果语义，再比较计划、扫描、回表与写入代价；JOIN和聚合问题回到第06章。事务案例画出两个事务的读写和等待，再解释长事务如何占用连接、锁与历史版本。拆事务后继续追问消息或外部动作如何恢复，不能把失败窗口藏起来。

第三轮：验证崩溃、恢复和规模变化的边界

  • 第25章 三类日志、提交协议与持久化 → 第26章 崩溃恢复、备份与重放幂等
  • 第30章 CDC 快照增量合并与派生索引对账 → 第31章 分片动机 业务键与路由规则 → 第32章 扩容 重分片与不停服迁移 → 第33章 跨分片事务与协调方案

先区分undo、redo、binlog以及各自持久化条件，再检查备份是否真正可恢复。需要讲分片和不停服迁移时，沿快照、增量、水位、校验、写权交接和回滚展开。扩容后的新写也必须进入回滚考虑，改路由不等于迁移完成。

怎样算学会了

每个重点先给简短结论，再用查询或事务时间线解释“为什么、失败在哪里、怎样验证”。建模、SQL、数据库比较、WAL、源码、反例与全部练习继续按目录补齐；导航只改变首读入口。

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

public final class JsonByteSize {
    private JsonByteSize() {}
    public static int utf8Bytes(String serializedJson) {
        return serializedJson.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Fixed serialized texts, not a general JSON serializer.
        String[] json = {"{\"x\":1}", "{\"x\":\"中\"}", "{\"x\":\"\\u4e2d\"}",
                         "{\"x\":\"😀\"}", "{\"x\":\"\\\"\\\\\\n\"}", "{ \"x\": 1 }"};
        int[] expected = {7,11,14,12,14,10};
        for (int i=0;i<json.length;i++) {
            int bytes=utf8Bytes(json[i]);
            if(bytes!=expected[i]) throw new AssertionError(json[i]+": "+bytes);
            System.out.println(json[i]+" -> UTF-8 bytes="+bytes+", Java UTF-16 units="+json[i].length());
        }
        System.out.println("JsonByteSize: 6 fixed-encoding examples passed.");
    }
}

application/code/ProtobufVarint.java
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.Random;

/** Teaching uint32 wire subset, not a general Protobuf parser or RPC protocol. */
public final class ProtobufVarint {
    public static byte[] encodeUInt32(long value) {
        if (value < 0 || value > 0xffff_ffffL) throw new IllegalArgumentException("uint32");
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream(5);
        do {
            int low = (int) (value & 0x7f);
            value >>>= 7;
            out.write(low | (value == 0 ? 0 : 0x80));
        } while (value != 0);
        return out.toByteArray();
    }
    public static long decodeUInt32(byte[] bytes) {
        if (bytes == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null");
        long result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            if (i == bytes.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("truncated");
            int b = bytes[i] & 0xff;
            if (i == 4 && (b & 0xf0) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("overflow");
            result |= (long) (b & 0x7f) << (7 * i);
            if ((b & 0x80) == 0) {
                if (i + 1 != bytes.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("trailing");
                return result;
            }
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("too long");
    }
    public static long zigZag32(int value) {
        return Integer.toUnsignedLong((value << 1) ^ (value >> 31));
    }
    public static int unZigZag32(long value) {
        if (value < 0 || value > 0xffff_ffffL) throw new IllegalArgumentException("uint32");
        return (int) ((value >>> 1) ^ -(value & 1));
    }
    /** Schema: uint32 count = 1; string label = 2. Always emits both fields. */
    public static byte[] message(long count, String label) {
        if (label == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null label");
        byte[] text = label.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (text.length > 1024) throw new IllegalArgumentException("label too large");
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        out.write(0x08); // (1 << 3) | VARINT
        out.writeBytes(encodeUInt32(count));
        out.write(0x12); // (2 << 3) | LEN
        out.writeBytes(encodeUInt32(text.length));
        out.writeBytes(text);
        return out.toByteArray();
    }
    private static int checks;
    private static void check(boolean ok) { checks++; if (!ok) throw new AssertionError(checks); }
    private static void reject(Runnable op) {
        boolean rejected = false;
        try { op.run(); } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) { rejected = true; }
        check(rejected);
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        long[] values = {0, 1, 127, 128, 150, 16383, 16384, 0xffff_ffffL};
        String[] hex = {"00", "01", "7f", "8001", "9601", "ff7f", "808001", "ffffffff0f"};
        for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
            check(HexFormat.of().formatHex(encodeUInt32(values[i])).equals(hex[i])
                    && decodeUInt32(HexFormat.of().parseHex(hex[i])) == values[i]);
        }
        Random random = new Random(7321);
        for (int i = 0; i < 10000; i++) {
            long value = Integer.toUnsignedLong(random.nextInt());
            byte[] bytes = encodeUInt32(value);
            int expectedLength = value == 0 ? 1 : (64 - Long.numberOfLeadingZeros(value) + 6) / 7;
            check(bytes.length == expectedLength && decodeUInt32(bytes) == value);
        }
        for (int value : new int[]{0, -1, 1, Integer.MIN_VALUE, Integer.MAX_VALUE}) {
            check(unZigZag32(zigZag32(value)) == value);
        }
        check(Arrays.equals(message(150, "中"), HexFormat.of().parseHex("0896011203e4b8ad")));
        reject(() -> encodeUInt32(-1)); reject(() -> encodeUInt32(0x1_0000_0000L));
        for (String invalid : new String[]{"", "80", "80808080", "ffffffff10", "808080808000", "0000"}) {
            reject(() -> decodeUInt32(HexFormat.of().parseHex(invalid)));
        }
        reject(() -> message(1, "x".repeat(1025)));
        System.out.println("PASS " + checks + " checks; wire example=0896011203e4b8ad (8 bytes)");
    }
}

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class SseCodecDemo {
    static String field(String text) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(text);
        if (text.length() > 128 || text.indexOf('\r') >= 0 || text.indexOf('\n') >= 0 || text.indexOf('\0') >= 0)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid SSE field");
        return text;
    }
    public static String encode(String id, String event, String data) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(data);
        if (data.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length > 65536)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("event too large");
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder("id: ").append(field(id)).append('\n')
                .append("event: ").append(field(event)).append('\n');
        String normalized = data.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace('\r', '\n');
        for (String line : normalized.split("\n", -1)) out.append("data: ").append(line).append('\n');
        return out.append('\n').toString();
    }
    static int checks;
    static void check(boolean ok) { if (!ok) throw new AssertionError(); checks++; }
    static void bad(Runnable r) {
        try { r.run(); throw new AssertionError("expected validation failure"); }
        catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) { checks++; }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        check(encode("1", "delta", "甲🙂").equals("id: 1\nevent: delta\ndata: 甲🙂\n\n"));
        check(encode("2", "progress", "a\r\nb\rc\n").equals("id: 2\nevent: progress\ndata: a\ndata: b\ndata: c\ndata: \n\n"));
        check(encode("", "message", "").equals("id: \nevent: message\ndata: \n\n"));
        bad(() -> encode("1\nevent: evil", "delta", "x"));
        bad(() -> encode("1", "delta\r", "x"));
        bad(() -> encode("\0", "delta", "x"));
        bad(() -> encode("1", "delta", "界".repeat(22000)));
        check(encode("1", "delta", "x".repeat(65536)).endsWith("\n\n"));
        System.out.println("SseCodecDemo checks " + checks + " PASS; encoding only");
    }
}

SseIncremental.java

application/code/SseIncremental.java
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Random;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

// Bounded teaching parser. Single-threaded, non-reentrant consumer; HTTP is outside it.
public final class SseIncremental {
    public record Event(String type, String data, String id) {}
    private final int maxLineBytes, maxDataChars;
    private final Consumer<Event> sink;
    private final ByteArrayOutputStream line = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
    private final StringBuilder data = new StringBuilder();
    private String eventType = "", idBuffer = "", lastEventId = "";
    private BigInteger retryMillis = BigInteger.valueOf(3000);
    private boolean skipLf, firstLine = true, closed;

    public SseIncremental(int maxLineBytes, int maxDataChars, Consumer<Event> sink) {
        if (maxLineBytes < 1 || maxDataChars < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("limits");
        this.maxLineBytes = maxLineBytes; this.maxDataChars = maxDataChars;
        this.sink = Objects.requireNonNull(sink);
    }
    public String lastEventId() { return lastEventId; }
    public BigInteger retryMillis() { return retryMillis; }
    public void feed(byte[] b, int off, int len) {
        if (closed) throw new IllegalStateException("parser ended or failed");
        Objects.checkFromIndexSize(off, len, b.length);
        try {
            for (int i = off; i < off + len; i++) {
                int value = b[i] & 255;
                if (skipLf) { skipLf = false; if (value == 10) continue; }
                if (value == 13 || value == 10) {
                    processLine();
                    skipLf = value == 13;
                } else {
                    if (line.size() == maxLineBytes) throw new IllegalArgumentException("line limit");
                    line.write(value);
                }
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException e) { closed = true; line.reset(); data.setLength(0); throw e; }
    }
    private void processLine() {
        // A valid UTF-8 multibyte character cannot contain CR or LF bytes.
        // Buffering the whole bounded line therefore preserves characters across reads.
        String s = line.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8); line.reset();
        if (firstLine) { firstLine = false; if (s.startsWith("\ufeff")) s = s.substring(1); }
        if (s.isEmpty()) {
            lastEventId = idBuffer;
            if (data.length() == 0) { eventType = ""; return; }
            Event event = new Event(eventType.isEmpty() ? "message" : eventType,
                    data.substring(0, data.length() - 1), lastEventId);
            data.setLength(0); eventType = "";
            sink.accept(event);
            return;
        }
        if (s.charAt(0) == ':') return;
        int colon = s.indexOf(':');
        String name = colon < 0 ? s : s.substring(0, colon);
        String value = colon < 0 ? "" : s.substring(colon + 1);
        if (value.startsWith(" ")) value = value.substring(1);
        switch (name) {
            case "data" -> {
                // Includes the LF added for each data line; limit is UTF-16 code units.
                if ((long)data.length() + value.length() + 1 > maxDataChars)
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("event limit");
                data.append(value).append('\n');
            }
            case "event" -> eventType = value;
            case "id" -> { if (value.indexOf('\0') < 0) idBuffer = value; }
            case "retry" -> {
                if (!value.isEmpty() && value.chars().allMatch(c -> c >= '0' && c <= '9'))
                    retryMillis = new BigInteger(value);
            }
            default -> { } // Unknown fields are ignored.
        }
    }
    public void end() {
        // EOF is not a blank line. Incomplete final event is intentionally discarded.
        line.reset(); data.setLength(0); eventType = ""; closed = true;
    }
    static final String FIXTURE = "\ufeff: keepalive\r\nid: 7\r\nevent: delta\r\n"
            + "data: {\"text\":\"甲🙂\\\"}\\\"\"}\r\n\r\n"
            + "data: {\"n\":1,\rdata: \"ok\":true}\r\r"
            + "id:\nevent:\ndata: not-json\n\n";
    static final List<Event> EXPECTED = List.of(
            new Event("delta", "{\"text\":\"甲🙂\\\"}\\\"\"}", "7"),
            new Event("message", "{\"n\":1,\n\"ok\":true}", "7"),
            new Event("message", "not-json", ""));
    static int checks;
    static void check(boolean b) { if (!b) throw new AssertionError(); checks++; }
    static void reject(Runnable r) {
        try { r.run(); throw new AssertionError("expected failure"); }
        catch (IllegalArgumentException | IllegalStateException expected) { checks++; }
    }
    static SseIncremental parser(List<Event> out) { return new SseIncremental(4096,8192,out::add); }
    static void text(SseIncremental p, String s) {
        byte[] bytes = s.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8); p.feed(bytes,0,bytes.length);
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        byte[] bytes = FIXTURE.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (args.length == 1 && args[0].equals("--fixture")) {
            List<Event> out = new ArrayList<>(); SseIncremental p = parser(out);
            for (int i=0;i<bytes.length;i++) p.feed(bytes,i,1);
            p.end();
            for (Event e:out) System.out.println(Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(e.data().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
            return;
        }
        for (int cut=0;cut<=bytes.length;cut++) {
            List<Event> out = new ArrayList<>(); SseIncremental p = parser(out);
            p.feed(bytes,0,cut); p.feed(bytes,cut,bytes.length-cut); p.end();
            check(out.equals(EXPECTED));
        }
        Random r = new Random(6455);
        for (int trial=0;trial<1000;trial++) {
            List<Event> out = new ArrayList<>(); SseIncremental p = parser(out);
            for (int at=0;at<bytes.length;) { int n=Math.min(1+r.nextInt(9),bytes.length-at);p.feed(bytes,at,n);at+=n; }
            p.end(); check(out.equals(EXPECTED));
        }
        List<Event> out = new ArrayList<>(); SseIncremental p = parser(out);
        text(p,"data: {\"a\":"); check(out.isEmpty());
        text(p,"1}\n"); check(out.isEmpty()); text(p,"\n");
        check(out.equals(List.of(new Event("message","{\"a\":1}",""))));
        text(p,"id: old\n\n"); check(p.lastEventId().equals("old"));
        text(p,"id: bad\0id\ndata:\n\n"); check(out.get(1).equals(new Event("message","","old")));
        text(p,"data:  x:y\nx:ignored\n\n"); check(out.get(2).data().equals(" x:y"));
        text(p,"retry: 19\nretry: +3\nretry: ３\n"); check(p.retryMillis().equals(BigInteger.valueOf(19)));
        text(p,"retry: 99999999999999999999\n"); check(p.retryMillis().equals(new BigInteger("99999999999999999999")));
        int size=out.size(); text(p,"data: unfinished\n"); p.end(); check(out.size()==size);
        reject(() -> text(p,"\n"));
        List<Event> invalid = new ArrayList<>(); SseIncremental q=parser(invalid);
        byte[] malformed={'d','a','t','a',':',' ',(byte)0xff,10,10};q.feed(malformed,0,malformed.length);
        check(invalid.get(0).data().equals("\ufffd"));
        List<Event> tightOut=new ArrayList<>(); SseIncremental tight=new SseIncremental(7,3,tightOut::add);
        text(tight,"data: x\n\n"); check(tightOut.get(0).data().equals("x"));
        reject(() -> text(tight,"data: xx")); reject(() -> text(tight,"\n"));
        SseIncremental eventLimit=new SseIncremental(100,3,e -> {});
        reject(() -> text(eventLimit,"data: x\ndata: y\n\n"));
        List<Event> noData=new ArrayList<>(); SseIncremental no=parser(noData);
        text(no,"event: stale\n\ndata\n\n"); check(noData.get(0).type().equals("message"));
        List<Event> bom=new ArrayList<>(); SseIncremental bp=parser(bom);
        text(bp,"\ufeffdata: first\n\ndata: \ufeffkept\n\n");
        check(bom.size()==2 && bom.get(1).data().equals("\ufeffkept"));
        System.out.println("SseIncremental PASS " + checks + "; no HTTP/browser/reconnection integration");
    }
}

HttpStreamClientDemo.java

application/code/HttpStreamClientDemo.java
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpExchange;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;

/** Java 21 loopback-only HTTP/SSE integration, not a production SDK.
 * Data is plain text in this small declared application protocol, not arbitrary JSON.
 * Request timeout bounds acquisition; a separate total-deadline watchdog closes the body.
 * No automatic retry, real credentials, external HTTP, or TLS configuration is involved.
 */
public final class HttpStreamClientDemo {
    sealed interface Message permits Text, Completed {}
    record Text(String value) implements Message {}
    record Completed(String result) implements Message {}
    record Result(List<Message> messages, int bytes) {}
    static final class StatusFailure extends IOException {
        final int status;
        StatusFailure(int status) { super("HTTP " + status); this.status = status; }
    }
    static final class ProtocolFailure extends RuntimeException {
        ProtocolFailure(String message) { super(message); }
    }

    static Result read(HttpClient client, ScheduledExecutorService timer,
                       URI uri, Duration budget, int maxBytes) throws Exception {
        if (!"http".equals(uri.getScheme()) || !"127.0.0.1".equals(uri.getHost())
                || uri.getUserInfo() != null || maxBytes < 1 || budget.isNegative() || budget.isZero())
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("loopback fixture and positive bounds required");
        var timedOut = new AtomicBoolean();
        var bodyRef = new AtomicReference<InputStream>();
        var watchdog = timer.schedule(() -> {
            timedOut.set(true);
            InputStream body = bodyRef.get();
            if (body != null) try { body.close(); } catch (IOException ignored) { }
        }, budget.toNanos(), TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);
        try {
            var request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(uri).timeout(budget)
                    .header("Accept", "text/event-stream").GET().build();
            var response = client.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofInputStream());
            try (InputStream body = response.body()) {
                bodyRef.set(body);
                // Deadline could have won before the handle became available.
                if (timedOut.get()) { body.close(); throw new IOException("total deadline"); }
                if (response.statusCode() != 200) throw new StatusFailure(response.statusCode());
                String type = response.headers().firstValue("Content-Type").orElse("")
                        .split(";", 2)[0].strip().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (!type.equals("text/event-stream")) throw new ProtocolFailure("content type");
                List<Message> messages = new ArrayList<>();
                AtomicBoolean terminal = new AtomicBoolean();
                SseIncremental parser = new SseIncremental(256, 512, event -> {
                    if (terminal.get()) throw new ProtocolFailure("event after terminal");
                    switch (event.type()) {
                        case "delta" -> messages.add(new Text(event.data()));
                        case "done" -> { messages.add(new Completed(event.data())); terminal.set(true); }
                        case "error" -> throw new ProtocolFailure("remote business error: " + event.data());
                        default -> throw new ProtocolFailure("unknown event type");
                    }
                });
                byte[] chunk = new byte[7]; // Deliberately unrelated to event / UTF-8 boundaries.
                int total = 0;
                try {
                    for (int n; !terminal.get() && (n = body.read(chunk)) != -1;) {
                        if (timedOut.get()) throw new IOException("total deadline");
                        if (n > maxBytes - total) throw new ProtocolFailure("body limit");
                        total += n;
                        parser.feed(chunk, 0, n);
                    }
                } finally { parser.end(); }
                if (timedOut.get()) throw new IOException("total deadline");
                if (!terminal.get()) throw new ProtocolFailure("EOF without terminal");
                return new Result(List.copyOf(messages), total);
            }
        } finally {
            bodyRef.set(null);
            watchdog.cancel(false);
        }
    }
    static void serve(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        try (exchange) {
            String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
            if (path.equals("/status")) { exchange.sendResponseHeaders(503, -1); return; }
            if (path.equals("/redirect")) {
                exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Location", "/stream");
                exchange.sendResponseHeaders(302, -1); return;
            }
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type",
                    path.equals("/type") ? "application/json" : "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, 0);
            if (path.equals("/hang")) {
                exchange.getResponseBody().write(": open\n\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                exchange.getResponseBody().flush();
                try { Thread.sleep(1200); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); }
                return;
            }
            String payload = switch (path) {
                case "/large" -> "event: delta\ndata: " + "a".repeat(200) + "\n\n";
                case "/incomplete" -> "event: delta\ndata: unfinished\n\n";
                case "/error" -> "event: error\ndata: failed\n\n";
                default -> "event: delta\ndata: 甲🙂\n\nevent: done\ndata: complete\n\n";
            };
            byte[] bytes = payload.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
                exchange.getResponseBody().write(bytes, i, Math.min(3, bytes.length - i));
                exchange.getResponseBody().flush();
            }
        } catch (IOException closedByClient) {
            // Early close from size, status, deadline or terminal is expected in these fixtures.
        }
    }
    interface Checked { void run() throws Exception; }
    static int checks;
    static void check(boolean ok) { if (!ok) throw new AssertionError(); checks++; }
    static void fails(Class<? extends Throwable> type, Checked action) throws Exception {
        try { action.run(); throw new AssertionError("expected " + type); }
        catch (Exception e) { if (!type.isInstance(e)) throw e; checks++; }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        HttpServer server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
        var workers = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);
        var timer = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();
        server.setExecutor(workers); server.createContext("/", HttpStreamClientDemo::serve); server.start();
        URI root = URI.create("http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort());
        try (HttpClient client = HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(1))
                .followRedirects(HttpClient.Redirect.NEVER).version(HttpClient.Version.HTTP_1_1).build()) {
            Duration budget = Duration.ofSeconds(2);
            Result result = read(client, timer, root.resolve("/stream"), budget, 1024);
            check(result.messages().equals(List.of(new Text("甲🙂"), new Completed("complete"))));
            check(result.bytes() > 0 && result.bytes() <= 1024);
            fails(StatusFailure.class, () -> read(client, timer, root.resolve("/status"), budget, 1024));
            fails(StatusFailure.class, () -> read(client, timer, root.resolve("/redirect"), budget, 1024));
            fails(ProtocolFailure.class, () -> read(client, timer, root.resolve("/type"), budget, 1024));
            fails(ProtocolFailure.class, () -> read(client, timer, root.resolve("/large"), budget, 64));
            fails(ProtocolFailure.class, () -> read(client, timer, root.resolve("/incomplete"), budget, 1024));
            fails(ProtocolFailure.class, () -> read(client, timer, root.resolve("/error"), budget, 1024));
            fails(IOException.class, () -> read(client, timer, root.resolve("/hang"), Duration.ofMillis(300), 1024));
            fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> read(client, timer,
                    URI.create("http://example.test/"), budget, 1024));
        } finally {
            server.stop(0); workers.shutdownNow(); timer.shutdownNow();
            workers.awaitTermination(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS); timer.awaitTermination(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        }
        System.out.println("HttpStreamClientDemo: " + checks + " checks passed (loopback HTTP only)");
    }
}
