import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;

public final class PatternExamples {
    private PatternExamples() {}

    // Simple factory: a named creation point, not GoF Factory Method by itself.
    public interface Message { String render(String body); }
    public static final class PlainMessage implements Message {
        public String render(String body) { return Objects.requireNonNull(body); }
    }
    public static final class TaggedMessage implements Message {
        public String render(String body) { return "[notice] " + Objects.requireNonNull(body); }
    }
    public static Message simpleFactory(String kind) {
        return switch (Objects.requireNonNull(kind)) {
            case "plain" -> new PlainMessage();
            case "tagged" -> new TaggedMessage();
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown kind: " + kind);
        };
    }
    // Factory Method: subclasses supply a product used by a stable workflow.
    public abstract static class MessageJob {
        protected abstract Message createMessage();
        public final String execute(String body) {
            return createMessage().render(Objects.requireNonNull(body));
        }
    }
    public static final class PlainJob extends MessageJob {
        protected Message createMessage() { return new PlainMessage(); }
    }
    public static final class TaggedJob extends MessageJob {
        protected Message createMessage() { return new TaggedMessage(); }
    }
    // Abstract Factory: choose a family, then create related product types.
    public interface Chair { String style(); }
    public interface Table { String style(); }
    public interface FurnitureFactory { Chair chair(); Table table(); }
    public static final class ModernFactory implements FurnitureFactory {
        public Chair chair() { return () -> "modern"; }
        public Table table() { return () -> "modern"; }
    }
    public static final class ClassicFactory implements FurnitureFactory {
        public Chair chair() { return () -> "classic"; }
        public Table table() { return () -> "classic"; }
    }

    public enum Tier { NORMAL, VIP }
    public interface PricePolicy { long quote(long cents); }
    public static final class PriceService {
        private final Map<Tier, PricePolicy> policies;
        public PriceService(Map<Tier, PricePolicy> policies) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(policies);
            EnumMap<Tier, PricePolicy> copy = new EnumMap<>(Tier.class);
            policies.forEach((k, v) -> copy.put(Objects.requireNonNull(k), Objects.requireNonNull(v)));
            this.policies = Collections.unmodifiableMap(copy);
        }
        public long quote(Tier tier, long cents) {
            if (cents < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative amount");
            PricePolicy p = policies.get(Objects.requireNonNull(tier));
            if (p == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("No policy for " + tier);
            long result = p.quote(cents);
            if (result < 0 || result > cents) throw new IllegalStateException("invalid discount");
            return result;
        }
    }

    public record Content(String text, boolean authenticated) {
        public Content { Objects.requireNonNull(text); }
    }
    public record Decision(boolean accepted, String reason) {
        public Decision { Objects.requireNonNull(reason); }
        public static Decision pass() { return new Decision(true, "accepted"); }
        public static Decision reject(String why) { return new Decision(false, why); }
    }
    public interface Rule { Optional<String> rejection(Content content); }
    public static final class ReviewChain {
        private final List<Rule> rules;
        public ReviewChain(List<Rule> rules) {
            this.rules = List.copyOf(rules);
            if (this.rules.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("empty review chain");
        }
        public Decision review(Content content) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(content);
            for (Rule rule : rules) {
                Optional<String> rejection = Objects.requireNonNull(rule.rejection(content));
                if (rejection.isPresent()) return Decision.reject(rejection.get());
            }
            return Decision.pass();
        }
    }

    // Template Method: keep the primary throwable, including shared exception instances.
    public interface Resource extends AutoCloseable {
        @Override void close() throws Exception;
    }
    public abstract static class ImportJob {
        protected abstract Resource open() throws Exception;
        protected abstract int doImport(Resource resource) throws Exception;
        public final int run() throws Exception {
            Resource resource = Objects.requireNonNull(open());
            Throwable primary = null;
            try {
                return doImport(resource);
            } catch (Throwable failure) {
                primary = failure;
                throw failure;
            } finally {
                if (primary == null) {
                    resource.close();
                } else {
                    try {
                        resource.close();
                    } catch (Throwable closing) {
                        if (closing != primary) primary.addSuppressed(closing);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public interface TextService { String read(String key); }
    public static final class UpperCaseDecorator implements TextService {
        private final TextService next;
        public UpperCaseDecorator(TextService next) { this.next = Objects.requireNonNull(next); }
        public String read(String key) { return next.read(key).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT); }
    }
    public static final class PrefixDecorator implements TextService {
        private final TextService next;
        private final String prefix;
        public PrefixDecorator(TextService next, String prefix) {
            this.next = Objects.requireNonNull(next);
            this.prefix = Objects.requireNonNull(prefix);
        }
        public String read(String key) { return prefix + next.read(key); }
    }
    public static final class GuardProxy implements TextService {
        private final TextService target;
        private final BooleanSupplier allowed;
        public GuardProxy(TextService target, BooleanSupplier allowed) {
            this.target = Objects.requireNonNull(target);
            this.allowed = Objects.requireNonNull(allowed);
        }
        public String read(String key) {
            if (!allowed.getAsBoolean()) throw new SecurityException("denied");
            return target.read(key);
        }
    }
    public interface LegacyLookup { String find(int id); }
    public static final class LookupAdapter implements TextService {
        private final LegacyLookup legacy;
        public LookupAdapter(LegacyLookup legacy) { this.legacy = Objects.requireNonNull(legacy); }
        public String read(String key) { return legacy.find(Integer.parseInt(key)); }
    }
}

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

// Thread-confined synchronous bus. It is intentionally not a concurrent broker.
public final class EventBus<E> {
    public interface Subscription extends AutoCloseable { @Override void close(); }
    private final Thread owner = Thread.currentThread();
    private final Map<String, LinkedHashSet<Entry>> topics = new HashMap<>();
    private final class Entry implements Subscription {
        final String topic;
        final LinkedHashSet<Entry> group;
        final Consumer<? super E> listener;
        final boolean once;
        boolean active = true;
        Entry(String topic, LinkedHashSet<Entry> group,
              Consumer<? super E> listener, boolean once) {
            this.topic = topic; this.group = group; this.listener = listener; this.once = once;
        }
        public void close() {
            checkThread();
            active = false;
            group.remove(this);
            if (group.isEmpty() && topics.get(topic) == group) topics.remove(topic);
        }
    }
    private void checkThread() {
        if (Thread.currentThread() != owner) throw new IllegalStateException("wrong thread");
    }
    public Subscription on(String topic, Consumer<? super E> listener, boolean once) {
        checkThread();
        Objects.requireNonNull(topic); Objects.requireNonNull(listener);
        LinkedHashSet<Entry> group = topics.computeIfAbsent(topic, ignored -> new LinkedHashSet<>());
        Entry entry = new Entry(topic, group, listener, once);
        group.add(entry);
        return entry;
    }
    public int emit(String topic, E event) {
        checkThread(); Objects.requireNonNull(topic);
        LinkedHashSet<Entry> group = topics.get(topic);
        if (group == null) return 0;
        List<Entry> snapshot = new ArrayList<>(group);
        int called = 0;
        for (Entry entry : snapshot) {
            if (!entry.active) continue;
            if (entry.once) entry.close();
            entry.listener.accept(event); // fail fast; subsequent listeners are not called
            called++;
        }
        return called;
    }
}

java/EventBus.mjs

java/EventBus.mjs
export class EventBus {
  #topics = new Map();
  on(topic, fn, { once = false } = {}) {
    if (typeof fn !== 'function') throw new TypeError('listener must be a function');
    let entries = this.#topics.get(topic);
    if (!entries) this.#topics.set(topic, entries = new Set());
    const entry = { fn, once, active: true };
    entries.add(entry);
    const off = () => {
      entry.active = false;
      entries.delete(entry);
      if (!entries.size && this.#topics.get(topic) === entries) this.#topics.delete(topic);
    };
    entry.off = off;
    return off;
  }
  emit(topic, payload) {
    const snapshot = [...(this.#topics.get(topic) ?? [])];
    let called = 0;
    for (const entry of snapshot) {
      if (!entry.active) continue;
      if (entry.once) entry.off();
      entry.fn(payload);
      called++;
    }
    return called;
  }
}

from functools import wraps
from time import perf_counter


def log_call(sink=print, format_args=lambda args, kwargs: "<redacted>"):
    """Synchronous functions only; provide an explicit safe formatter to print arguments."""
    def decorate(fn):
        @wraps(fn)
        def wrapped(*args, **kwargs):
            started = perf_counter()
            try:
                sink(f"{fn.__name__} args={format_args(args, kwargs)}")
                return fn(*args, **kwargs)
            finally:
                sink(f"{fn.__name__} elapsed={perf_counter() - started:.6f}s")
        return wrapped
    return decorate

tests/PatternContractTest.java
import java.io.*;
import java.lang.reflect.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
import java.util.function.*;

public final class PatternContractTest {
    private static int checks;
    private static void check(boolean condition, String name) {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(name);
    }
    private static void expect(Class<? extends Throwable> type, Runnable action, String name) {
        try { action.run(); } catch (Throwable error) {
            check(type.isInstance(error), name + ": " + error); return;
        }
        throw new AssertionError(name + ": missing error");
    }
    private static void singletonRace(Supplier<Object> get) throws Exception {
        ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(16);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);
        List<Future<Object>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) tasks.add(pool.submit(() -> { start.await(); return get.get(); }));
            start.countDown();
            Object first = tasks.get(0).get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            for (Future<Object> task : tasks) check(task.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == first, "same identity");
        } finally { pool.shutdownNow(); check(pool.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "pool ended"); }
    }
    private static void singletons() throws Exception {
        singletonRace(SingletonExamples.Eager::getInstance);
        singletonRace(SingletonExamples.StaticBlock::getInstance);
        singletonRace(() -> SingletonExamples.EnumSingle.INSTANCE);
        singletonRace(SingletonExamples.SynchronizedLazy::getInstance);
        singletonRace(() -> {
            SingletonExamples.DoubleChecked value = SingletonExamples.DoubleChecked.getInstance();
            if (value.initializedValue() != 42) throw new AssertionError("unsafe publication");
            return value;
        });
        singletonRace(SingletonExamples.HolderSingle::getInstance);
        ByteArrayOutputStream bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try (ObjectOutputStream out = new ObjectOutputStream(bytes)) { out.writeObject(SingletonExamples.EnumSingle.INSTANCE); }
        try (ObjectInputStream in = new ObjectInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes.toByteArray()))) {
            check(in.readObject() == SingletonExamples.EnumSingle.INSTANCE, "enum serialization identity");
        }
        Constructor<SingletonExamples.EnumSingle> enumCtor = SingletonExamples.EnumSingle.class.getDeclaredConstructor(String.class, int.class);
        enumCtor.setAccessible(true);
        try { enumCtor.newInstance("FAKE", 1); throw new AssertionError("enum reflection accepted"); }
        catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) { check(true, "enum reflection refused"); }
        Constructor<SingletonExamples.HolderSingle> ordinary = SingletonExamples.HolderSingle.class.getDeclaredConstructor();
        ordinary.setAccessible(true);
        check(ordinary.newInstance() != SingletonExamples.HolderSingle.getInstance(), "private ctor is not reflection proof");
        URL base = SingletonExamples.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation();
        try (URLClassLoader left = new URLClassLoader(new URL[]{base}, null);
             URLClassLoader right = new URLClassLoader(new URL[]{base}, null)) {
            Object a = left.loadClass("SingletonExamples$HolderSingle").getMethod("getInstance").invoke(null);
            Object b = right.loadClass("SingletonExamples$HolderSingle").getMethod("getInstance").invoke(null);
            check(a != b && a.getClass() != b.getClass(), "per defining class loader");
        }
    }
    private static void patterns() throws Exception {
        check(PatternExamples.simpleFactory("plain").render("x").equals("x"), "simple factory");
        expect(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> PatternExamples.simpleFactory("missing"), "unknown factory");
        check(new PatternExamples.TaggedJob().execute("x").equals("[notice] x"), "factory method");
        check(new PatternExamples.PlainJob().execute("x").equals("x"), "factory method alternative");
        for (PatternExamples.FurnitureFactory f : List.of(new PatternExamples.ModernFactory(), new PatternExamples.ClassicFactory()))
            check(f.chair().style().equals(f.table().style()), "compatible product family");
        Map<PatternExamples.Tier, PatternExamples.PricePolicy> input = new EnumMap<>(PatternExamples.Tier.class);
        input.put(PatternExamples.Tier.NORMAL, amount -> amount);
        input.put(PatternExamples.Tier.VIP, amount -> amount - amount / 10);
        PatternExamples.PriceService pricing = new PatternExamples.PriceService(input);
        input.clear();
        check(pricing.quote(PatternExamples.Tier.NORMAL, 99) == 99, "immutable selection map");
        check(pricing.quote(PatternExamples.Tier.VIP, 99) == 90, "round down discount cents");
        check(pricing.quote(PatternExamples.Tier.VIP, Long.MAX_VALUE) == Long.MAX_VALUE - Long.MAX_VALUE / 10, "no multiplication overflow");
        expect(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> pricing.quote(PatternExamples.Tier.VIP, -1), "negative price");
        expect(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new PatternExamples.PriceService(Map.of()).quote(PatternExamples.Tier.NORMAL, 1), "missing strategy");
        expect(IllegalStateException.class, () -> new PatternExamples.PriceService(Map.of(PatternExamples.Tier.NORMAL, n -> -1)).quote(PatternExamples.Tier.NORMAL, 1), "broken strategy contract");
        List<String> seen = new ArrayList<>();
        PatternExamples.Rule auth = content -> { seen.add("auth"); return content.authenticated() ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of("auth"); };
        PatternExamples.Rule length = content -> { seen.add("length"); return content.text().length() > 5 ? Optional.of("length") : Optional.empty(); };
        PatternExamples.ReviewChain chain = new PatternExamples.ReviewChain(List.of(auth, length));
        check(!chain.review(new PatternExamples.Content("hi", false)).accepted() && seen.equals(List.of("auth")), "chain stops");
        seen.clear();
        check(chain.review(new PatternExamples.Content("hi", true)).accepted() && seen.equals(List.of("auth", "length")), "chain order");
        check(chain.review(new PatternExamples.Content("123456", true)).reason().equals("length"), "chain rejection reason");
        expect(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new PatternExamples.ReviewChain(List.of()), "empty chain rejected");
        AtomicInteger closed = new AtomicInteger();
        PatternExamples.ImportJob job = new PatternExamples.ImportJob() {
            protected PatternExamples.Resource open() { return closed::incrementAndGet; }
            protected int doImport(PatternExamples.Resource resource) { return 7; }
        };
        check(job.run() == 7 && closed.get() == 1, "template closes success");
        PatternExamples.ImportJob failure = new PatternExamples.ImportJob() {
            protected PatternExamples.Resource open() { return () -> { throw new IOException("close"); }; }
            protected int doImport(PatternExamples.Resource resource) throws Exception { throw new IOException("work"); }
        };
        try { failure.run(); throw new AssertionError("failure missing"); }
        catch (IOException e) { check(e.getMessage().equals("work") && e.getSuppressed().length == 1, "template preserves primary error"); }
        PatternExamples.TextService base = key -> "hello";
        check(new PatternExamples.UpperCaseDecorator(new PatternExamples.PrefixDecorator(base, "pre:")).read("x").equals("PRE:HELLO"), "decorator nesting order");
        check(new PatternExamples.PrefixDecorator(new PatternExamples.UpperCaseDecorator(base), "pre:").read("x").equals("pre:HELLO"), "reverse decorator order differs");
        AtomicInteger hits = new AtomicInteger();
        PatternExamples.GuardProxy guard = new PatternExamples.GuardProxy(key -> { hits.incrementAndGet(); return key; }, () -> false);
        expect(SecurityException.class, () -> guard.read("x"), "proxy denied");
        check(hits.get() == 0, "proxy did not call target");
        check(new PatternExamples.LookupAdapter(id -> "id=" + id).read("42").equals("id=42"), "adapter converts contract");
    }
    private static void events() throws Exception {
        EventBus<String> empty = new EventBus<>();
        check(empty.emit("t", "x") == 0, "empty bus");
        EventBus<String> bus = new EventBus<>();
        List<String> events = new ArrayList<>();
        EventBus.Subscription one = bus.on("t", x -> events.add("1" + x), false);
        bus.on("t", x -> events.add("2" + x), false);
        check(bus.emit("t", "x") == 2 && events.equals(List.of("1x", "2x")), "order and payload");
        one.close(); one.close(); events.clear();
        check(bus.emit("t", "y") == 1 && events.equals(List.of("2y")), "idempotent cancel");
        EventBus<Integer> recursive = new EventBus<>();
        AtomicInteger count = new AtomicInteger();
        recursive.on("t", x -> { count.incrementAndGet(); recursive.emit("t", x); }, true);
        recursive.emit("t", 1);
        check(count.get() == 1, "once removed before reentry");
        EventBus<String> cancel = new EventBus<>();
        EventBus.Subscription[] later = new EventBus.Subscription[1];
        cancel.on("t", x -> later[0].close(), false);
        later[0] = cancel.on("t", x -> { throw new AssertionError("canceled called"); }, false);
        check(cancel.emit("t", "x") == 1, "cancel in snapshot");
        EventBus<String> add = new EventBus<>();
        AtomicInteger added = new AtomicInteger();
        add.on("t", x -> add.on("t", y -> added.incrementAndGet(), false), true);
        check(add.emit("t", "x") == 1 && added.get() == 0, "new listener excluded from current snapshot");
        check(add.emit("t", "x") == 1 && added.get() == 1, "new listener participates next time");
        Consumer<String> fn = x -> count.incrementAndGet();
        EventBus<String> dup = new EventBus<>();
        EventBus.Subscription first = dup.on("t", fn, false);
        dup.on("t", fn, false); first.close();
        check(dup.emit("t", "x") == 1, "same function independent registrations");
        EventBus<String> fail = new EventBus<>();
        AtomicInteger after = new AtomicInteger();
        fail.on("t", x -> { throw new IllegalArgumentException("bad"); }, false);
        fail.on("t", x -> after.incrementAndGet(), false);
        expect(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> fail.emit("t", "x"), "fail fast");
        check(after.get() == 0, "later callback not invoked");
        EventBus<String> replace = new EventBus<>();
        EventBus.Subscription old = replace.on("t", x -> {}, false);
        old.close(); replace.on("t", x -> {}, false); old.close();
        check(replace.emit("t", "x") == 1, "old cancel does not remove new group");
        ExecutorService worker = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
        try {
            Future<Boolean> outcome = worker.submit(() -> { try { bus.emit("t", "x"); return false; } catch (IllegalStateException expected) { return true; } });
            check(outcome.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "thread confinement checked");
        } finally { worker.shutdownNow(); check(worker.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "worker ended"); }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        singletons(); patterns(); events();
        System.out.println("PASS PatternContractTest " + checks + " checks");
    }
}

public final class ImportJobBoundaryTest {
    private static int checks;
    private static void check(boolean condition, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }
    private static Throwable run(Exception work, Exception closing, int[] events) {
        PatternExamples.ImportJob job = new PatternExamples.ImportJob() {
            @Override protected PatternExamples.Resource open() {
                events[0]++;
                return () -> { events[2]++; if (closing != null) throw closing; };
            }
            @Override protected int doImport(PatternExamples.Resource resource) throws Exception {
                events[1]++;
                if (work != null) throw work;
                return 7;
            }
        };
        try {
            check(job.run() == 7, "success result");
            return null;
        } catch (Throwable failure) {
            return failure;
        }
    }
    private static void caseOf(Exception work, Exception closing, Throwable expected, int suppressed) {
        int[] events = new int[3];
        Throwable actual = run(work, closing, events);
        check(actual == expected, "preserve exception identity");
        check(events[0] == 1 && events[1] == 1 && events[2] == 1, "open/work/close exactly once");
        if (actual != null) {
            check(actual.getSuppressed().length == suppressed, "suppressed count");
            if (suppressed == 1) check(actual.getSuppressed()[0] == closing, "secondary identity");
        }
    }
    private static final class NoSuppression extends Exception {
        NoSuppression() { super("disabled", null, false, true); }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        caseOf(null, null, null, 0);
        Exception workOnly = new Exception("work");
        caseOf(workOnly, null, workOnly, 0);
        Exception closeOnly = new Exception("close");
        caseOf(null, closeOnly, closeOnly, 0);
        Exception primary = new Exception("primary"), secondary = new Exception("secondary");
        caseOf(primary, secondary, primary, 1);
        Exception shared = new Exception("same instance");
        caseOf(shared, shared, shared, 0);
        Exception disabled = new NoSuppression();
        caseOf(disabled, new Exception("unrecorded secondary"), disabled, 0);
        System.out.println("ImportJobBoundaryTest " + checks + " checks passed");
    }
}

items.q: 首页 1.5s→800ms 后，如何继续到 100ms：权限计算场景
items.a:
本质先固定同一接口、输入和 percentile，按关键路径证明剩余 800ms 花在哪里，再优化权限依赖与重复计算；不能为延迟目标省掉鉴权。

本节保留教学来源的条件、示例和代码。原文“通过”、测试数量、性能数字与运行命令不代表本批实际执行或个人项目成绩；本批只做来源保真与隔离的站点内容编译，没有运行导入程序。混合来源中的纯前端或推荐课程已单独排除；理论与场景的完整程序、夹具只存来源归档，不进入学习导航。实际算法与手撕代码如有裁切会明确注明。

首页 1.5s→800ms 后，如何继续到 100ms：权限计算场景

先固定同一接口、输入和 percentile，按关键路径证明剩余 800ms 花在哪里，再优化权限依赖与重复计算；不能为延迟目标省掉鉴权。

1.5s、800ms 和 100ms 分别是已有描述与继续优化目标，不能据此推断发生过某个缓存改造。沿同一 requestId关联客户端、网关、服务、权限服务、数据库，观察排队、序列化、N+1检查、连接池与网络往返。若权限仅占80ms，把它降为0也不能从800ms到100ms；先用占比上界判断收益。

权限优化可以批量查用户角色/组与对象 ACL，减少逐项 RPC；把角色继承预编译为可解释集合/位图，按用户、组织、资源版本缓存计算结果；把静态策略与动态属性拆开，在入口验证身份后对列表批量授权。SQL下推过滤能减少返回后丢弃，但要保证条件与原策略等价，并防止分页/计数泄漏无权对象。

撤销、离职、跨租户、临时授权到期与资源改属是关键边界。缓存 key 必须携带影响决策的政策/主体/资源版本，失效通知断线后的恢复有明确策略；对高敏感写操作在权威点再校验，不能靠很长 TTL继续授权。局部缓存可减网络开销，但不同实例读到不同版本时要定义收敛或强校验要求。

用真实权限分布比较冷/热路径、最深组织树、最多角色用户和大量拒绝对象，观察 p95/p99与正确率；注入权限服务超时，按操作风险 fail-closed或返回受限内容，不允许失败时默认管理员。AI 可以分析脱敏 Trace、提出方案和测试，但代码、策略等价与性能均需真实执行验证。

title: 十个海盗 分一百枚金币

items.q: 十个海盗 分一百枚金币？
items.a:
本质采用“至少 50% 赞成”、提案者能自投、金币不可分、所有人先保命再多拿金币、相同生死与金币时反对的模型，一种最优方案为 (96,0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1,0)。首人给第 3、5、7、9 号各一枚，加自己的赞成票恰好五票，通过并保留 96 枚。

十个海盗 分一百枚金币

采用“至少 50% 赞成”、提案者能自投、金币不可分、所有人先保命再多拿金币、相同生死与金币时反对的模型，一种最优方案为 (96,0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1,0)。首人给第 3、5、7、9 号各一枚，加自己的赞成票恰好五票，通过并保留 96 枚。

“半数以上（>=50%）”按明确的 >= 计算，需要 ceil(n/2) 票；如果实际想表达严格超过一半，则需要 floor(n/2)+1 票，会改变从两人开始的全部递推。仅有“理性、贪婪、优先保命”也没有定义完全相同收益时怎么投票，所以下面的平利反对是公开补充的决策规则，不能称作所有解读下唯一方案。

每张票值多少，不看选民现在拿到多少，而看他拒绝当前方案之后会怎样。逆推时，先算出提案者死后，余下每个人的生死与金币，再逐人比较：

- 继续下去会死：现在给零金币但能让他存活，也能买到赞成票。

- 继续下去会活：在平利反对规则下，至少比下一轮多给一枚，才能保证赞成。

提案者从这些价格中选最便宜的票，买够所需数量，剩余归自己。这里先比较生死、再比较金币，不能只按下一轮金币数排序而忘掉死亡状态。

剩余人数至少一半通过时的一种最优分配
2(100,0)
3(99,0,1)
4(99,0,1,0)
5(98,0,1,0,1)
6(98,0,1,0,1,0)
7(97,0,1,0,1,0,1)
8(97,0,1,0,1,0,1,0)
9(96,0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1)
10(96,0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1,0)

从人数少的地方开始，票价才算得出来。两人时提案者自己一票已到 50%，所以独拿 100；三人时给末人一枚，因为若首人死，末人下一轮只能拿零。

四人只需要两票，本轮第三人在下一轮分配里拿零，所以给其一枚。注意比较的是同一个人：每步都要按人物身份把下一轮向量右移一位，不能把“下一轮第三人”误当成本轮第三人。

十人时，首人死后的九人方案在原第 2 至 10 号上是 (96,0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1)。最便宜四票正是原第 3、5、7、9 号。至少需要四张别人的票，而每个这类存活选民都至少要一枚才严格改善，所以总代价至少四枚；96 达到这个模型的最优上界。

严格超过一半会怎样

严格多数时，两人需要两票，第二人拒绝后可独拿 100，而第一人最多也只能给 100，平利反对使第一人无法保命。三人时，第二人若进入下一轮会成为那个必死的提案者，所以当前给零也赞成，首人便可保留全部 100。

从这条不同的基础情形继续逆推，一种确定同成本选民次序下的方案为：4 人 (98,0,1,1)，5 人 (97,0,1,2,0)，6 人 (96,0,1,2,0,1)，7 人 (96,0,1,2,0,1,0)，8 人 (95,0,1,2,0,1,0,1)，9 人 (95,0,1,2,0,1,0,1,0)，10 人 (94,0,1,2,0,1,0,1,0,1)。等成本选民可产生其他同收益分配，不必执着于唯一向量。

附录用 -1 表示死亡，零表示活着但没金币，两者不能合并。每个子问题验证金币守恒与票数；提案者买不起最便宜的足够票数时，才进入被淘汰分支。自投被禁止、金币可无限分割、平利赞成、强制全票或允许可信联盟，都会改变推导。

java/FairCoin.java

java/FairCoin.java
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.OptionalInt;
import java.util.function.IntSupplier;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
public final class FairCoin {
    public enum Winner { A, B }
    // true = heads; equal pairs are explicitly unresolved, never silently biased.
    public static Optional<Winner> twoTosses(boolean first, boolean second) {
        if (first == second) return Optional.empty();
        return Optional.of(first ? Winner.A : Winner.B);
    }
    public static Optional<Winner> bounded(BooleanSupplier coin, int maxPairs) {
        if (maxPairs < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative budget");
        for (int i = 0; i < maxPairs; i++) {
            Optional<Winner> result = twoTosses(coin.getAsBoolean(),coin.getAsBoolean());
            if (result.isPresent()) return result;
        }
        return Optional.empty();
    }
    private static int nextBit(IntSupplier fn) {
        int bit = fn.getAsInt();
        if (bit != 0 && bit != 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("not a bit");
        return bit;
    }
    // fn is the only random source; 01 -> 0, 10 -> 1, equal pairs retry.
    // Requires IID calls with fixed P(fn() == 0) = P, where 0 < P < 1.
    // Almost-sure termination, E[calls] = 1 / (P * (1 - P)); no finite worst-case bound.
    // Degenerate or correlated sources are not made valid by this wrapper.
    public static int fairBit(IntSupplier fn) {
        java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(fn);
        while (true) {
            int first = nextBit(fn), second = nextBit(fn);
            if (first != second) return first;
        }
    }
    // Engineering alternative: a spent budget returns unresolved, never a biased bit.
    public static OptionalInt fairBit(IntSupplier fn, int maxPairs) {
        java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(fn);
        Optional<Winner> result = bounded(() -> nextBit(fn) == 0, maxPairs);
        return result.isEmpty() ? OptionalInt.empty()
            : OptionalInt.of(result.get() == Winner.A ? 0 : 1);
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        if (twoTosses(true,false).orElseThrow() != Winner.A ||
            twoTosses(false,true).orElseThrow() != Winner.B ||
            twoTosses(true,true).isPresent() || twoTosses(false,false).isPresent()) throw new AssertionError();
        boolean[] sequence = {true,true,false,false,false,true};
        int[] index={0};
        if (bounded(() -> sequence[index[0]++],3).orElseThrow()!=Winner.B || index[0]!=6) throw new AssertionError();
        if (bounded(() -> true,100).isPresent()) throw new AssertionError();
        int[] calls={0};
        if (bounded(() -> { calls[0]++;return true;},0).isPresent() || calls[0]!=0) throw new AssertionError();
        for (int first = 0; first <= 1; first++) for (int second = 0; second <= 1; second++) {
            int[] bits = {first, second}; int[] at = {0};
            OptionalInt answer = fairBit(() -> bits[at[0]++], 1);
            if (answer.isPresent() != (first != second) ||
                (answer.isPresent() && answer.getAsInt() != first) || at[0] != 2)
                throw new AssertionError("integer bit pair");
        }
        int[] bits = {0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 0}; int[] at = {0};
        if (fairBit(() -> bits[at[0]++], 3).orElseThrow() != 1 || at[0] != 6)
            throw new AssertionError("integer bit retry");
        if (fairBit(() -> { throw new AssertionError("zero budget called source"); }, 0).isPresent())
            throw new AssertionError("integer bit zero budget");
        for (int invalid : new int[]{-1, 2}) {
            boolean rejected = false;
            try { fairBit(() -> invalid, 1); }
            catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) { rejected = true; }
            if (!rejected) throw new AssertionError("invalid integer bit");
        }
        // Only terminating deterministic sequences are supplied to the unbounded overload.
        for (int[] sequenceBits : new int[][]{{0, 1}, {1, 0}, {0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1}, {1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0}}) {
            int[] cursor = {0};
            int answer = fairBit(() -> sequenceBits[cursor[0]++]);
            if (answer != sequenceBits[sequenceBits.length - 2] || cursor[0] != sequenceBits.length)
                throw new AssertionError("unbounded integer bit contract");
        }
        for (int[] invalidBits : new int[][]{{-1}, {2}, {0, -1}, {1, 2}}) {
            int[] cursor = {0}; boolean rejected = false;
            try { fairBit(() -> invalidBits[cursor[0]++]); }
            catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) { rejected = true; }
            if (!rejected) throw new AssertionError("unbounded invalid bit");
        }
        System.out.println("PASS: boolean pairs, bounded and exact int-returning bit interfaces, retries, zero budget, invalid bits; unbounded tests use terminating sequences only");
    }
}

import java.util.*;

public final class HorseLab {
    public static final class Course {
        private final int lanes;
        private final int[] speeds;
        private int calls;
        public Course(int lanes, int[] speeds) {
            if (lanes < 2 || speeds.length != lanes * lanes) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
            this.lanes = lanes; this.speeds = speeds.clone();
            if (Arrays.stream(speeds).distinct().count() != speeds.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ties excluded");
        }
        public int[] race(int... horses) {
            if (horses.length < 1 || horses.length > lanes) throw new IllegalArgumentException("lane limit");
            if (Arrays.stream(horses).distinct().count() != horses.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate horse");
            Integer[] input = Arrays.stream(horses).boxed().toArray(Integer[]::new);
            for (int h : horses) if (h < 0 || h >= speeds.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("unknown horse");
            Arrays.sort(input, Comparator.comparingInt((Integer h) -> speeds[h]).reversed());
            calls++;
            return Arrays.stream(input).mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
        }
        public int calls() { return calls; }
    }
    private static int[][] grouped(Course course, int lanes) {
        Map<Integer, int[]> byChampion = new HashMap<>();
        int[] champions = new int[lanes];
        for (int group = 0; group < lanes; group++) {
            int[] horses = new int[lanes];
            for (int i = 0; i < lanes; i++) horses[i] = group * lanes + i;
            int[] ranking = course.race(horses);
            champions[group] = ranking[0]; byChampion.put(ranking[0], ranking);
        }
        champions = course.race(champions);
        int[][] groups = new int[lanes][];
        for (int i = 0; i < lanes; i++) groups[i] = byChampion.get(champions[i]);
        return groups;
    }
    public static int[] topThree(Course course, int lanes) {
        if (lanes != 5 && lanes != 6) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        int[][] g = grouped(course, lanes);
        int[] finalRace = course.race(g[0][1], g[0][2], g[1][0], g[1][1], g[2][0]);
        return new int[]{g[0][0], finalRace[0], finalRace[1]};
    }
    // All variants return a set of fastest four; omit-B1 need not order the set.
    public static int[] topFour64(Course course, String omit) {
        int[][] g = grouped(course, 8);
        int a1=g[0][0], a2=g[0][1], a3=g[0][2], a4=g[0][3];
        int b1=g[1][0], b2=g[1][1], b3=g[1][2], c1=g[2][0], c2=g[2][1], d1=g[3][0];
        int excluded = switch (omit) { case "A4" -> a4; case "B3" -> b3; case "B1" -> b1; default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(); };
        int[] all = {a2,a3,a4,b1,b2,b3,c1,c2,d1};
        int[] eighth = Arrays.stream(all).filter(h -> h != excluded).toArray();
        int[] r = course.race(eighth);
        if (!omit.equals("B1")) {
            int predecessor = omit.equals("A4") ? a3 : b2;
            int third = r[2];
            if (r[1] == predecessor) third = course.race(r[2], excluded)[0];
            return new int[]{a1,r[0],r[1],third};
        }
        Set<Integer> knownSlower = Set.of(b2,b3,c1,c2,d1);
        if (knownSlower.contains(r[0]) || knownSlower.contains(r[1]) || knownSlower.contains(r[2]))
            return new int[]{a1,b1,r[0],r[1]};
        int[] last = course.race(a2,a3,a4,b1);
        return new int[]{a1,last[0],last[1],last[2]};
    }
}

public final class NineBalls {
    public record Defect(int ball, int delta) {}
    public static final class Scale {
        private final Defect hidden;
        public int calls;
        public Scale(Defect hidden) { this.hidden = hidden; }
        public int compare(int[] left, int[] right) {
            if (left.length != right.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unequal pan counts");
            calls++;
            int difference = 0;
            for (int x : left) if (x == hidden.ball()) difference += hidden.delta();
            for (int x : right) if (x == hidden.ball()) difference -= hidden.delta();
            return Integer.signum(difference);
        }
    }
    public static Defect solve(Scale scale) {
        int first = scale.compare(new int[]{1,2,3}, new int[]{4,5,6});
        if (first == 0) {
            int second = scale.compare(new int[]{7}, new int[]{8});
            if (second == 0) return new Defect(9, scale.compare(new int[]{9},new int[]{1}));
            int third = scale.compare(new int[]{7}, new int[]{1});
            return third != 0 ? new Defect(7,third) : new Defect(8,-second);
        }
        int[] heavy = first > 0 ? new int[]{1,2,3} : new int[]{4,5,6};
        int[] light = first > 0 ? new int[]{4,5,6} : new int[]{1,2,3};
        int second = scale.compare(new int[]{heavy[0],light[0]},new int[]{heavy[1],light[1]});
        int h = second > 0 ? heavy[0] : second < 0 ? heavy[1] : heavy[2];
        int l = second > 0 ? light[1] : second < 0 ? light[0] : light[2];
        return scale.compare(new int[]{h},new int[]{7}) > 0 ? new Defect(h,1) : new Defect(l,-1);
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int checked = 0;
        for (int ball = 1; ball <= 9; ball++) for (int delta : new int[]{-1,1}) {
            Defect expected = new Defect(ball,delta);
            Scale scale = new Scale(expected);
            if (!solve(scale).equals(expected) || scale.calls != 3) throw new AssertionError(expected);
            checked++;
        }
        System.out.println("PASS: " + checked + " heavy/light states; exactly three equal-count comparisons each");
    }
}

import java.util.*;
public final class Pirates {
    // -1 denotes death. Equal surviving payoff votes no in this explicitly chosen model.
    public static int[] solve(int n,int gold,boolean strictMajority) {
        if(n<1 || gold<0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        int[] result={gold};
        for(int people=2;people<=n;people++) {
            int[] next=result;
            int need=(strictMajority ? people/2+1 : (people/2+people%2))-1;
            Integer[] voters=new Integer[people-1];
            for(int i=0;i<voters.length;i++) voters[i]=i;
            Arrays.sort(voters,Comparator.comparingLong((Integer i)->next[i]<0?0L:(long)next[i]+1L).thenComparingInt(i->i));
            long cost=0; for(int j=0;j<need;j++) cost += next[voters[j]]<0?0L:(long)next[voters[j]]+1L;
            result=new int[people];
            if(cost>gold) {
                result[0]=-1; System.arraycopy(next,0,result,1,next.length);
            } else {
                result[0]=gold-(int)cost;
                for(int j=0;j<need;j++) result[voters[j]+1]=(int)(next[voters[j]]<0?0L:(long)next[voters[j]]+1L);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        for(boolean strict:new boolean[]{false,true}) for(int n=1;n<=10;n++) {
            int[] r=solve(n,100,strict);
            if(Arrays.stream(r).filter(x->x>=0).sum()!=100) throw new AssertionError();
            if(n>1 && r[0]>=0) {
                int[] next=solve(n-1,100,strict); int votes=1;
                for(int i=1;i<n;i++) if(next[i-1]<0 || r[i]>next[i-1]) votes++;
                if(votes<(strict?n/2+1:(n/2+n%2))) throw new AssertionError();
            }
            System.out.println((strict?">50% ":">=50% ")+n+" "+Arrays.toString(r));
        }
        if(!Arrays.equals(solve(10,100,false),new int[]{96,0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1,0})) throw new AssertionError();
        int max=Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        if(!Arrays.equals(solve(2,max,false),new int[]{max,0}) ||
           !Arrays.equals(solve(3,max,false),new int[]{max-1,0,1}) ||
           !Arrays.equals(solve(2,max,true),new int[]{-1,max}) ||
           !Arrays.equals(solve(3,max,true),new int[]{max,0,0})) throw new AssertionError("integer boundary");
        System.out.println("PASS: both thresholds, n=1..10, vote/coin invariants; Integer.MAX_VALUE gold at n=2,3");
    }
}

import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.IntSupplier;

public final class PuzzleModels {
    private PuzzleModels() {}
    public static int bitsForStates(long states) {
        if (states < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("states must be positive");
        return states == 1 ? 0 : 64 - Long.numberOfLeadingZeros(states - 1);
    }
    public record EggResult(int threshold, List<Integer> drops) {}
    public static EggResult twoEggs(int floors, int hiddenThreshold) {
        if (floors < 0 || hiddenThreshold < 0 || hiddenThreshold > floors) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        int budget = 0;
        while ((long) budget * (budget + 1) / 2 < floors) budget++;
        int low = 0, step = budget;
        List<Integer> drops = new ArrayList<>();
        while (low < floors) {
            int test = (int)Math.min((long)floors, (long)low + step--);
            drops.add(test);
            if (test > hiddenThreshold) {
                for (int candidate = low + 1; candidate < test; candidate++) {
                    drops.add(candidate);
                    if (candidate > hiddenThreshold) return new EggResult(candidate - 1, List.copyOf(drops));
                }
                return new EggResult(test - 1, List.copyOf(drops));
            }
            low = test;
        }
        return new EggResult(floors, List.copyOf(drops));
    }
    public record Water(int a, int b) {}
    public static List<Water> waterPath(int a, int b, int target) {
        if (a < 1 || b < 1 || target < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        Water start = new Water(0, 0);
        Map<Water, Water> previous = new HashMap<>();
        ArrayDeque<Water> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        previous.put(start, null); queue.add(start);
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            Water cur = queue.remove();
            if (cur.a == target || cur.b == target) {
                List<Water> path = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Water node = cur; node != null; node = previous.get(node)) path.add(node);
                Collections.reverse(path); return path;
            }
            int ab = Math.min(cur.a, b - cur.b), ba = Math.min(cur.b, a - cur.a);
            List<Water> next = List.of(new Water(a, cur.b), new Water(cur.a, b),
                new Water(0, cur.b), new Water(cur.a, 0),
                new Water(cur.a - ab, cur.b + ab), new Water(cur.a + ba, cur.b - ba));
            for (Water n : next) if (!previous.containsKey(n)) { previous.put(n, cur); queue.add(n); }
        }
        return List.of();
    }
    public static BigInteger choose(int n, int k) {
        if (n < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return BigInteger.ZERO;
        k = Math.min(k, n - k);
        BigInteger value = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) value = value.multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(n - k + i)).divide(BigInteger.valueOf(i));
        return value;
    }
    public static BigInteger distributeIdentical(int candy, int people) {
        if (candy < 0 || people < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        BigInteger[] dp = new BigInteger[candy + 1]; Arrays.fill(dp, BigInteger.ZERO); dp[0] = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (int person = 0; person < people; person++) {
            BigInteger[] next = new BigInteger[candy + 1]; Arrays.fill(next, BigInteger.ZERO);
            for (int used = 0; used <= candy; used++)
                for (int give = 0; used + give <= candy; give++) next[used + give] = next[used + give].add(dp[used]);
            dp = next;
        }
        return dp[candy];
    }
    public static BigInteger shotSequences(int shots, int target, int min, int max) {
        if (shots < 0 || target < 0 || min < 0 || max < min) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        BigInteger[] dp = new BigInteger[target + 1]; Arrays.fill(dp, BigInteger.ZERO); dp[0] = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (int i = 0; i < shots; i++) {
            BigInteger[] next = new BigInteger[target + 1]; Arrays.fill(next, BigInteger.ZERO);
            for (int total = 0; total <= target; total++)
                for (int score = min; score <= max && score <= target - total; score++) next[total + score] = next[total + score].add(dp[total]);
            dp = next;
        }
        return dp[target];
    }
    public static BigInteger ringWalks(int steps) {
        if (steps < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        BigInteger[] dp = new BigInteger[9]; Arrays.fill(dp, BigInteger.ZERO); dp[0] = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            BigInteger[] next = new BigInteger[9];
            for (int pos = 0; pos < 9; pos++) next[pos] = dp[(pos + 8) % 9].add(dp[(pos + 1) % 9]);
            dp = next;
        }
        return dp[0];
    }
    public static BigInteger ringByBinomial(int steps) {
        if (steps < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        BigInteger result = BigInteger.ZERO;
        for (int clockwise = 0; clockwise <= steps; clockwise++)
            if ((2L * clockwise - steps) % 9 == 0) result = result.add(choose(steps, clockwise));
        return result;
    }
    public static long integerSqrt(long n) {
        if (n < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        long lo = 0, hi = Math.min(n, 3_037_000_499L), answer = 0;
        while (lo <= hi) {
            long mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
            if (mid == 0 || mid <= n / mid) { answer = mid; lo = mid + 1; }
            else hi = mid - 1;
        }
        return answer;
    }
    public static BigInteger rectangleIntersection(long xa, long ya, long xb, long yb,
                                                    long xc, long yc, long xd, long yd) {
        if (xa > xb || ya > yb || xc > xd || yc > yd) throw new IllegalArgumentException("reversed corners");
        BigInteger width = BigInteger.valueOf(Math.min(xb, xd)).subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(Math.max(xa, xc))).max(BigInteger.ZERO);
        BigInteger height = BigInteger.valueOf(Math.min(yb, yd)).subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(Math.max(ya, yc))).max(BigInteger.ZERO);
        return width.multiply(height);
    }
    public static OptionalInt random7(IntSupplier random5, int maxPairs) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(random5);
        if (maxPairs < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        for (int i = 0; i < maxPairs; i++) {
            int a = random5.getAsInt(), b = random5.getAsInt();
            if (a < 0 || a > 4 || b < 0 || b > 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException("not a base-5 digit");
            int value = 5 * a + b;
            if (value < 21) return OptionalInt.of(value % 7);
        }
        return OptionalInt.empty();
    }
    public record PiEstimate(long inside, long samples, double estimate, double approximateStandardError) {}
    public static PiEstimate estimatePi(int samples, long seed) {
        if (samples < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        Random random = new Random(seed);
        long inside = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
            double x = random.nextDouble(), y = random.nextDouble();
            if (x * x + y * y <= 1) inside++;
        }
        double p = inside / (double)samples;
        return new PiEstimate(inside, samples, 4 * p, 4 * Math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / samples));
    }
    public record Fraction(BigInteger numerator, BigInteger denominator) {
        public Fraction {
            if (denominator.signum() == 0) throw new ArithmeticException("zero denominator");
            if (denominator.signum() < 0) { numerator = numerator.negate(); denominator = denominator.negate(); }
            BigInteger gcd = numerator.gcd(denominator); numerator = numerator.divide(gcd); denominator = denominator.divide(gcd);
        }
        public Fraction(long n, long d) { this(BigInteger.valueOf(n), BigInteger.valueOf(d)); }
        public Fraction add(Fraction b) { return new Fraction(numerator.multiply(b.denominator).add(b.numerator.multiply(denominator)), denominator.multiply(b.denominator)); }
        public Fraction subtract(Fraction b) { return add(new Fraction(b.numerator.negate(), b.denominator)); }
        public Fraction multiply(Fraction b) { return new Fraction(numerator.multiply(b.numerator), denominator.multiply(b.denominator)); }
        public Fraction divide(Fraction b) { return new Fraction(numerator.multiply(b.denominator), denominator.multiply(b.numerator)); }
        public double asDouble() { return numerator.doubleValue() / denominator.doubleValue(); }
        public String toString() { return numerator + "/" + denominator; }
    }
    public static Fraction firstWins(Fraction p, Fraction q) {
        Fraction one = new Fraction(1, 1);
        return p.divide(one.subtract(one.subtract(p).multiply(one.subtract(q))));
    }
    public static Fraction duelOnlySurvivor(Fraction p, Fraction q) {
        Fraction one = new Fraction(1, 1);
        return p.multiply(one.subtract(q)).divide(one.subtract(one.subtract(p).multiply(one.subtract(q))));
    }
    public static List<Fraction> threeShooters() {
        Fraction one = new Fraction(1,1), a = new Fraction(4,5), b = new Fraction(3,5), c = new Fraction(2,5);
        Fraction aLives = one.subtract(b).multiply(one.subtract(c)), bLives = one.subtract(a);
        Fraction ac = aLives.multiply(a), bc = one.subtract(aLives).multiply(bLives);
        Fraction all = aLives.multiply(bLives), onlyC = one.subtract(aLives).multiply(a);
        Fraction denom = one.subtract(all);
        Fraction finalA = ac.multiply(duelOnlySurvivor(a,c)).divide(denom);
        Fraction finalB = bc.multiply(duelOnlySurvivor(b,c)).divide(denom);
        Fraction finalC = onlyC.add(ac.multiply(duelOnlySurvivor(c,a))).add(bc.multiply(duelOnlySurvivor(c,b))).divide(denom);
        return List.of(finalA, finalB, finalC, one.subtract(finalA).subtract(finalB).subtract(finalC));
    }
}

        check(PuzzleModels.firstWins(half,half).equals(new PuzzleModels.Fraction(2,3)), "alternating coin");
        var result=PuzzleModels.threeShooters();
        check(result.equals(List.of(new PuzzleModels.Fraction(144,1309),new PuzzleModels.Fraction(9,119),new PuzzleModels.Fraction(904,1309),new PuzzleModels.Fraction(162,1309))), "shooter exact absorption");
        check(result.stream().reduce(new PuzzleModels.Fraction(0,1), PuzzleModels.Fraction::add).equals(new PuzzleModels.Fraction(1,1)), "probabilities sum one");
        int[] frequency=new int[7];int rejected=0;
        for(int a=0;a<5;a++)for(int b=0;b<5;b++) {
            int[] pair={a,b};int[] i={0};var r=PuzzleModels.random7(()->pair[i[0]++],1);
            if(r.isPresent())frequency[r.getAsInt()]++;else rejected++;
        }
        check(Arrays.stream(frequency).allMatch(x->x==3) && rejected==4, "random5 exact accepted counts");
        check(PuzzleModels.random7(()->4,100).isEmpty(), "rejection budget not biased fallback");
        var pi=PuzzleModels.estimatePi(200_000,20261011L);
        check(pi.inside()>0 && pi.inside()<pi.samples() && pi.estimate()>3 && pi.estimate()<3.3, "pi smoke not accuracy proof");
        System.out.println("pi demonstration="+pi);
        System.out.println("shooter absorption="+result);
    }
    private static void horses() {
        Random random=new Random(731);
        for(int lanes:new int[]{5,6,8})for(int trial=0;trial<10_000;trial++) {
            int n=lanes*lanes;int[] speeds=new int[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)speeds[i]=i;
            for(int i=n-1;i>0;i--){int j=random.nextInt(i+1),t=speeds[i];speeds[i]=speeds[j];speeds[j]=t;}
            Set<Integer> expected=new HashSet<>();int top=lanes==8?4:3;
            for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(speeds[i]>=n-top)expected.add(i);
            if(lanes<8) {
                var course=new HorseLab.Course(lanes,speeds);int[] answer=HorseLab.topThree(course,lanes);
                check(new HashSet<>(Arrays.stream(answer).boxed().toList()).equals(expected), "top3 set");
                check(speeds[answer[0]]>speeds[answer[1]] && speeds[answer[1]]>speeds[answer[2]], "top3 order");
                check(course.calls()==lanes+2, "top3 race count");
            } else for(String omit:List.of("A4","B3","B1")) {
                var course=new HorseLab.Course(8,speeds);int[] answer=HorseLab.topFour64(course,omit);
                check(new HashSet<>(Arrays.stream(answer).boxed().toList()).equals(expected), "64 horse set "+omit);
                check(course.calls()>=10 && course.calls()<=11, "64 horse upper bound");
            }
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        coding();resource();gamesAndCounting();probabilities();horses();
        System.out.println("PASS PuzzleContractTest "+checks+" checks");
    }
}

tests/SamplingChecks.java
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.IntSupplier;

// Local validation models. The supplied 16-bit generator must be IID uniform.
public final class SamplingChecks {
    private static int checks;
    private static void check(boolean ok, String name) { checks++; if (!ok) throw new AssertionError(name); }
    public static OptionalInt belowFrom16(IntSupplier random16, int bound, int maxPairs) {
        if (bound < 1 || maxPairs < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        long range = 1L << 32, limit = range / bound * bound;
        for (int i=0;i<maxPairs;i++) {
            int high=random16.getAsInt(), low=random16.getAsInt();
            if(high<0 || high>65535 || low<0 || low>65535)throw new IllegalArgumentException("not 16-bit output");
            long value=((long)high<<16)|low;
            if(value<limit)return OptionalInt.of((int)(value%bound));
        }
        return OptionalInt.empty();
    }
    public static Optional<int[]> sampleEmployees(int n,int k,IntSupplier random16,int maxPairsPerChoice) {
        if(n<0 || k<0 || k>n || maxPairsPerChoice<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        int[] ids=new int[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)ids[i]=i+1;
        for(int i=0;i<k;i++) {
            OptionalInt draw=belowFrom16(random16,n-i,maxPairsPerChoice);
            if(draw.isEmpty())return Optional.empty(); // no biased fallback or partial successful result
            int j=i+draw.getAsInt(), temp=ids[i];ids[i]=ids[j];ids[j]=temp;
        }
        return Optional.of(Arrays.copyOf(ids,k));
    }
    private static void shuffleLeaves(int[] a,int i,Map<String,Integer> counts) {
        if(i==0){counts.merge(Arrays.toString(a),1,Integer::sum);return;}
        for(int j=0;j<=i;j++) {
            int t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;
            shuffleLeaves(a,i-1,counts);
            t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Map<String,Integer> permutations=new HashMap<>();shuffleLeaves(new int[]{1,2,3},2,permutations);
        check(permutations.size()==6 && permutations.values().stream().allMatch(x->x==1), "six equal shuffle paths");
        Map<String,Integer> subsets=new HashMap<>();
        for(int j6=0;j6<6;j6++)for(int j7=0;j7<7;j7++) {
            int[] pool={1,2,3,4,5};if(j6<5)pool[j6]=6;if(j7<5)pool[j7]=7;
            Arrays.sort(pool);subsets.merge(Arrays.toString(pool),1,Integer::sum);
        }
        check(subsets.size()==21 && subsets.values().stream().allMatch(x->x==2), "reservoir 42 paths to 21 equal subsets");
        long range=1L<<32,limit=range/300000*300000;
        check(limit==4294800000L && range-limit==167296L,"16-bit rejection boundary");
        check(belowFrom16(()->65535,300000,2).isEmpty(),"all maximum rejected");
        check(belowFrom16(()->0,300000,1).orElseThrow()==0,"zero accepted");
        for(int bound=1;bound<=64;bound++) {
            int[] frequencies=new int[bound];int max=256/bound*bound;
            for(int x=0;x<max;x++)frequencies[x%bound]++;
            int expected=256/bound;
            check(Arrays.stream(frequencies).allMatch(x->x==expected),"small model exact no modulo bias");
        }
        Random random=new Random(20261011);
        for(int k:new int[]{100000,9999}) {
            int[] result=sampleEmployees(300000,k,()->random.nextInt(65536),100).orElseThrow();
            check(result.length==k,"employee sample size");
            check(Arrays.stream(result).allMatch(x->x>=1&&x<=300000),"employee ID range");
            check(Arrays.stream(result).distinct().count()==k,"no duplicate winners");
        }
        System.out.println("PASS SamplingChecks "+checks+" checks; uniformity proof is exact path counting, not sample frequency");
    }
}

title: 概率智力题：模型、证明与验证路线
html:
智力题与概率推理面试手册

智力题要先把条件说完整，再证明答案；一个可行方案、一个最优方案和一个平均表现好的方案，是三种不同结论。先说明对象、允许操作、能观察到的信息和优化目标，再给出不变量、下界或递推，最后用小例子验证，通常比直接报一个熟悉的数字更可靠。

本书覆盖编码与称量、随机数与概率、资源搬运、赛马、博弈、组合计数、几何与数量估算。每道题先给结论，再展开为什么成立、哪里会失效。附录包含完整 Java 模型和可运行检查，帮助把口头推理变成能复现的结果。模型测试用来发现边界错误，数学证明用来解释为什么成立，两者各有作用。

第 1 章 先决定自己究竟在回答什么

一个正确答案必须同时满足题设和目标，不能靠补出自己熟悉的经典题来获得确定数字。面试时可以很简短地确认：“这里是求最坏次数，还是平均次数？每次能看到排名还是时间？相同收益时参与者会怎么选择？”这些问题会真正改变答案。

读题时，先把会改变答案的四件事分开：

- 输入状态：恰好一瓶异常，还是可能没有或有多瓶异常。状态数变了，编码对象就变了。

- 允许操作：水只能倒到一桶满或空，不能凭目测停在任意刻度。一个算得出来的中间量，不一定做得出来。

- 可观察结果：天平有三种结果，但不是任意三分都能由实际称量实现。信息够多，还要能设计出对应操作。

- 优化目标：是找出某个对象、找出前几名的集合、给出完整排序，还是最小化期望代价。一个方案满足其中一项，不代表满足其他目标。

证明最优要走两步：信息量下界说明少于某次数不够，具体构造说明这些次数足够；两者相遇才得到最优。只有构造时，可以说“这些次数能做到”，还不能说“谁都不可能更少”。随机测试做了很多次，也不能代替所有输入上的最优性证明。

概率与博弈也先检查推理入口：概率题没给独立性，不能直接把两个概率相乘；博弈题没给偏好，不能把“大家都理性”当成一个完整收益函数。

题目只有“智力题”“逻辑题”或“用 Python 写一道概率题”时，缺少对象、约束和目标，无法求解一个确定问题。适当的回应是请补充题干，而不是选择一道常见题代为回答。下面每个计算都明确给出了自己使用的模型。

第 17 章 面试复述与验证路线

先报带条件的结论，再给最关键的一条推理，最后用反例说明条件为什么必要。比如“独立同分布的偏硬币可用 HT/TH 提取公平结果；两条路径概率相同；如果只允许两次且必须结束，未知偏置下不可能”就是一段完整而紧凑的回答。

复习时可以按四组练习：

1. 下界与构造：1000 个候选为何至少十位；八球两次与九球三次为何不同；金条块数如何对应子集数；两蛋十四次怎样既必要又足够。

2. 不变量与状态：香蕉何时换阶段；水桶哪些操作合法；赛马淘汰时有哪些更快证据；报数、取书、石子和灯泡各保持什么关系。

3. 概率与收益：公平是无条件还是条件概率；硬币游戏有没有未结束状态；枪手是首轮存活还是最终独活；海盗平利时如何投票。

4. 计数与模型：糖是否相同；打靶是否区分先后及是否允许零环；九位置圆环为什么奇数步也可能回原点；矩形是否旋转；估算参数哪些是已知、哪些是假设。

验证方法要匹配正在证明的结论。附录中，九球穷举所有隐藏状态，鸡蛋穷举所有阈值，随机数转换枚举一轮全部结果；糖果、打靶、圆环用两种独立公式或 DP 对照；赛马用固定种子的互异速度排列验证构造分支。它们分别是穷举、独立公式和模拟，不是同一种证据。

复习可以先选一个条件自己推，再看对应检查：例如九球只改异常方向，重新跟一遍候选集合；鸡蛋把阈值设在两个跳点之间，先写出 drops；抽样把停止条件改成“新记录入池就停”，说明公平性在哪一步失效。卡住时只回到缺失的前提、状态转移或边界，再换一个条件回答。

随机模拟不能证明随机源真的均匀，也不能证明赛马方案全局最优。观察失败信息时，不要只增加更多随机次数；要指出哪条推理或哪一个实现契约需要修正。

附录 完整 Java 模型与检查程序

将下列文件按目录保存，在 Java 21 环境运行 run-tests.sh。也可以用 javac 编译 java 和 tests 目录的全部 Java 文件，再分别运行各个测试主类。程序只在本地模拟抽象模型；随机源在需要时从参数传入，失败或预算耗尽不会被冒充为一个公平结果。

- NineBalls：完整三次天平决策树，以及十八个隐藏状态的检查

- FairCoin：四种二次抛掷结果、有限重试、未决与零预算

- Pirates：两种投票阈值的完整逆推、金币守恒与票数检查

- PuzzleModels：编码、鸡蛋、水桶、计数、几何、灯泡、随机转换与有理数概率

- HorseLab：每场只允许合法数量参赛的赛道模型和三种六十四马构造

- PuzzleContractTest：将模型与边界、独立公式和直接排序答案对照

- SamplingChecks：有限路径计数，以及三十万员工两种抽样规模的本地检查

保留完整来源代码和题设变体。本批仅做结构与来源保真验证，未运行 Java、Node、Python 或 Bash 教学代码；测试参数、PASS 文本和命令均不是本轮实际运行结果。证明、穷举与随机模拟的证据范围不同。

items.q: 自由文本采购请求的 Java 抽取边界确认与只读预检
items.a:
本质自由文本采购预检可以完整实现为 Extractor、严格候选校验、申报确认、确定性政策和同源报告五个环节；本程序已把这些环节串接为可运行 Java，演示抽取器是明确标记的离线替身，不宣称调用过真实模型或理解任意自然语言。

本节保留教学来源的条件、示例和代码。原文“通过”、测试数量、性能数字与运行命令不代表本批实际执行或个人项目成绩；本批只做来源保真与隔离的站点内容编译，没有运行导入程序。混合来源中的纯前端或推荐课程已单独排除；理论与场景的完整程序、夹具只存来源归档，不进入学习导航。实际算法与手撕代码如有裁切会明确注明。

自由文本采购请求的 Java 抽取边界确认与只读预检

自由文本采购预检可以完整实现为 Extractor、严格候选校验、申报确认、确定性政策和同源报告五个环节；本程序已把这些环节串接为可运行 Java，演示抽取器是明确标记的离线替身，不宣称调用过真实模型或理解任意自然语言。

常见问法与题意： 读入员工的一句话采购请求与员工信息，检查安全、完整性、权限，并按每个内部动作输出“可以做、不可以做、需要审批、需要补充信息”的 JSON 及中文解释。题目明确只做下单前安全检查。换问包括：“不用固定模板怎么接？”“模型伪造 approved 会怎样？”“预算上限被当成单价怎么办？”“没接员工 API 能否演示？”“模型超时后会不会默认允许？”

两项输入与信任边界

业务入口为 Engine.check(rawRequest, trustedEmployee, confirmation)。rawRequest 是自由文本，不要求员工按照固定字段顺序重写。Employee 对象由调用方提供可信身份、在职状态、能力集合和额度；调用方已经提供员工信息时，这个受信对象就足够完成演示。接真实单点登录、员工 API 或采购服务不是本题的前置要求。

Extractor 只能收到 rawRequest，返回候选 JSON；它看不到员工权限、额度、身份凭据或审批材料。这里提供的 FixtureExtractor 仅按四个明确样例返回预设结果，其他句子返回空结果。它是故障与边界验收的受控替身，不是规则伪装的通用语义模型。

模型、员工原话和候选中的 claimed_approval 都不能授予权限。候选 schema 根本不接收 role、capabilities、approved、decision 或执行指令。替换抽取器也无法给预检器增加下单接口：代码没有模型 HTTP 客户端、采购 SDK、网络请求、数据库写入或动作调度器。

不可信候选怎样进入规则

候选根对象必须恰好有 items、ambiguities、claimed_approval 三个键。每条明细保留 description、catalog_id、quantity、unit、amount、amount_kind、currency、purpose 和 evidence；缺失槽位必须显式为 null。evidence 为每个槽位保留本次原文片段，存在字段必须有片段，缺失字段的片段也为 null。目录 ID 可由描述提出，但仍是待核对的候选。

解析器限制 32768 个 UTF-16 字符、10 层嵌套和 2048 个 JSON 值；拒绝重复键、尾随内容、异常 Unicode 转义、未知键和类型错误。明细数为 1..8，数量为 1..10000 的精确整数，金额必须为正的十进制字符串，最多九位整数与两位小数，不能用 double 或隐式默认零。可解析币种为 CNY、USD、EUR；教学政策只处理 CNY，同一候选混币种直接判为候选无效。金额只用 BigDecimal 计算。

UNIT_PRICE 表示申报单价，UNIT_CAP 表示单件预算上限。只有每条明细都有数量、申报单价和人民币币种时，才能给出 declared_total_cny；预算上限不会变成确定应付金额。这个 total 仍是待核验申报总额，不能替代报价。型号未知、单位与目录不同、未说明包装换算、价格或用途缺失时保持补信息。

原文片段只能证明字段有可核对的出处，不能证明模型解释正确。比如模型把“不超过”误写为 UNIT_PRICE，schema 仍可能合法；程序因此把所有影响草稿的候选先设为未确认。确认前可在有权限时查询目录资格，但不会把申报视为已核实。

确认绑定具体候选但不代表审批

报告展示全部候选及其证据，同时给出 candidate_id。该标识绑定本次原文、受信员工 ID、策略版本和规范化候选内容。确认必须由已认证的调用方从员工明确核对动作传入；不能从模型 JSON 或采购文字提取。CLI 的 --confirm 仅用于演示这个传参边界，不是员工认证系统。

candidate_id 只能确认它绑定的原文、员工、策略和候选；任一项变化，旧标识都不能确认新候选。每次仍用当前 Employee 重算权限与额度，确认不会缓存授权。

确认也不会消除 ambiguities、补上缺字段、把预算上限改成单价，或让越权动作获准。可以沿“候选已确认后，员工权限改变”这一条件练习重新判断；有歧义时只追问相关槽位，修正请求并重新抽取，不要求员工重填无关信息。

每个动作独立决定状态并保留原因

教学策略提供 lookup_catalog、create_draft、request_approval、place_order 四个动作名称。catalog 能力负责目录查询，request 能力负责采购申请相关动作。KB-1、MON-1、PAPER-1 是演示目录项，其单位分别为个、台、包；DEMO-FORBIDDEN 是用于测试明确禁止条件的虚构项。这些目录、能力和额度规则不是任何公司的真实制度。

每动作的主状态优先级是已知禁止、需要补信息、需要审批、可以做。失效员工、缺相应能力或命中明确禁止目录项先拒绝；同时存在缺字段时，missing 和其他原因仍保留。没有数量不妨碍有权限的目录查询，但会阻止有效草稿；未知目录或未能理解的表达不猜测放行。

候选完整且已确认时，创建待核验草稿资格和提交审批资格可以为 ALLOWED。提交审批资格允许只意味着下一步可以提交，不表示已经提交或获批。place_order 即使申报完整、金额在额度内，也仍为 NEEDS_APPROVAL，因为受信核价、预算与用途审核、绑定明细与版本的有效批准尚未提供。超过额度会增加 OVER_LIMIT 原因；员工说“领导批过了”只保留为 CLAIM_NOT_APPROVAL。

所有动作都只是资格判断，程序没有实际查询目录、创建草稿、提交审批或下单。Report 固定 report_only=true；JSON 和中文解释来自同一组 Decision，不让模型把“需要审批”自由改写成“已买好”。

超时故障与资源上限

输入最大 4096 个 UTF-16 字符，CLI 先限制 UTF-8 字节并拒绝非法编码。空请求返回补信息，过长或非法控制字符拒绝；受信员工不可用时不调用抽取器。抽取空结果、异常、超时、中断、繁忙或非法候选均有稳定原因码，不回退为默认允许。用户没有某动作权限时，即便抽取同时失败，该动作仍保留拒绝主状态。

Engine 用两个固定工作线程和两个排队槽位限制抽取任务，服务应复用同一个 Engine，不能每次请求无限新建池。等待超时会取消任务，但 Java 中断是合作式的：忽略中断的适配器不能被强制终止，池上限只是限制可同时被占用的工作线程数量。

因此真实适配器仍须在传输层限制连接、读取截止时间和响应字节，之后才返回有限字符串。读这段实现时，把“调用方不再等待”和“外部工作已停止”分开判断；本样例没有真实外部调用，不作网络性能承诺。

替换 Extractor 的完整接入位置

实现 Extractor.extract(String) 并返回上述严格候选 JSON，然后将该对象传入 new Engine(extractor, timeoutMillis)，即可沿用同一个 check 调用、校验器、确认和政策；替换后无需也不应把模型返回值直接传给执行工具。这里提供完整可调用边界与完整离线实现，没有以空接口代替整条流程。

真实模型适配器应使用固定抽取任务和输出 schema，把原话隔离为数据，限制返回体、日志字段和重试次数，不拼接员工令牌，不包含购买工具。没有提供或调用真实模型凭据。自由文本准确率另需真实抽取验收集，覆盖同义表达、中文数字、箱与包换算、否定更正、多商品、上下文指代、无关插话和提示注入。离线替身测试能证明候选如何被处理，不能证明真实模型理解这些表达。
