import java.util.*;

/** Single-threaded educational HNSW, squared L2, append-only IDs.
 * Geometric p=1/M levels capped at16; M links selected/new node,
 * caps 2M at level0 and M above; diversity selection with rejected refill.
 * No deletion, persistence, filters, concurrent mutation or production claims.
 */
public final class MiniHnsw {
    public record Neighbor(int id,double squaredDistance){}
    private static final Comparator<Neighbor> NEAR=Comparator.comparingDouble(Neighbor::squaredDistance).thenComparingInt(Neighbor::id);
    private static final class Node {
        final double[] vector;final List<List<Integer>> links=new ArrayList<>();
        Node(double[] v,int level){vector=v.clone();for(int i=0;i<=level;i++)links.add(new ArrayList<>());}
        int level(){return links.size()-1;}
    }
    private final int dimension,m,constructionEf;private final Random random;private final List<Node> nodes=new ArrayList<>();
    private int entry=-1,maxLevel=-1;
    public MiniHnsw(int dimension,int m,int constructionEf,long seed){
        if(dimension<1||dimension>1024||m<2||m>1_000_000||constructionEf<m)throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid dimensions/M/efConstruction");
        this.dimension=dimension;this.m=m;this.constructionEf=constructionEf;random=new Random(seed);
    }
    private void validate(double[] vector){Objects.requireNonNull(vector);if(vector.length!=dimension)throw new IllegalArgumentException("dimension mismatch");for(double v:vector)if(!Double.isFinite(v)||Math.abs(v)>1e100)throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonfinite/out-of-range component");}
    private static double distance(double[] a,double[] b){double sum=0;for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){double delta=a[i]-b[i];sum+=delta*delta;}return sum;}
    private Neighbor neighbor(double[] q,int id){return new Neighbor(id,distance(q,nodes.get(id).vector));}
    private List<Neighbor> searchLayer(double[] q,List<Integer> starts,int ef,int level){
        PriorityQueue<Neighbor> candidates=new PriorityQueue<>(NEAR),best=new PriorityQueue<>(NEAR.reversed());Set<Integer> visited=new HashSet<>();
        for(int id:starts)if(visited.add(id)){Neighbor n=neighbor(q,id);candidates.add(n);best.add(n);if(best.size()>ef)best.remove();}
        while(!candidates.isEmpty()){
            Neighbor current=candidates.remove();
            if(best.size()==ef && current.squaredDistance>best.peek().squaredDistance)break;
            for(int id:nodes.get(current.id).links.get(level))if(visited.add(id)){
                Neighbor candidate=neighbor(q,id);
                if(best.size()<ef||NEAR.compare(candidate,best.peek())<0){candidates.add(candidate);best.add(candidate);if(best.size()>ef)best.remove();}
            }
        }
        List<Neighbor> result=new ArrayList<>(best);result.sort(NEAR);return result;
    }
    /** Candidate extension disabled, keepPrunedConnections enabled. */
    private List<Integer> select(double[] center,List<Neighbor> candidates,int limit){
        List<Neighbor> sorted=new ArrayList<>(candidates);sorted.sort(NEAR);List<Integer> selected=new ArrayList<>(),discarded=new ArrayList<>();
        for(Neighbor c:sorted){
            if(selected.size()==limit)break;boolean diverse=true;
            for(int other:selected)if(distance(nodes.get(c.id).vector,nodes.get(other).vector)<c.squaredDistance){diverse=false;break;}
            if(diverse)selected.add(c.id);else discarded.add(c.id);
        }
        for(int id:discarded){if(selected.size()==limit)break;selected.add(id);}
        return selected;
    }
    private static List<Integer> ids(List<Neighbor> result){List<Integer> out=new ArrayList<>();for(Neighbor n:result)out.add(n.id);return out;}
    public int add(double[] vector){
        validate(vector);int level=0;while(level<16 && random.nextDouble()<1.0/m)level++;
        int id=nodes.size();nodes.add(new Node(vector,level));
        if(entry<0){entry=id;maxLevel=level;return id;}
        List<Integer> starts=List.of(entry);
        for(int l=maxLevel;l>level;l--)starts=List.of(searchLayer(vector,starts,1,l).get(0).id);
        for(int l=Math.min(level,maxLevel);l>=0;l--){
            List<Neighbor> candidates=searchLayer(vector,starts,constructionEf,l);List<Integer> chosen=select(vector,candidates,m);
            nodes.get(id).links.get(l).addAll(chosen);
            for(int other:chosen){
                List<Integer> links=nodes.get(other).links.get(l);links.add(id);int cap=l==0?2*m:m;
                if(links.size()>cap){List<Neighbor> options=new ArrayList<>();for(int target:links)options.add(neighbor(nodes.get(other).vector,target));List<Integer> kept=select(nodes.get(other).vector,options,cap);links.clear();links.addAll(kept);}
            }
            starts=ids(candidates);
        }
        if(level>maxLevel){entry=id;maxLevel=level;}
        return id;
    }
    public List<Neighbor> search(double[] query,int k,int efSearch){
        validate(query);if(k<0||efSearch<Math.max(1,k))throw new IllegalArgumentException("efSearch >= max(1,k)");
        if(k==0||entry<0)return List.of();List<Integer> starts=List.of(entry);
        for(int l=maxLevel;l>0;l--)starts=List.of(searchLayer(query,starts,1,l).get(0).id);
        List<Neighbor> result=searchLayer(query,starts,efSearch,0);return List.copyOf(result.subList(0,Math.min(k,result.size())));
    }
    private List<Neighbor> exact(double[] query,int k){List<Neighbor> out=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<nodes.size();i++)out.add(neighbor(query,i));out.sort(NEAR);return out.subList(0,Math.min(k,out.size()));}
    private void invariant(){
        int max=-1;for(int id=0;id<nodes.size();id++){Node n=nodes.get(id);max=Math.max(max,n.level());for(int l=0;l<=n.level();l++){List<Integer> links=n.links.get(l);if(links.size()>(l==0?2*m:m)||new HashSet<>(links).size()!=links.size())throw new AssertionError("degree/duplicate");for(int to:links)if(to==id||to<0||to>=nodes.size()||nodes.get(to).level()<l)throw new AssertionError("invalid edge");}}
        if(max!=maxLevel||(entry>=0&&nodes.get(entry).level()!=maxLevel))throw new AssertionError("entry level");
    }
    private static double[] vector(Random r,int d){double[] v=new double[d];for(int i=0;i<d;i++)v[i]=r.nextDouble()*2-1;return v;}
    public static void main(String[] args){
        Random r=new Random(965);int exactQueries=0;
        for(int repeat=0;repeat<20;repeat++){
            MiniHnsw index=new MiniHnsw(4,64,64,repeat);
            if(!index.search(new double[4],5,64).isEmpty())throw new AssertionError();

            for(int j=0;j<100;j++){double[] q=vector(r,4);if(!index.search(q,10,64).equals(index.exact(q,10)))throw new AssertionError("exact complete-graph case");exactQueries++;}
        }
        MiniHnsw approximate=new MiniHnsw(8,6,30,123);for(int i=0;i<500;i++)approximate.add(vector(r,8));approximate.invariant();
        int recall10=0,recall40=0;
        for(int qn=0;qn<200;qn++){
            double[] q=vector(r,8);Set<Integer> truth=new HashSet<>(ids(approximate.exact(q,10)));
            List<Neighbor> low=approximate.search(q,10,10),high=approximate.search(q,10,40);
            for(Neighbor n:low)if(truth.contains(n.id))recall10++;for(Neighbor n:high)if(truth.contains(n.id))recall40++;
            for(List<Neighbor> result:List.of(low,high)){if(new HashSet<>(ids(result)).size()!=result.size())throw new AssertionError();for(int i=0;i<result.size();i++){Neighbor n=result.get(i);if(!n.equals(approximate.neighbor(q,n.id)))throw new AssertionError();if(i>0 && NEAR.compare(result.get(i-1),n)>0)throw new AssertionError();}}
        }

        if(trap.search(new double[]{0},1,1).get(0).id!=0||trap.search(new double[]{0},1,3).get(0).id!=2)throw new AssertionError("controlled local-minimum counterexample");

"""Complete local cosine FAISS construction example. FAISS is imported only at execution.
No installation, remote service, permission service, or production persistence is included.
"""
import numpy as np

def normalized_matrix(rows, dimension):
    if not isinstance(dimension, int) or isinstance(dimension, bool) or not 1 <= dimension <= 4096:
        raise ValueError("dimension")
    matrix = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float64)
    if matrix.ndim != 2 or matrix.shape[1] != dimension or not 1 <= len(matrix) <= 50000:
        raise ValueError("shape or bounded batch")
    if not np.isfinite(matrix).all():
        raise ValueError("non-finite")
    scales = np.max(np.abs(matrix), axis=1, keepdims=True)
    if (scales == 0).any():
        raise ValueError("zero vector")
    scaled = matrix / scales
    unit = scaled / np.sqrt(np.sum(scaled * scaled, axis=1, keepdims=True))
    return np.ascontiguousarray(unit, dtype=np.float32)

def stable_ids(ids, count):
    values = np.asarray(ids)
    if values.ndim != 1 or len(values) != count or values.dtype.kind not in "iu":
        raise ValueError("integer id shape")
    if (values < 0).any() or (values > np.iinfo(np.int64).max).any() or len(np.unique(values)) != count:
        raise ValueError("negative/duplicate/out-of-range id")
    return np.ascontiguousarray(values, dtype=np.int64)

def build(rows, ids, dimension, *, nlist=None, nprobe=1):
    """Call only with a trusted, already authorized corpus snapshot."""
    matrix = normalized_matrix(rows, dimension)
    identifiers = stable_ids(ids, len(matrix))
    if nlist is not None and (not isinstance(nlist, int) or isinstance(nlist, bool) or not 1 <= nlist <= len(matrix)):
        raise ValueError("nlist")
    if nlist is not None and (not isinstance(nprobe, int) or isinstance(nprobe, bool) or not 1 <= nprobe <= nlist):
        raise ValueError("nprobe")
    import faiss
    if nlist is None:
        index = faiss.IndexIDMap2(faiss.IndexFlatIP(dimension))
    else:
        quantizer = faiss.IndexFlatIP(dimension)
        index = faiss.IndexIVFFlat(quantizer, dimension, nlist, faiss.METRIC_INNER_PRODUCT)
        index.train(matrix)  # Real workloads need a representative training sample.
        index.nprobe = nprobe
    index.add_with_ids(matrix, identifiers)
    return index

def query(index, rows, dimension, k):
    if not isinstance(k, int) or isinstance(k, bool) or not 1 <= k <= 50000:
        raise ValueError("k")
    if index.d != dimension:
        raise ValueError("index dimension")
    queries = normalized_matrix(rows, dimension)
    distances, ids = index.search(queries, k)
    # FAISS may pad missing neighbors with -1; never treat -1 as a document ID.
    return [[(int(i), float(s)) for i, s in zip(row_ids, row_scores) if i >= 0]
            for row_ids, row_scores in zip(ids, distances)]

def demo():
    random = np.random.default_rng(17003)
    rows = random.normal(size=(512, 8))
    ids = np.arange(1000, 1512, dtype=np.int64)
    exact = build(rows, ids, 8)
    approximate = build(rows, ids, 8, nlist=8, nprobe=2)
    return {"flat": query(exact, rows[:2], 8, 5),
            "ivf": query(approximate, rows[:2], 8, 5)}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(demo())

import java.util.*;

public final class RankFusion {
    private RankFusion() {}
    public record Hit(String id, double score) {}
    // Ranks use the original first occurrence's 1-based position in each list.
    public static List<Hit> rrf(List<List<String>> rankings,
                               double[] weights, double c, int topK) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(rankings);
        Objects.requireNonNull(weights);
        if (weights.length != rankings.size() || !Double.isFinite(c)
                || c <= 0 || topK < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        Map<String, Double> scores = new HashMap<>();
        for (int channel = 0; channel < rankings.size(); channel++) {
            double w = weights[channel];
            if (!Double.isFinite(w) || w < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
            List<String> list = Objects.requireNonNull(rankings.get(channel));
            Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
                String id = Objects.requireNonNull(list.get(i));
                if (id.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("empty id");
                if (!seen.add(id)) continue;
                double score = scores.getOrDefault(id, 0.0) + w / (c + i + 1.0);
                if (!Double.isFinite(score)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("overflow");
                scores.put(id, score);
            }
        }
        List<Hit> out = new ArrayList<>();
        scores.forEach((id, score) -> out.add(new Hit(id, score)));
        out.sort(Comparator.comparingDouble(Hit::score).reversed().thenComparing(Hit::id));
        return new ArrayList<>(out.subList(0, Math.min(topK, out.size())));
    }
}

import java.util.*;
public final class RetrievalSelection {
    public record Hit(String id,String parent,String version,double score,int tokens){public Hit{Objects.requireNonNull(id);Objects.requireNonNull(parent);Objects.requireNonNull(version);if(id.isEmpty()||parent.isEmpty()||version.isEmpty()||!Double.isFinite(score)||tokens<=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException();}}
    private record Key(String id,String version) {}
    private static final Comparator<Hit> BEST=Comparator.comparingDouble(Hit::score).reversed().thenComparing(Hit::id).thenComparing(Hit::version);
    // Caller supplies only currently authorized, active-version candidates; this is not an ACL check.
    public static List<Hit> topK(List<Hit> candidates,int k){Objects.requireNonNull(candidates);if(k<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException();Map<Key,Hit> unique=new HashMap<>();for(Hit h:candidates){Objects.requireNonNull(h);Key key=new Key(h.id,h.version);Hit old=unique.get(key);if(old!=null&&(!old.parent.equals(h.parent)||old.tokens!=h.tokens))throw new IllegalArgumentException("conflicting metadata");if(old==null||h.score>old.score)unique.put(key,h);}if(k==0)return List.of();PriorityQueue<Hit> heap=new PriorityQueue<>(BEST.reversed());for(Hit h:unique.values()){if(heap.size()<k)heap.add(h);else if(BEST.compare(h,heap.peek())<0){heap.remove();heap.add(h);}}List<Hit> result=new ArrayList<>(heap);result.sort(BEST);return result;}
    // Greedy by rank with distinct parent/version, threshold and token cap; NOT global knapsack optimum.
    public static List<Hit> evidence(List<Hit> candidates,int maxChunks,int tokenBudget,double threshold){if(maxChunks<0||tokenBudget<0||!Double.isFinite(threshold))throw new IllegalArgumentException();List<Hit> out=new ArrayList<>();Set<Key> parents=new HashSet<>();int remaining=tokenBudget;for(Hit h:topK(candidates,candidates.size())){if(out.size()==maxChunks)break;if(h.score<threshold)break;Key key=new Key(h.parent,h.version);if(parents.contains(key)||h.tokens>remaining)continue;out.add(h);parents.add(key);remaining-=h.tokens;}return out;}
    public static void main(String[] args){Random random=new Random(369);for(int t=0;t<3000;t++){List<Hit> input=new ArrayList<>();Map<String,Hit> oracle=new HashMap<>();for(int i=0,n=random.nextInt(80);i<n;i++){int id=random.nextInt(20);Hit h=new Hit("c"+id,"p"+(id/3),"v1",random.nextInt(10),id+1);input.add(h);Hit old=oracle.get(h.id);if(old==null||h.score>old.score)oracle.put(h.id,h);}List<Hit> sorted=new ArrayList<>(oracle.values());sorted.sort(BEST);List<Hit> before=List.copyOf(input);for(int k=0;k<25;k++)if(!topK(input,k).equals(sorted.subList(0,Math.min(k,sorted.size()))))throw new AssertionError();if(!input.equals(before))throw new AssertionError();}List<Hit> hits=List.of(new Hit("a","p1","v1",.9,11),new Hit("b","p1","v1",.8,4),new Hit("c","p2","v1",.7,3),new Hit("d","p3","v1",.6,4));if(!evidence(hits,3,7,.65).equals(List.of(hits.get(1),hits.get(2)))||!evidence(hits,3,7,.95).isEmpty())throw new AssertionError();System.out.println("PASS 75000 topK versus full-sort cases; identity dedup/stable ties/k0/nonmutation; threshold/token/parent selection");}
}

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.*;

/** Complete local teaching contract. No model, JSON parser, semantic entailment or device control. */
public final class DiagnosisContract {
    private DiagnosisContract() {}
    public enum Kind { SOP, CASE }
    public enum Likelihood { POSSIBLE, MORE_LIKELY }
    public record Fact(String id, BigDecimal value, String unit) {
        public Fact { text(id); Objects.requireNonNull(value); text(unit); }
    }
    public record Evidence(String id, String tenant, String snapshot, String source,
                           String revision, String position, String hash, Kind kind) {
        public Evidence { text(id);text(tenant);text(snapshot);text(source);text(revision);
            text(position);text(hash);Objects.requireNonNull(kind); }
    }
    public record Check(String id, String approvedText) {
        public Check { text(id);text(approvedText); }
    }
    public record Cause(String text, Likelihood likelihood, List<String> evidence) {
        public Cause { DiagnosisContract.text(text);Objects.requireNonNull(likelihood);
            evidence=ids(evidence,8,true); }
    }
    public record RecommendedCheck(String checkId, List<String> evidence) {
        public RecommendedCheck { text(checkId);evidence=ids(evidence,8,true); }
    }
    public record DiagnosisDraft(List<Cause> possibleCauses,
                                 List<RecommendedCheck> recommendedChecks,
                                 List<String> factRefs, List<String> pendingConfirmations,
                                 boolean insufficientEvidence) {
        public DiagnosisDraft {
            possibleCauses=List.copyOf(possibleCauses);
            recommendedChecks=List.copyOf(recommendedChecks);
            if(possibleCauses.size()>8||recommendedChecks.size()>8)fail("draft budget");
            factRefs=ids(factRefs,32,false);
            pendingConfirmations=ids(pendingConfirmations,16,false);
        }
    }
    public record Snapshot(String tenant, String id, Map<String,Fact> facts,
                           Map<String,Evidence> shownEvidence, Map<String,Check> allowedChecks) {
        public Snapshot {
            text(tenant);text(id);facts=Map.copyOf(facts);shownEvidence=Map.copyOf(shownEvidence);
            allowedChecks=Map.copyOf(allowedChecks);
            facts.forEach((k,v)->{if(!k.equals(v.id()))fail("fact identity");});
            allowedChecks.forEach((k,v)->{if(!k.equals(v.id()))fail("check identity");});
            for(var e:shownEvidence.entrySet()) {
                Evidence v=e.getValue();
                if(!e.getKey().equals(v.id())||!tenant.equals(v.tenant())||!id.equals(v.snapshot()))
                    fail("evidence identity/snapshot");
            }
        }
    }
    /** Caller has freshly re-read current grants, source eligibility, check applicability and alarm epoch. */
    public record CurrentView(boolean sameAlarmEpoch, Set<String> eligibleEvidence,
                              Set<String> applicableChecks) {
        public CurrentView { eligibleEvidence=Set.copyOf(eligibleEvidence);
            applicableChecks=Set.copyOf(applicableChecks); }
    }
    public record Checked(List<Cause> hypotheses, List<Check> checks, List<Fact> facts,
                          List<String> pending, boolean insufficient, boolean requiresHumanReview) {}
    private static void text(String s) { if(s==null||s.isBlank()||s.length()>2000)fail("text"); }
    private static void fail(String s) { throw new IllegalArgumentException(s); }
    private static List<String> ids(List<String> values,int max,boolean nonempty) {
        List<String> copy=List.copyOf(values);
        if(copy.size()>max||(nonempty&&copy.isEmpty()))fail("list budget");
        Set<String> seen=new HashSet<>();
        for(String s:copy){text(s);if(!seen.add(s))fail("duplicate identity");}
        return copy;
    }
    private static void noGeneratedNumbers(String s) {
        if(s.codePoints().anyMatch(Character::isDigit))fail("numbers must come from fact references");
    }
    private static boolean evidence(List<String> refs,Snapshot s,CurrentView now) {
        boolean sop=false;
        for(String id:refs) {
            Evidence e=s.shownEvidence().get(id);
            if(e==null||!now.eligibleEvidence().contains(id))fail("unseen, revoked or stale evidence");
            sop |= e.kind()==Kind.SOP;
        }
        return sop;
    }
    public static Checked verify(DiagnosisDraft draft, Snapshot s, CurrentView now) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(draft);Objects.requireNonNull(s);Objects.requireNonNull(now);
        if(!now.sameAlarmEpoch())fail("alarm changed; re-evaluate publication");
        if(draft.insufficientEvidence()&&(!draft.recommendedChecks().isEmpty()
                ||draft.pendingConfirmations().isEmpty()))fail("insufficient evidence must be actionable only as clarification");
        List<Fact> facts=new ArrayList<>();
        for(String id:draft.factRefs()) {
            Fact f=s.facts().get(id);if(f==null)fail("unknown measurement");facts.add(f);
        }
        for(Cause c:draft.possibleCauses()) {
            noGeneratedNumbers(c.text());evidence(c.evidence(),s,now);
        }
        List<Check> checks=new ArrayList<>();Set<String> selected=new HashSet<>();
        for(RecommendedCheck c:draft.recommendedChecks()) {
            Check approved=s.allowedChecks().get(c.checkId());
            if(approved==null||!now.applicableChecks().contains(c.checkId())||!selected.add(c.checkId()))
                fail("unknown, duplicate or inapplicable check");
            if(!evidence(c.evidence(),s,now))fail("a historical case alone cannot authorize an operational check");
            checks.add(approved);
        }
        // IDs, eligibility and literal numbers cannot establish semantic support or engineering safety.
        return new Checked(draft.possibleCauses(),List.copyOf(checks),List.copyOf(facts),
                draft.pendingConfirmations(),draft.insufficientEvidence(),true);
    }
    private static int passed;
    private static void rejects(Runnable r) {
        try {r.run();throw new AssertionError("expected rejection");}
        catch(IllegalArgumentException expected){passed++;}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Entirely synthetic data. Hash strings identify fixtures; they are not real document hashes.
        var e1=new Evidence("E1","tenant-a","snap-7","sop-a","v2","section-4.3","fixture-hash-1",Kind.SOP);
        var c1=new Evidence("C1","tenant-a","snap-7","case-a","v1","paragraph-2","fixture-hash-2",Kind.CASE);
        var s=new Snapshot("tenant-a","snap-7",Map.of("M1",new Fact("M1",new BigDecimal("89.0"),"degC")),
                Map.of("E1",e1,"C1",c1),Map.of("CHK-A",new Check("CHK-A","仅提交有权限工程师复核，当前程序不操作设备")));
        var now=new CurrentView(true,Set.of("E1","C1"),Set.of("CHK-A"));
        var cause=new Cause("可能存在换热异常，尚需核实",Likelihood.POSSIBLE,List.of("E1","C1"));
        var good=new DiagnosisDraft(List.of(cause),List.of(new RecommendedCheck("CHK-A",List.of("E1"))),
                List.of("M1"),List.of("由工程师确认适用工况与证据支持"),false);
        Checked result=verify(good,s,now);
        if(!result.facts().get(0).value().equals(new BigDecimal("89.0"))||!result.requiresHumanReview())
            throw new AssertionError();passed++;
        rejects(()->verify(good,s,new CurrentView(true,Set.of("C1"),Set.of("CHK-A"))));
        rejects(()->verify(good,s,new CurrentView(false,Set.of("E1","C1"),Set.of("CHK-A"))));
        rejects(()->verify(good,s,new CurrentView(true,Set.of("E1","C1"),Set.of())));
        rejects(()->verify(new DiagnosisDraft(List.of(cause),List.of(new RecommendedCheck("CHK-A",List.of("C1"))),
                List.of(),List.of(),false),s,now));
        rejects(()->verify(new DiagnosisDraft(List.of(new Cause("当前温度93度",Likelihood.POSSIBLE,List.of("E1"))),
                List.of(),List.of(),List.of(),false),s,now));
        rejects(()->verify(new DiagnosisDraft(List.of(),List.of(),List.of("M2"),List.of(),false),s,now));
        rejects(()->new Cause("未知",Likelihood.POSSIBLE,List.of("E1","E1")));
        rejects(()->verify(new DiagnosisDraft(List.of(),List.of(),List.of(),List.of(),true),s,now));
        var empty=new DiagnosisDraft(List.of(),List.of(),List.of("M1"),List.of("缺少当前适用的正式依据"),true);
        if(!verify(empty,s,new CurrentView(true,Set.of(),Set.of())).insufficient())throw new AssertionError();passed++;
        System.out.println("PASS: "+passed+" diagnosis structural/current-eligibility checks; no JSON parser, LLM, semantic entailment or production safety test.");
    }
}

import java.util.*;

/** Java 17+ teaching implementation. Judges and embeddings are injected, never invented. */
public final class RagasFourMetrics {
    private RagasFourMetrics() {}
    public static final double AP_EPSILON = 1e-10;

    public record Sample(String question, String answer, List<String> contexts, String reference) {
        public Sample {
            nonBlank(question, "question");
            Objects.requireNonNull(answer, "answer");
            contexts = textList(contexts, false, "contexts");
            // reference may be absent for faithfulness, relevancy and reference-free precision.
        }
        String requireReference() {
            nonBlank(reference, "reference");
            return reference;
        }
        String joinedContext() { return String.join("\n", contexts); }
    }

    public record Score(OptionalDouble value, String note) {
        public Score {
            Objects.requireNonNull(value, "value");
            nonBlank(note, "note");
            if (value.isPresent() && (!Double.isFinite(value.getAsDouble())
                    || value.getAsDouble() < -1 || value.getAsDouble() > 1))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("score must be finite and within [-1,1]");
        }
        static Score defined(double x, String note) { return new Score(OptionalDouble.of(x), note); }
        static Score undefined(String note) { return new Score(OptionalDouble.empty(), note); }
    }
    public record Decision(int index, String statement, int verdict, String reason) {
        public Decision {
            if (index < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative statement index");
            nonBlank(statement, "statement"); binary(verdict); nonBlank(reason, "reason");
        }
    }
    public record ReverseQuestion(String question, int noncommittal) {
        public ReverseQuestion { Objects.requireNonNull(question, "generated question"); binary(noncommittal); }
    }
    public record Useful(int verdict, String reason) {
        public Useful { binary(verdict); nonBlank(reason, "reason"); }
    }
    public record Attribution(String statement, int attributed, String reason) {
        public Attribution { nonBlank(statement, "reference statement"); binary(attributed); nonBlank(reason, "reason"); }
    }

    @FunctionalInterface public interface StatementExtractor {
        List<String> extract(String question, String answer);
    }
    @FunctionalInterface public interface FaithfulnessJudge {
        List<Decision> judge(String joinedContext, List<String> statements);
    }
    @FunctionalInterface public interface ReverseQuestionJudge {
        ReverseQuestion generate(String answer); // Intentionally receives no original question.
    }
    public interface Embeddings {
        double[] embedQuery(String originalQuestion);
        double[][] embedDocuments(List<String> generatedQuestions);
    }
    @FunctionalInterface public interface PrecisionJudge {
        Useful judge(String question, String oneContext, String targetAnswer);
    }
    @FunctionalInterface public interface RecallJudge {
        List<Attribution> classify(String question, String joinedContext, String reference);
    }

    public record FaithfulnessResult(Score score, List<String> statements, List<Decision> decisions) {}
    public record RelevancyResult(Score score, List<ReverseQuestion> generations, List<Double> cosines) {}
    public record PrecisionResult(Score score, List<Useful> judgments) {}
    public record RecallResult(Score score, List<Attribution> judgments) {}
    public record Evaluation(FaithfulnessResult faithfulness, RelevancyResult relevancy,
                             PrecisionResult precision, RecallResult recall) {}

    public static FaithfulnessResult faithfulness(Sample sample, StatementExtractor extractor,
                                                  FaithfulnessJudge judge) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(sample); Objects.requireNonNull(extractor); Objects.requireNonNull(judge);
        List<String> statements = textList(extractor.extract(sample.question(), sample.answer()), true, "statements");
        if (statements.isEmpty())
            return new FaithfulnessResult(Score.undefined("no answer statements"), statements, List.of());
        List<Decision> raw = immutable(judge.judge(sample.joinedContext(), statements), "faithfulness judgments");
        if (raw.size() != statements.size()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing or extra judgments");
        Decision[] ordered = new Decision[statements.size()];
        for (Decision d : raw) {
            if (d.index() >= ordered.length || ordered[d.index()] != null)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("unknown or duplicate judgment index");
            if (!d.statement().equals(statements.get(d.index())))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("judgment changed statement text");
            ordered[d.index()] = d;
        }
        int[] flags = new int[ordered.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < flags.length; i++) flags[i] = ordered[i].verdict();
        return new FaithfulnessResult(binaryFraction(flags, "no answer statements"), statements, List.of(ordered));
    }

    public static RelevancyResult relevancy(Sample sample, int strictness, ReverseQuestionJudge judge,
                                            Embeddings embeddings) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(sample); Objects.requireNonNull(judge); Objects.requireNonNull(embeddings);
        if (strictness <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("strictness must be positive");
        List<ReverseQuestion> results = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < strictness; i++) results.add(Objects.requireNonNull(judge.generate(sample.answer())));
        return relevancyFromGenerations(sample.question(), results, embeddings);
    }

    public static RelevancyResult relevancyFromGenerations(String originalQuestion,
            List<ReverseQuestion> generations, Embeddings embeddings) {
        nonBlank(originalQuestion, "question"); Objects.requireNonNull(embeddings);
        List<ReverseQuestion> rows = immutable(generations, "generations");
        if (rows.isEmpty() || rows.stream().allMatch(r -> r.question().isBlank()))
            return new RelevancyResult(Score.undefined("no generated questions"), rows, List.of());
        // Deliberate validation improvement: do not silently embed a partially empty result.
        List<String> questions = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean noncommittal = false;
        for (ReverseQuestion row : rows) {
            nonBlank(row.question(), "partially empty generated question");
            questions.add(row.question()); noncommittal |= row.noncommittal() == 1;
        }
        double[] original = Objects.requireNonNull(embeddings.embedQuery(originalQuestion));
        double[][] generated = Objects.requireNonNull(embeddings.embedDocuments(List.copyOf(questions)));
        if (generated.length != rows.size()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("embedding count mismatch");
        List<Double> cosines = new ArrayList<>();
        double sum = 0;
        for (double[] vector : generated) { double c = cosine(original, vector); cosines.add(c); sum += c; }
        // Validate embeddings before applying the gate; an invalid vector is not a valid zero score.
        double score = noncommittal ? 0.0 : sum / rows.size();
        return new RelevancyResult(Score.defined(score, noncommittal ? "noncommittal gate" : "mean cosine"),
                rows, List.copyOf(cosines));
    }

    public static PrecisionResult precisionWithReference(Sample sample, PrecisionJudge judge) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(sample);
        return precision(sample, sample.requireReference(), judge);
    }
    public static PrecisionResult precisionWithoutReference(Sample sample, PrecisionJudge judge) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(sample);
        return precision(sample, sample.answer(), judge);
    }
    private static PrecisionResult precision(Sample sample, String target, PrecisionJudge judge) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(judge);
        List<Useful> judgments = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String context : sample.contexts())
            judgments.add(Objects.requireNonNull(judge.judge(sample.question(), context, target)));
        int[] flags = judgments.stream().mapToInt(Useful::verdict).toArray();
        return new PrecisionResult(Score.defined(averagePrecision(flags), "rank-sensitive AP, epsilon=1e-10"),
                List.copyOf(judgments));
    }

    public static RecallResult recall(Sample sample, RecallJudge judge) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(sample); Objects.requireNonNull(judge);
        List<Attribution> judgments = immutable(judge.classify(sample.question(), sample.joinedContext(),
                sample.requireReference()), "recall classifications");
        int[] flags = judgments.stream().mapToInt(Attribution::attributed).toArray();
        return new RecallResult(binaryFraction(flags, "no reference classifications"), judgments);
    }

    public static Evaluation evaluate(Sample sample, StatementExtractor extractor, FaithfulnessJudge faithful,
            ReverseQuestionJudge reverse, Embeddings embeddings, PrecisionJudge precision, RecallJudge recall) {
        return new Evaluation(faithfulness(sample, extractor, faithful), relevancy(sample, 3, reverse, embeddings),
                precisionWithReference(sample, precision), recall(sample, recall));
    }

    public record Summary(OptionalDouble mean, int defined, int undefined) {}
    public static Summary summarize(List<Score> scores) {
        List<Score> rows = immutable(scores, "scores");
        double mean = 0; int count = 0;
        for (Score score : rows) if (score.value().isPresent()) {
            count++;
            mean += (score.value().getAsDouble() - mean) / count;
        }
        return new Summary(count == 0 ? OptionalDouble.empty() : OptionalDouble.of(mean), count, rows.size() - count);
    }

    public static Score binaryFraction(int[] flags, String emptyReason) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(flags); nonBlank(emptyReason, "empty reason");
        long positive = 0;
        for (int flag : flags) { binary(flag); positive += flag; }
        return flags.length == 0 ? Score.undefined(emptyReason)
                : Score.defined((double) positive / flags.length, "supported / classified units");
    }
    public static double averagePrecision(int[] flags) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(flags);
        long relevant = 0; double numerator = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < flags.length; i++) {
            binary(flags[i]); relevant += flags[i];
            if (flags[i] == 1) numerator += (double) relevant / (i + 1L);
        }
        return numerator / (relevant + AP_EPSILON);
    }
    public static double cosine(double[] left, double[] right) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(left); Objects.requireNonNull(right);
        if (left.length == 0 || left.length != right.length)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("empty vector or dimension mismatch");
        double[] a = unit(left), b = unit(right);
        double dot = 0, correction = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            double adjusted = a[i] * b[i] - correction;
            double next = dot + adjusted;
            correction = (next - dot) - adjusted; dot = next;
        }
        // Only roundoff can exceed these limits for validated unit vectors.
        return Math.max(-1.0, Math.min(1.0, dot));
    }
    private static double[] unit(double[] vector) {
        double scale = 0;
        for (double x : vector) {
            if (!Double.isFinite(x)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("non-finite embedding");
            scale = Math.max(scale, Math.abs(x));
        }
        if (scale == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("zero embedding norm");
        double sum = 0;
        for (double x : vector) { double scaled = x / scale; sum += scaled * scaled; }
        double norm = Math.sqrt(sum);
        double[] result = new double[vector.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) result[i] = (vector[i] / scale) / norm;
        return result;
    }
    private static void binary(int n) {
        if (n != 0 && n != 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("expected 0 or 1");
    }
    private static void nonBlank(String text, String name) {
        if (text == null || text.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " must be nonblank");
    }
    private static <T> List<T> immutable(List<T> list, String name) {
        if (list == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " is null");
        for (T value : list) if (value == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " contains null");
        return List.copyOf(list);
    }
    private static List<String> textList(List<String> list, boolean requireNonblank, String name) {
        List<String> result = immutable(list, name);
        if (requireNonblank) for (String text : result) nonBlank(text, name);
        return result;
    }
}

/** Deterministic fixtures only: no network, LLM, downloaded model or semantic benchmark. */
public final class RagasFourMetricsChecks {

    private static void invalid(Runnable r, String name) {

        return new RagasFourMetrics.Decision(index, CLAIMS.get(index), verdict, "固定测试判定");
    }
    private static RagasFourMetrics.ReverseQuestion reverse(String q, int nc) {
        return new RagasFourMetrics.ReverseQuestion(q, nc);
    }

    private static void pipelineFixture() {
        var s = sample(List.of(C1, C2, C3));
        var queries = List.of("P7压力及投产年份？", "P7额定压力是多少？", "P7何时开始使用？");
        AtomicInteger generated = new AtomicInteger();
        var result = RagasFourMetrics.evaluate(s,
            (q, a) -> { check(q.equals(Q) && a.equals(A), "extractor contract"); return CLAIMS; },
            (context, statements) -> {
                check(context.equals(C1 + "\n" + C2 + "\n" + C3), "faithfulness joined contexts");
                check(statements.equals(CLAIMS), "faithfulness input claims");
                return List.of(decision(1, 0), decision(0, 1)); // Deliberately returned out of order.
            },
            a -> { check(a.equals(A), "reverse generation sees answer"); return reverse(queries.get(generated.getAndIncrement()), 0); },
            new RagasFourMetrics.Embeddings() {
                public double[] embedQuery(String q) { check(q.equals(Q), "embedding original input"); return new double[]{1, 0}; }
                public double[][] embedDocuments(List<String> q) {
                    check(q.equals(queries), "embedding all reverse questions in order");
                    return new double[][]{{1, 0}, {0.8, 0.6}, {0, 1}};
                }
            },
            (q, context, reference) -> {
                check(q.equals(Q) && reference.equals(REF), "precision uses reference, not answer");
                return new RagasFourMetrics.Useful(context.equals(C2) ? 0 : 1, "固定测试判定");
            },
            (q, context, reference) -> {
                check(q.equals(Q) && reference.equals(REF) && context.equals(s.joinedContext()), "recall contract");
                return List.of(new RagasFourMetrics.Attribution(C1, 1, "第一块支持"),
                               new RagasFourMetrics.Attribution(C3, 1, "第三块支持"));
            });
        close(value(result.faithfulness().score()), 0.5, "faithfulness 1/2");
        close(value(result.relevancy().score()), 0.6, "relevancy (1+0.8+0)/3");
        close(value(result.precision().score()), (1.0 + 2.0/3) / (2 + 1e-10), "precision ranked AP");
        close(value(result.recall().score()), 1.0, "recall 2/2 despite incorrect generated year");
        check(result.faithfulness().decisions().get(0).index() == 0, "faithfulness ID reordering");
        check(generated.get() == 3, "default strictness exactly 3");
    }

    private static void fractionAndFaithfulness() {
        close(value(RagasFourMetrics.binaryFraction(new int[]{1, 0, 1}, "empty")), 2.0/3, "binary fraction");
        check(RagasFourMetrics.binaryFraction(new int[0], "empty").value().isEmpty(), "undefined empty denominator");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.binaryFraction(new int[]{2}, "empty"), "nonbinary fraction");
        var summary = RagasFourMetrics.summarize(List.of(
            RagasFourMetrics.binaryFraction(new int[]{1, 0}, "empty"),
            RagasFourMetrics.binaryFraction(new int[]{1}, "empty"),
            RagasFourMetrics.binaryFraction(new int[0], "empty")));
        close(summary.mean().orElseThrow(), 0.75, "macro mean of defined samples");
        check(summary.defined()==2 && summary.undefined()==1, "aggregation exposes coverage");
        check(RagasFourMetrics.summarize(List.of()).mean().isEmpty(), "empty aggregation undefined");
        check(RagasFourMetrics.summarize(List.of(RagasFourMetrics.binaryFraction(new int[0], "empty"))).mean().isEmpty(), "all undefined aggregation");
        invalid(() -> new RagasFourMetrics.Score(OptionalDouble.of(Double.NaN), "bad"), "NaN score");
        invalid(() -> new RagasFourMetrics.Score(OptionalDouble.of(2), "bad"), "out-of-range score");
        invalid(() -> new RagasFourMetrics.Decision(0, "s", -1, "r"), "nonbinary judgment");
        invalid(() -> new RagasFourMetrics.Decision(-1, "s", 1, "r"), "negative ID");
        var s = sample(List.of(C1));
        var emptyAnswer = new RagasFourMetrics.Sample(Q, "", List.of(), null);
        check(RagasFourMetrics.faithfulness(emptyAnswer, (q, a) -> { check(a.isEmpty(), "empty answer forwarded"); return List.of(); },
            (c, cl) -> { throw new AssertionError("no empty-answer claims"); }).score().value().isEmpty(), "empty answer without claims undefined");
        var empty = RagasFourMetrics.faithfulness(s, (q, a) -> List.of(),
            (c, claims) -> { throw new AssertionError("must not judge empty claims"); });
        check(empty.score().value().isEmpty(), "faithfulness no claims undefined");
        close(value(RagasFourMetrics.faithfulness(sample(List.of()), (q, a) -> CLAIMS,
            (c, claims) -> { check(c.isEmpty(), "empty retrieved context passed"); return List.of(decision(0, 0), decision(1, 0)); }).score()), 0, "claims with no evidence");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.faithfulness(s, (q, a) -> CLAIMS, (c, cl) -> List.of(decision(0, 1))), "missing judgment");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.faithfulness(s, (q, a) -> CLAIMS,
            (c, cl) -> List.of(decision(0, 1), decision(0, 0))), "duplicate index");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.faithfulness(s, (q, a) -> CLAIMS,
            (c, cl) -> List.of(decision(0, 1), new RagasFourMetrics.Decision(7, CLAIMS.get(1), 1, "r"))), "unknown index");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.faithfulness(s, (q, a) -> CLAIMS,
            (c, cl) -> List.of(decision(0, 1), new RagasFourMetrics.Decision(1, "changed", 1, "r"))), "changed claim");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.faithfulness(s, (q, a) -> List.of(" "), (c, cl) -> List.of()), "blank extracted statement");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.faithfulness(s, (q, a) -> null, (c, cl) -> List.of()), "null extraction");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.faithfulness(s, (q, a) -> CLAIMS, (c, cl) -> null), "null judgments");
    }

    private static void rankingsAndRecall() {
        close(RagasFourMetrics.averagePrecision(new int[0]), 0, "empty AP matches epsilon contract");
        close(RagasFourMetrics.averagePrecision(new int[]{0, 0}), 0, "all irrelevant AP");
        close(RagasFourMetrics.averagePrecision(new int[]{1}), 1.0/(1+1e-10), "AP retains epsilon");
        close(RagasFourMetrics.averagePrecision(new int[]{0, 1, 1}), (0.5+2.0/3)/(2+1e-10), "late relevant AP");
        close(RagasFourMetrics.averagePrecision(new int[]{1, 0, 0}), 1.0/(1+1e-10), "irrelevant trailing chunks not penalized by this AP");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.averagePrecision(new int[]{1, 3}), "nonbinary AP");
        // Independent O(n^2) calculation over positive rank positions, for every binary ranking up to 12.
        for (int n = 0; n <= 12; n++) {
            for (int bits = 0; bits < (1 << n); bits++) {
                int[] flags = new int[n]; List<Integer> ranks = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { flags[i] = (bits >>> i) & 1; if (flags[i] == 1) ranks.add(i+1); }
                double reference = 0;
                for (int rank : ranks) {
                    long earlier = ranks.stream().filter(r -> r <= rank).count();
                    reference += (double) earlier / rank;
                }
                reference /= (ranks.size() + 1e-10);
                close(RagasFourMetrics.averagePrecision(flags), reference, "exhaustive rank reference");
                for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) if (flags[i] == 1 && flags[i-1] == 0) {
                    int[] swapped = flags.clone(); swapped[i-1] = 1; swapped[i] = 0;
                    check(RagasFourMetrics.averagePrecision(swapped) >= RagasFourMetrics.averagePrecision(flags), "moving useful chunk earlier cannot lower AP");
                }
            }
        }
        var s = sample(List.of(C1, C2));
        close(value(RagasFourMetrics.precisionWithoutReference(s, (q, c, target) -> {
            check(target.equals(A), "reference-free precision uses answer");
            return new RagasFourMetrics.Useful(c.equals(C1) ? 1 : 0, "fixture");
        }).score()), 1.0/(1+1e-10), "reference-free AP");
        close(value(RagasFourMetrics.precisionWithReference(sample(List.of()),
            (q, c, a) -> { throw new AssertionError("no chunks to judge"); }).score()), 0, "empty contexts precision");
        close(value(RagasFourMetrics.recall(s, (q, c, r) -> List.of(
            new RagasFourMetrics.Attribution(C1, 1, "yes"), new RagasFourMetrics.Attribution(C3, 0, "absent"))).score()), 0.5, "recall denominator is reference units");
        close(value(RagasFourMetrics.recall(sample(List.of()), (q, c, r) -> List.of(
            new RagasFourMetrics.Attribution(C1, 0, "absent"), new RagasFourMetrics.Attribution(C3, 0, "absent"))).score()), 0, "recall no evidence");
        check(RagasFourMetrics.recall(s, (q, c, r) -> List.of()).score().value().isEmpty(), "empty recall classifications undefined");
        var noReference = new RagasFourMetrics.Sample(Q, A, List.of(C1), null);
        close(value(RagasFourMetrics.precisionWithoutReference(noReference, (q, c, a) -> new RagasFourMetrics.Useful(1, "fixture")).score()),
            1.0/(1+1e-10), "reference-free metric really permits absent reference");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.precisionWithReference(noReference, (q, c, a) -> new RagasFourMetrics.Useful(1, "r")), "precision missing reference");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.recall(noReference, (q, c, r) -> List.of()), "recall missing reference");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.recall(s, (q, c, r) -> null), "null recall classifications");
        invalid(() -> new RagasFourMetrics.Attribution("s", 2, "r"), "nonbinary recall");
    }

    private static void relevancyAndVectors() {
        var one = List.of(reverse("q1", 0));
        var two = List.of(reverse("q1", 0), reverse("q2", 1));
        var base = embeddings(new double[]{1, 0}, new double[][]{{1, 0}});
        close(value(RagasFourMetrics.relevancyFromGenerations(Q, one, base).score()), 1, "relevancy identical");
        close(value(RagasFourMetrics.relevancyFromGenerations(Q, one,
            embeddings(new double[]{1, 0}, new double[][]{{-1, 0}})).score()), -1, "negative relevancy retained");
        close(value(RagasFourMetrics.relevancyFromGenerations(Q, two,
            embeddings(new double[]{1, 0}, new double[][]{{1, 0}, {1, 0}})).score()), 0, "any noncommittal gates all");
        check(RagasFourMetrics.relevancyFromGenerations(Q, List.of(reverse("", 0)), base).score().value().isEmpty(), "all-empty generated questions");
        check(RagasFourMetrics.relevancyFromGenerations(Q, List.of(), base).score().value().isEmpty(), "zero returned generations");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.relevancyFromGenerations(Q, List.of(reverse("q", 0), reverse("", 0)), base), "partially empty generation");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.relevancy(sample(List.of()), 0, a -> reverse("q", 0), base), "strictness zero");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.relevancy(sample(List.of()), -1, a -> reverse("q", 0), base), "strictness negative");
        invalid(() -> reverse("q", 2), "invalid noncommittal flag");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.relevancyFromGenerations(Q, two, base), "embedding count mismatch");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.relevancyFromGenerations(Q, List.of(reverse("q", 1)),
            embeddings(new double[]{0, 0}, new double[][]{{1, 0}})), "invalid embedding not hidden by gate");
        close(RagasFourMetrics.cosine(new double[]{1, 0}, new double[]{0, 1}), 0, "orthogonal cosine");
        close(RagasFourMetrics.cosine(new double[]{3, 4}, new double[]{6, 8}), 1, "scale invariance");
        close(RagasFourMetrics.cosine(new double[]{Double.MAX_VALUE, Double.MAX_VALUE},
            new double[]{Double.MIN_VALUE, Double.MIN_VALUE}), 1, "extreme finite magnitudes");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.cosine(new double[0], new double[0]), "empty vectors");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.cosine(new double[]{1}, new double[]{1, 2}), "dimension mismatch");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.cosine(new double[]{0}, new double[]{1}), "zero norm");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.cosine(new double[]{Double.NaN}, new double[]{1}), "NaN vector");
        invalid(() -> RagasFourMetrics.cosine(new double[]{1}, new double[]{Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY}), "infinite vector");
        Random random = new Random(20261012L);
        for (int t = 0; t < 1000; t++) {
            double[] x = new double[7], y = new double[7]; double dot=0, xx=0, yy=0;
            for (int i=0; i<x.length; i++) { x[i]=random.nextDouble()*2-1; y[i]=random.nextDouble()*2-1; dot+=x[i]*y[i]; xx+=x[i]*x[i]; yy+=y[i]*y[i]; }
            close(RagasFourMetrics.cosine(x, y), dot/Math.sqrt(xx*yy), "independent moderate-vector cosine");
        }
    }

    private static void inputOwnership() {
        ArrayList<String> contexts = new ArrayList<>(List.of(C1));
        var s = sample(contexts); contexts.add(C2);
        check(s.contexts().equals(List.of(C1)), "defensive input copy");
        try { s.contexts().add(C3); throw new AssertionError("mutable contexts"); }
        catch (UnsupportedOperationException expected) { checks++; }
        invalid(() -> new RagasFourMetrics.Sample(" ", A, List.of(), REF), "blank question");
        invalid(() -> new RagasFourMetrics.Sample(Q, null, List.of(), REF), "null answer");
        invalid(() -> new RagasFourMetrics.Sample(Q, A, null, REF), "null contexts");
        invalid(() -> new RagasFourMetrics.Sample(Q, A, Arrays.asList((String)null), REF), "null context entry");
        var duplicate = sample(List.of(C1, C1)); AtomicInteger count = new AtomicInteger();
        close(value(RagasFourMetrics.precisionWithReference(duplicate, (q, c, r) -> {
            count.incrementAndGet(); return new RagasFourMetrics.Useful(1, "fixture");
        }).score()), 2.0/(2+1e-10), "duplicates retained in supplied ranking");
        check(count.get()==2, "judge sees duplicate chunks separately");
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        pipelineFixture(); fractionAndFaithfulness(); rankingsAndRecall(); relevancyAndVectors(); inputOwnership();
        System.out.println("PASS " + checks + " deterministic checks. No LLM, embedding model, network or RAGAS runtime executed.");
    }

-- Prerequisites: extension vector 0.8.2 already installed in a disposable PG16 database.

BEGIN;
DO $$
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('server_version_num')::int NOT BETWEEN 160000 AND 169999 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'requires PostgreSQL 16';
 END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='vector' AND extversion='0.8.2') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'requires installed pgvector 0.8.2';
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND (rolsuper OR rolbypassrls)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'RLS demonstration must not use superuser or BYPASSRLS';
 END IF;
END $$;

 chunk_id bigint NOT NULL, source_id text NOT NULL, revision text NOT NULL,

ALTER TABLE demo_vector_chunk FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY demo_read_policy ON demo_vector_chunk FOR SELECT USING(
 tenant_id=nullif(current_setting('demo.tenant',true),'')::bigint
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM demo_vector_grant g
 WHERE (g.tenant_id,g.generation,g.chunk_id)=
       (demo_vector_chunk.tenant_id,demo_vector_chunk.generation,demo_vector_chunk.chunk_id)
 AND g.principal=current_user));

-- Thus this custom GUC is NOT itself a tenant-authentication boundary.

SET LOCAL statement_timeout='2s';
SET LOCAL hnsw.ef_search=100;
SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan='strict_order';
SET LOCAL hnsw.max_scan_tuples=1000;
SET LOCAL hnsw.scan_mem_multiplier=1;

 FROM demo_vector_chunk WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND generation=$2
 ORDER BY embedding <=> $3 LIMIT CASE WHEN $4 BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN $4 ELSE 0 END;

-- merely because its index exists. Check the actual plan below.

) SELECT chunk_id,embedding <=> '[1,0,0]'::vector AS distance
 FROM eligible ORDER BY distance,chunk_id LIMIT 5;

DO $$
BEGIN

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'grant revocation failed';
 END IF;
END $$;
DEALLOCATE demo_ann;
ROLLBACK;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
import java.util.function.LongSupplier;

/** Local monotonic budget only: does not cancel remote calls or interrupt threads. */
public final class DeadlineBudget {
    private final LongSupplier clock;
    private final long started;
    private final long budget;
    public DeadlineBudget(Duration total, LongSupplier clock) {
        this.clock = Objects.requireNonNull(clock);
        Objects.requireNonNull(total);
        if (total.isNegative() || total.isZero() || total.compareTo(Duration.ofDays(1)) > 0)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("total must be in (0, one day]");
        budget = total.toNanos(); started = clock.getAsLong();
    }
    public long remainingNanos() {
        long elapsed = clock.getAsLong() - started;
        // nanoTime may wrap; subtraction is valid for elapsed intervals less than 2^63 ns.
        if (elapsed < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("clock moved backwards or interval too large");
        return elapsed >= budget ? 0 : budget - elapsed;
    }
    public Duration allowance(Duration stageCap, Duration reserveAfter) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(stageCap); Objects.requireNonNull(reserveAfter);
        if (stageCap.isNegative() || stageCap.isZero() || reserveAfter.isNegative()
                || stageCap.compareTo(Duration.ofDays(1)) > 0 || reserveAfter.compareTo(Duration.ofDays(1)) > 0)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid bounded stage durations");
        long left = remainingNanos(); long reserve = reserveAfter.toNanos();
        return Duration.ofNanos(left <= reserve ? 0 : Math.min(stageCap.toNanos(), left - reserve));
    }
    private static void check(boolean b) { if (!b) throw new AssertionError(); }
    private static void invalid(Runnable r) { try { r.run(); throw new AssertionError(); } catch (IllegalArgumentException ok) {} }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        AtomicLong now = new AtomicLong(100);
        DeadlineBudget b = new DeadlineBudget(Duration.ofSeconds(10), now::get);
        check(b.allowance(Duration.ofSeconds(3), Duration.ofSeconds(4)).equals(Duration.ofSeconds(3)));
        now.addAndGet(Duration.ofSeconds(5).toNanos());
        check(b.allowance(Duration.ofSeconds(3), Duration.ofSeconds(4)).equals(Duration.ofSeconds(1)));
        now.addAndGet(Duration.ofSeconds(1).toNanos());
        check(b.allowance(Duration.ofSeconds(3), Duration.ofSeconds(4)).isZero());
        now.addAndGet(Duration.ofSeconds(4).toNanos()); check(b.remainingNanos() == 0);
        now.incrementAndGet(); check(b.remainingNanos() == 0);
        invalid(() -> new DeadlineBudget(Duration.ZERO, now::get));
        invalid(() -> new DeadlineBudget(Duration.ofDays(2), now::get));
        invalid(() -> b.allowance(Duration.ofSeconds(-1), Duration.ZERO));
        invalid(() -> b.allowance(Duration.ofSeconds(1), Duration.ofNanos(-1)));
        AtomicLong wrap = new AtomicLong(Long.MAX_VALUE - 5);
        DeadlineBudget w = new DeadlineBudget(Duration.ofNanos(20), wrap::get);
        wrap.addAndGet(10); check(w.remainingNanos() == 10);
        AtomicLong exact = new AtomicLong(-100);
        DeadlineBudget e = new DeadlineBudget(Duration.ofNanos(10000), exact::get);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 10000; i++) {
            exact.set(-100L + i); check(e.remainingNanos() == 10000 - i);
        }
        System.out.println("PASS DeadlineBudget: 10001 boundaries, reserve exhaustion, invalid duration, nanoTime wrap. Local fake clock only; no network timeout/cancellation execution.");
    }
}

import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

/** Complete synthetic saturation demonstration; not a persistent queue or an application scheduler. */
public final class BoundedWorkerDemo {
    private BoundedWorkerDemo() {}
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        CountDownLatch started=new CountDownLatch(8), release=new CountDownLatch(1);
        AtomicInteger completed=new AtomicInteger();
        ThreadPoolExecutor worker=new ThreadPoolExecutor(8,8,0L,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS,
                new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(8),new ThreadPoolExecutor.AbortPolicy());
        Runnable hold=()->{
            started.countDown();
            try {release.await();completed.incrementAndGet();}
            catch(InterruptedException e){Thread.currentThread().interrupt();}
        };
        try {
            for(int i=0;i<8;i++)worker.execute(hold);
            if(!started.await(5,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("workers failed to start");
            for(int i=0;i<8;i++)worker.execute(completed::incrementAndGet);
            if(worker.getQueue().size()!=8)throw new AssertionError("queue bound");
            try {worker.execute(completed::incrementAndGet);throw new AssertionError("expected rejection");}
            catch(RejectedExecutionException expected) { /* Leave durable task pending; do not claim acceptance. */ }
        } finally {
            release.countDown();worker.shutdown();
            if(!worker.awaitTermination(5,TimeUnit.SECONDS))worker.shutdownNow();
        }
        if(completed.get()!=16)throw new AssertionError("lost accepted work");
        System.out.println("PASS: 8 running + 8 queued; 17th rejected; all 16 accepted tasks completed. No database, broker, lease or crash recovery exercised.");
    }
}

/** 单词项教学评分；长度按实际 token 数，不含 Lucene norm 编码。 */
public final class BM25Score {
    private BM25Score() {}
    public static double term(int tf, int documentLength, int documents,
                              int documentFrequency, double averageLength,
                              double k1, double b) {
        if (tf < 0 || documentLength < tf || documents <= 0
                || documentFrequency < 0 || documentFrequency > documents
                || (tf > 0 && documentFrequency == 0)
                || !Double.isFinite(averageLength) || averageLength < 1
                || !Double.isFinite(k1) || k1 < 0 || k1 > 10
                || !Double.isFinite(b) || b < 0 || b > 1) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid statistics or parameters");
        }
        if (tf == 0) return 0;
        double idf = Math.log1p((documents - documentFrequency + .5)
                / (documentFrequency + .5));
        double norm = (1 - b) + b * documentLength / averageLength;
        return idf * (tf * (k1 + 1)) / (tf + k1 * norm);
    }
}

import java.util.Objects;

/** 每个数组项对应一个不同查询词；不实现分词、倒排或多字段融合。 */
public final class Bm25 {
    private Bm25() {}
    public static double score(long documentCount, long[] documentFrequency,
                               int[] termFrequency, int documentLength,
                               double averageLength, double k1, double b) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(documentFrequency, "documentFrequency");
        Objects.requireNonNull(termFrequency, "termFrequency");
        if (documentCount < 1 || documentLength < 0
                || documentFrequency.length != termFrequency.length
                || !Double.isFinite(averageLength) || averageLength <= 0
                || !Double.isFinite(k1) || k1 < 0 || k1 > 1000
                || !Double.isFinite(b) || b < 0 || b > 1) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid corpus or parameters");
        }
        double ratio = documentLength / averageLength;
        if (!Double.isFinite(ratio))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("length ratio overflow");
        double norm = (1 - b) + b * ratio;
        double result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < termFrequency.length; i++) {
            long df = documentFrequency[i];
            int tf = termFrequency[i];
            if (df < 0 || df > documentCount || tf < 0 || tf > documentLength
                    || (tf > 0 && df == 0))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("inconsistent term statistics");
            if (tf == 0) continue;
            // 先做 long 减法，避免大 N 与 df 转 double 后相减丢失差值。
            double idf = Math.log1p(((documentCount - df) + .5) / (df + .5));
            double saturation;
            if (k1 == 0) {
                saturation = 1;
            } else if (norm >= 1) {
                // 分子分母同除 norm，避免有限的 k1 和 norm 相乘溢出。
                saturation = ((k1 + 1) * tf / norm) / (tf / norm + k1);
            } else {
                saturation = ((k1 + 1) * tf) / (tf + k1 * norm);
            }
            result += idf * saturation;
            if (!Double.isFinite(result))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("score overflow");
        }
        return result;
    }
}

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

/** 单租户、单代次有向图快照；不实现实体抽取、推理或真实授权服务。 */
public final class EvidenceGraph {
    public record Edge(long id, long from, long to, String relation, String evidence) {
        public Edge {
            if (id < 0 || from < 0 || to < 0 || relation == null || relation.isBlank()
                    || evidence == null || evidence.isBlank())
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("edge");
        }
    }
    public record Step(long node, int depth, List<Long> edgeIds) {
        public Step {
            edgeIds = List.copyOf(edgeIds);
            if (node < 0 || depth < 0 || depth > 32 || edgeIds.size() != depth
                    || edgeIds.stream().anyMatch(id -> id < 0))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("step");
        }
    }
    public static final class BudgetExceeded extends RuntimeException {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
        BudgetExceeded() { super("Traversal budget exceeded; no partial result returned"); }
    }
    private final long tenant, generation;
    private final Set<Long> nodes;
    private final Map<Long, List<Edge>> adjacency;

    public EvidenceGraph(long tenant, long generation, Set<Long> nodes, List<Edge> edges) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(nodes, "nodes");
        Objects.requireNonNull(edges, "edges");
        if (tenant <= 0 || generation < 0 || nodes.size() > 10000 || edges.size() > 50000)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("snapshot/budget");
        for (Long id : nodes)
            if (id == null || id < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("node");
        this.tenant = tenant;
        this.generation = generation;
        this.nodes = Set.copyOf(nodes);
        Set<Long> edgeIds = new HashSet<>();
        Map<Long, List<Edge>> temporary = new HashMap<>();
        for (Edge e : edges) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(e, "edge");
            if (!this.nodes.contains(e.from()) || !this.nodes.contains(e.to())
                    || !edgeIds.add(e.id()))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing node/duplicate edge id");
            temporary.computeIfAbsent(e.from(), key -> new ArrayList<>()).add(e);
        }
        Map<Long, List<Edge>> built = new HashMap<>();
        temporary.forEach((key, value) -> {
            value.sort(Comparator.comparingLong(Edge::id));
            built.put(key, List.copyOf(value));
        });
        adjacency = Map.copyOf(built);
    }

    /** 权限集合必须来自可信的当前鉴权结果；关系和时间等条件在建快照时限定。 */
    public List<Step> reach(long tenant, long generation, long start,
                            Set<Long> authorizedNodes, Set<String> authorizedEvidence,
                            Set<String> relations, int maxDepth, int maxVisited,
                            int maxScannedEdges) {
        if (tenant != this.tenant || generation != this.generation)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("wrong snapshot");
        Set<Long> allowed = Set.copyOf(authorizedNodes);
        Set<String> evidence = Set.copyOf(authorizedEvidence);
        Set<String> types = Set.copyOf(relations);
        if (maxDepth < 0 || maxDepth > 32 || maxVisited < 1 || maxVisited > 10000
                || maxScannedEdges < 0 || maxScannedEdges > 50000)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("budget");
        if (!nodes.contains(start) || !allowed.contains(start)) return List.of();
        List<Step> result = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<Long> seen = new HashSet<>();
        ArrayDeque<Step> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        queue.add(new Step(start, 0, List.of()));
        seen.add(start);
        int scanned = 0;
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            Step s = queue.removeFirst();
            result.add(s);
            if (s.depth() == maxDepth) continue;
            for (Edge edge : adjacency.getOrDefault(s.node(), List.of())) {
                if (++scanned > maxScannedEdges) throw new BudgetExceeded();
                if (!types.contains(edge.relation()) || !evidence.contains(edge.evidence())
                        || !allowed.contains(edge.to()) || seen.contains(edge.to())) continue;
                if (seen.size() == maxVisited) throw new BudgetExceeded();
                seen.add(edge.to());
                List<Long> path = new ArrayList<>(s.edgeIds());
                path.add(edge.id());
                queue.addLast(new Step(edge.to(), s.depth() + 1, path));
            }
        }
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }
}

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Random;
import java.util.Set;

public final class RecallChecks {
    private static int checks;
    private static void check(boolean ok) {
        checks++;
        if (!ok) throw new AssertionError("check " + checks);
    }
    private static void close(double actual, double expected) {
        check(Double.isFinite(actual) && Math.abs(actual - expected)
                <= Math.max(1e-12 * Math.abs(expected), 1e-320));
    }
    private static void rejects(Class<? extends Throwable> type, Runnable run) {
        checks++;
        try { run.run(); }
        catch (Throwable e) {
            if (type.isInstance(e)) return;
            throw new AssertionError("unexpected exception", e);
        }
        throw new AssertionError("expected " + type.getSimpleName());
    }
    private static double score(int tf, int len, long df, double avg, double k, double b) {
        return Bm25.score(1000, new long[]{df}, new int[]{tf}, len, avg, k, b);
    }
    private static void bm25() {
        double idf = Math.log1p(990.5 / 10.5);
        close(BM25Score.term(1,100,1000,10,100,1.2,.75), idf);
        close(score(2,100,10,100,1.2,.75), 1.375 * idf);
        for (int df = 1; df < 100; df++) {
            double previous = 0;
            for (int tf = 1; tf <= 100; tf++) {
                double s = BM25Score.term(tf,100,1000,df,100,1.2,.75);
                check(s > previous && s < Math.log1p((1000-df+.5)/(df+.5))*2.2);
                close(s,score(tf,100,df,100,1.2,.75));
                previous = s;
            }
        }
        close(score(0,100,10,100,0,.75),0);
        close(score(2,100,10,100,0,.75),idf);
        close(score(1,100,10,100,1.2,0),score(1,400,10,100,1.2,0));
        check(score(1,100,10,100,1.2,.75)>score(1,400,10,100,1.2,.75));
        check(score(1,100,10,100,1.2,.75)>score(1,100,20,100,1.2,.75));
        close(Bm25.score(1000,new long[0],new int[0],0,1,1.2,.75),0);
        close(Bm25.score(1000,new long[]{10,20,0},new int[]{2,1,0},100,100,1.2,.75),
                score(2,100,10,100,1.2,.75)+score(1,100,20,100,1.2,.75));
        close(BM25Score.term(0,0,1,0,1,0,1),0);
        close(Bm25.score(1,new long[]{0},new int[]{0},0,.1,0,1),0);
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->Bm25.score(0,new long[0],new int[0],0,1,1,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->score(-1,1,1,1,1,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->score(0,1,-1,1,1,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->score(1,1,1,Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY,1,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->score(1,1,1,1,1,Double.NaN));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->score(1,1,1,1,-1,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->Bm25.score(1000,new long[]{10,0},new int[]{1,1},2,2,1,.5));
        Random random = new Random(9283);
        for (int i=0;i<2000;i++) {
            int n=1+random.nextInt(10000), df=1+random.nextInt(n);
            int len=1+random.nextInt(500), tf=1+random.nextInt(len);
            double avg=.01+random.nextDouble()*1000, k=random.nextDouble()*1000;
            double b=random.nextDouble();
            double expected=Math.log1p((n-df+.5)/(df+.5))
                *tf*(k+1)/(tf+k*(1-b+b*len/avg));
            close(Bm25.score(n,new long[]{df},new int[]{tf},len,avg,k,b),expected);
        }
        // normalization 有限，但旧的 k1*normalization 会溢出。
        double extreme=score(1,1,10,1e-308,1000,1);
        check(extreme > 0);
        close(extreme,idf*1.001e-308);
        double rare=Bm25.score(Long.MAX_VALUE,new long[]{Long.MAX_VALUE},new int[]{1},1,1,0,1);
        close(rare,Math.log1p(.5/(Long.MAX_VALUE+.5)));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->BM25Score.term(1,1,1,0,1,1,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->BM25Score.term(0,-1,1,0,1,1,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->BM25Score.term(1,1,1,1,.5,1,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->BM25Score.term(1,1,1,1,1,11,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->score(1,0,1,1,1,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->score(1,1,0,1,1,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->score(0,1,1001,1,1,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->score(1,1,1,Double.MIN_VALUE,1,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->score(1,1,1,1,Double.NaN,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->score(1,1,1,1,1001,.5));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->score(1,1,1,1,1,1.1));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->Bm25.score(1,new long[]{1},new int[0],1,1,1,.5));
        rejects(NullPointerException.class,()->Bm25.score(1,null,new int[0],1,1,1,.5));
    }
    private static void graph() {
        List<EvidenceGraph.Edge> edges=List.of(
            new EvidenceGraph.Edge(2,0,1,"R","a"),
            new EvidenceGraph.Edge(1,0,2,"R","b"),
            new EvidenceGraph.Edge(3,1,3,"R","a"),
            new EvidenceGraph.Edge(4,2,3,"R","b"),
            new EvidenceGraph.Edge(5,3,0,"R","a"));
        Set<Long> all=Set.of(0L,1L,2L,3L);
        EvidenceGraph g=new EvidenceGraph(1,7,all,edges);
        var result=g.reach(1,7,0,all,Set.of("a","b"),Set.of("R"),3,10,50);
        check(result.size()==4);
        check(result.get(3).edgeIds().equals(List.of(1L,4L)));
        check(g.reach(1,7,0,all,Set.of("a"),Set.of("R"),3,10,50).size()==3);
        check(g.reach(1,7,0,Set.of(0L,3L),Set.of("a","b"),Set.of("R"),3,10,50).size()==1);
        check(g.reach(1,7,0,all,Set.of("a","b"),Set.of("R"),0,1,0).size()==1);
        check(g.reach(1,7,0,Set.of(),Set.of(),Set.of(),1,1,0).isEmpty());
        rejects(EvidenceGraph.BudgetExceeded.class,()->g.reach(1,7,0,all,Set.of("a","b"),Set.of("R"),3,1,50));
        rejects(EvidenceGraph.BudgetExceeded.class,()->g.reach(1,7,0,all,Set.of(),Set.of(),3,10,0));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->g.reach(2,7,0,all,Set.of(),Set.of(),1,1,0));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->g.reach(1,8,0,all,Set.of(),Set.of(),1,1,0));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new EvidenceGraph(1,1,all,List.of(edges.get(0),edges.get(0))));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new EvidenceGraph(1,1,Set.of(0L),edges));
        rejects(UnsupportedOperationException.class,()->result.add(result.get(0)));
        rejects(UnsupportedOperationException.class,()->result.get(3).edgeIds().add(9L));
        EvidenceGraph directed=new EvidenceGraph(1,0,Set.of(0L,1L),List.of(edges.get(0)));
        check(directed.reach(1,0,1,all,Set.of("a"),Set.of("R"),3,10,50).size()==1);
        check(g.reach(1,7,99,all,Set.of("a"),Set.of("R"),1,10,10).isEmpty());
        check(g.reach(1,7,0,all,Set.of("a","b"),Set.of("R"),32,10000,50000).size()==4);
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->g.reach(1,7,0,all,Set.of(),Set.of(),33,10,50));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->g.reach(1,7,0,all,Set.of(),Set.of(),1,0,50));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->g.reach(1,7,0,all,Set.of(),Set.of(),1,10001,50));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->g.reach(1,7,0,all,Set.of(),Set.of(),1,10,50001));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new EvidenceGraph(0,1,all,edges));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new EvidenceGraph(1,-1,all,edges));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new EvidenceGraph.Edge(1,0,1," ","a"));
        rejects(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new EvidenceGraph.Step(1,2,List.of(1L)));
        rejects(NullPointerException.class,()->new EvidenceGraph(1,1,null,edges));
        Set<Long> mutableNodes=new HashSet<>(all);
        List<EvidenceGraph.Edge> mutableEdges=new ArrayList<>(edges);
        EvidenceGraph immutable=new EvidenceGraph(1,7,mutableNodes,mutableEdges);
        mutableNodes.clear();mutableEdges.clear();
        check(immutable.reach(1,7,0,all,Set.of("a","b"),Set.of("R"),3,10,50).size()==4);
        Random random=new Random(861);
        for(int trial=0;trial<500;trial++) {
            int n=1+random.nextInt(25), depth=random.nextInt(6);
            Set<Long> nodes=new HashSet<>(), allowed=new HashSet<>();
            for(long i=0;i<n;i++){nodes.add(i);if(random.nextBoolean())allowed.add(i);}
            List<EvidenceGraph.Edge> es=new ArrayList<>();
            for(long id=0,count=random.nextInt(90);id<count;id++)
                es.add(new EvidenceGraph.Edge(id,random.nextInt(n),random.nextInt(n),
                    random.nextBoolean()?"R":"X",random.nextBoolean()?"a":"b"));
            long start=random.nextInt(n);
            var actual=new EvidenceGraph(1,0,nodes,es).reach(1,0,start,allowed,Set.of("a"),Set.of("R"),depth,100,1000);
            // 独立的逐层全边松弛，不使用队列或邻接表。
            Map<Long,Integer> distance=new HashMap<>();
            if(allowed.contains(start))distance.put(start,0);
            for(int step=0;step<depth;step++) {
                Map<Long,Integer> next=new HashMap<>(distance);
                for(var e:es) if(distance.containsKey(e.from()) && allowed.contains(e.to())
                        && e.relation().equals("R") && e.evidence().equals("a"))
                    next.merge(e.to(),distance.get(e.from())+1,Math::min);
                distance=next;
            }
            check(actual.size()==distance.size());
            Map<Long,EvidenceGraph.Edge> byId=new HashMap<>();
            for(var e:es)byId.put(e.id(),e);
            for(var s:actual) {
                check(distance.get(s.node())==s.depth());
                long at=start;
                for(long id:s.edgeIds()) {
                    var e=byId.get(id);
                    check(e.from()==at && allowed.contains(e.to()) && e.relation().equals("R") && e.evidence().equals("a"));
                    at=e.to();
                }
                check(at==s.node());
            }
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        bm25(); graph();
        System.out.println("PASS " + checks + " local deterministic checks");
    }
}

 FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,generation,evidence_id) REFERENCES kg_evidence);
CREATE TEMP TABLE kg_edge (
 tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, generation BIGINT NOT NULL, edge_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
 subject_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, predicate VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, object_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
 polarity SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK(polarity IN (-1,1)),
 qualifiers JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb CHECK(jsonb_typeof(qualifiers)='object'),
 valid_from BIGINT NOT NULL, valid_to BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(valid_from<valid_to),
 PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,generation,edge_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,generation,subject_id) REFERENCES kg_node,
 FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,generation,object_id) REFERENCES kg_node);
CREATE TEMP TABLE kg_edge_evidence (
 tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, generation BIGINT NOT NULL, edge_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
 evidence_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
 confidence DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL CHECK(confidence>=0 AND confidence<=1),
 PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,generation,edge_id,evidence_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,generation,edge_id) REFERENCES kg_edge,
 FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,generation,evidence_id) REFERENCES kg_evidence);
CREATE INDEX ix_kg_forward ON kg_edge(tenant_id,generation,subject_id,predicate,object_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_kg_reverse ON kg_edge(tenant_id,generation,object_id,predicate,subject_id);
